8489 Diag(FD->getLocation(), diag::err_defaulted_comparison_num_args)
8490 << int(IsMethod) << int(DCK);
8491 return true;
8492 }
8493
8494 const ParmVarDecl *KnownParm = nullptr;
8495 for (const ParmVarDecl *Param : FD->parameters()) {
8496 QualType ParmTy = Param->getType();
8497 if (ParmTy->isDependentType())
8498 continue;
8499 if (!KnownParm) {
8500 auto CTy = ParmTy;
8501 // Is it `T const &`?
8502 bool Ok = !IsMethod;
8503 QualType ExpectedTy;
8504 if (RD)
8505 ExpectedTy = Context.getRecordType(RD);
8506 if (auto *Ref = CTy->getAs<ReferenceType>()) {
8507 CTy = Ref->getPointeeType();
8508 if (RD)
8509 ExpectedTy.addConst();
8510 Ok = true;
8511 }
8512
8513 // Is T a class?
8514 if (!Ok) {
8515 } else if (RD) {
8516 if (!RD->isDependentType() && !Context.hasSameType(CTy, ExpectedTy))
8517 Ok = false;
8518 } else if (auto *CRD = CTy->getAsRecordDecl()) {
8519 RD = cast<CXXRecordDecl>(CRD);
8520 } else {
8521 Ok = false;
8522 }
8523
8524 if (Ok) {
8525 KnownParm = Param;
8526 } else {
8527 // Don't diagnose an implicit 'operator=='; we will have diagnosed the
8528 // corresponding defaulted 'operator<=>' already.
8529 if (!FD->isImplicit()) {
8530 if (RD) {
8531 QualType PlainTy = Context.getRecordType(RD);
8532 QualType RefTy =
8533 Context.getLValueReferenceType(PlainTy.withConst());
8534 Diag(FD->getLocation(), diag::err_defaulted_comparison_param)
8535 << int(DCK) << ParmTy << RefTy << int(!IsMethod) << PlainTy
8536 << Param->getSourceRange();
8537 } else {
8538 assert(!IsMethod && "should know expected type for method");
8539 Diag(FD->getLocation(),
8540 diag::err_defaulted_comparison_param_unknown)
8541 << int(DCK) << ParmTy << Param->getSourceRange();
8542 }
8543 }
8544 return true;
8545 }
8546 } else if (!Context.hasSameType(KnownParm->getType(), ParmTy)) {
8547 Diag(FD->getLocation(), diag::err_defaulted_comparison_param_mismatch)
8548 << int(DCK) << KnownParm->getType() << KnownParm->getSourceRange()
8549 << ParmTy << Param->getSourceRange();
8550 return true;
8551 }
8552 }
8553
8554 assert(RD && "must have determined class");
8555 if (IsMethod) {
8556 } else if (isa<CXXRecordDecl>(FD->getLexicalDeclContext())) {
8557 // In-class, must be a friend decl.
8558 assert(FD->getFriendObjectKind() && "expected a friend declaration");
8559 } else {
8560 // Out of class, require the defaulted comparison to be a friend (of a
8561 // complete type).
8562 if (RequireCompleteType(FD->getLocation(), Context.getRecordType(RD),
8563 diag::err_defaulted_comparison_not_friend, int(DCK),
8564 int(1)))
8565 return true;
8566
8567 if (llvm::find_if(RD->friends(), [&](const FriendDecl *F) {
8568 return FD->getCanonicalDecl() ==
8569 F->getFriendDecl()->getCanonicalDecl();
8570 }) == RD->friends().end()) {
8571 Diag(FD->getLocation(), diag::err_defaulted_comparison_not_friend)
8572 << int(DCK) << int(0) << RD;
8573 Diag(RD->getCanonicalDecl()->getLocation(), diag::note_declared_at);
8574 return true;
8575 }
8576 }
8577
8578 // C++2a [class.eq]p1, [class.rel]p1:
8579 // A [defaulted comparison other than <=>] shall have a declared return
8580 // type bool.
8581 if (DCK != DefaultedComparisonKind::ThreeWay &&
8582 !FD->getDeclaredReturnType()->isDependentType() &&
8583 !Context.hasSameType(FD->getDeclaredReturnType(), Context.BoolTy)) {
8584 Diag(FD->getLocation(), diag::err_defaulted_comparison_return_type_not_bool)
8585 << (int)DCK << FD->getDeclaredReturnType() << Context.BoolTy
8586 << FD->getReturnTypeSourceRange();
8587 return true;
8588 }
8589 // C++2a [class.spaceship]p2 [P2002R0]:
8590 // Let R be the declared return type [...]. If R is auto, [...]. Otherwise,
8591 // R shall not contain a placeholder type.
8592 if (DCK == DefaultedComparisonKind::ThreeWay &&
8593 FD->getDeclaredReturnType()->getContainedDeducedType() &&
8594 !Context.hasSameType(FD->getDeclaredReturnType(),
8595 Context.getAutoDeductType())) {
8596 Diag(FD->getLocation(),
8597 diag::err_defaulted_comparison_deduced_return_type_not_auto)
8598 << (int)DCK << FD->getDeclaredReturnType() << Context.AutoDeductTy
8599 << FD->getReturnTypeSourceRange();
8600 return true;
8601 }
8602
8603 // For a defaulted function in a dependent class, defer all remaining checks
8604 // until instantiation.
8605 if (RD->isDependentType())
8606 return false;
8607
8608 // Determine whether the function should be defined as deleted.
8609 DefaultedComparisonInfo Info =
8610 DefaultedComparisonAnalyzer(*this, RD, FD, DCK).visit();
8611
8612 bool First = FD == FD->getCanonicalDecl();
8613
8614 // If we want to delete the function, then do so; there's nothing else to
8615 // check in that case.
8616 if (Info.Deleted) {
8617 if (!First) {
8618 // C++11 [dcl.fct.def.default]p4:
8619 // [For a] user-provided explicitly-defaulted function [...] if such a
8620 // function is implicitly defined as deleted, the program is ill-formed.
8621 //
8622 // This is really just a consequence of the general rule that you can
8623 // only delete a function on its first declaration.
8624 Diag(FD->getLocation(), diag::err_non_first_default_compare_deletes)
8625 << FD->isImplicit() << (int)DCK;
8626 DefaultedComparisonAnalyzer(*this, RD, FD, DCK,
8627 DefaultedComparisonAnalyzer::ExplainDeleted)
8628 .visit();
8629 return true;
8630 }
8631
8632 SetDeclDeleted(FD, FD->getLocation());
8633 if (!inTemplateInstantiation() && !FD->isImplicit()) {
8634 Diag(FD->getLocation(), diag::warn_defaulted_comparison_deleted)
8635 << (int)DCK;
8636 DefaultedComparisonAnalyzer(*this, RD, FD, DCK,
8637 DefaultedComparisonAnalyzer::ExplainDeleted)
8638 .visit();
8639 }
8640 return false;
8641 }
8642
8643 // C++2a [class.spaceship]p2:
8644 // The return type is deduced as the common comparison type of R0, R1, ...
8645 if (DCK == DefaultedComparisonKind::ThreeWay &&
8646 FD->getDeclaredReturnType()->isUndeducedAutoType()) {
8647 SourceLocation RetLoc = FD->getReturnTypeSourceRange().getBegin();
8648 if (RetLoc.isInvalid())
8649 RetLoc = FD->getBeginLoc();
8650 // FIXME: Should we really care whether we have the complete type and the
8651 // 'enumerator' constants here? A forward declaration seems sufficient.
8652 QualType Cat = CheckComparisonCategoryType(
8653 Info.Category, RetLoc, ComparisonCategoryUsage::DefaultedOperator);
8654 if (Cat.isNull())
8655 return true;
8656 Context.adjustDeducedFunctionResultType(
8657 FD, SubstAutoType(FD->getDeclaredReturnType(), Cat));
8658 }
8659
8660 // C++2a [dcl.fct.def.default]p3 [P2002R0]:
8661 // An explicitly-defaulted function that is not defined as deleted may be
8662 // declared constexpr or consteval only if it is constexpr-compatible.
8663 // C++2a [class.compare.default]p3 [P2002R0]:
8664 // A defaulted comparison function is constexpr-compatible if it satisfies
8665 // the requirements for a constexpr function [...]
8666 // The only relevant requirements are that the parameter and return types are
8667 // literal types. The remaining conditions are checked by the analyzer.
8668 if (FD->isConstexpr()) {
8669 if (CheckConstexprReturnType(*this, FD, CheckConstexprKind::Diagnose) &&
8670 CheckConstexprParameterTypes(*this, FD, CheckConstexprKind::Diagnose) &&
8671 !Info.Constexpr) {
8672 Diag(FD->getBeginLoc(),
8673 diag::err_incorrect_defaulted_comparison_constexpr)
8674 << FD->isImplicit() << (int)DCK << FD->isConsteval();
8675 DefaultedComparisonAnalyzer(*this, RD, FD, DCK,
8676 DefaultedComparisonAnalyzer::ExplainConstexpr)
8677 .visit();
8678 }
8679 }
8680
8681 // C++2a [dcl.fct.def.default]p3 [P2002R0]:
8682 // If a constexpr-compatible function is explicitly defaulted on its first
8683 // declaration, it is implicitly considered to be constexpr.
8684 // FIXME: Only applying this to the first declaration seems problematic, as
8685 // simple reorderings can affect the meaning of the program.
8686 if (First && !FD->isConstexpr() && Info.Constexpr)
8687 FD->setConstexprKind(ConstexprSpecKind::Constexpr);
8688
8689 // C++2a [except.spec]p3:
8690 // If a declaration of a function does not have a noexcept-specifier
8691 // [and] is defaulted on its first declaration, [...] the exception
8692 // specification is as specified below
8693 if (FD->getExceptionSpecType() == EST_None) {
8694 auto *FPT = FD->getType()->castAs<FunctionProtoType>();
8695 FunctionProtoType::ExtProtoInfo EPI = FPT->getExtProtoInfo();
8696 EPI.ExceptionSpec.Type = EST_Unevaluated;
8697 EPI.ExceptionSpec.SourceDecl = FD;
8698 FD->setType(Context.getFunctionType(FPT->getReturnType(),
8699 FPT->getParamTypes(), EPI));
8700 }
8701
8702 return false;
8703}
8704
8705void Sema::DeclareImplicitEqualityComparison(CXXRecordDecl *RD,
8706 FunctionDecl *Spaceship) {
8707 Sema::CodeSynthesisContext Ctx;
8708 Ctx.Kind = Sema::CodeSynthesisContext::DeclaringImplicitEqualityComparison;
8709 Ctx.PointOfInstantiation = Spaceship->getEndLoc();
8710 Ctx.Entity = Spaceship;
8711 pushCodeSynthesisContext(Ctx);
8712
8713 if (FunctionDecl *EqualEqual = SubstSpaceshipAsEqualEqual(RD, Spaceship))
8714 EqualEqual->setImplicit();
8715
8716 popCodeSynthesisContext();
8717}
8718
8719void Sema::DefineDefaultedComparison(SourceLocation UseLoc, FunctionDecl *FD,
8720 DefaultedComparisonKind DCK) {
8721 assert(FD->isDefaulted() && !FD->isDeleted() &&
8722 !FD->doesThisDeclarationHaveABody());
8723 if (FD->willHaveBody() || FD->isInvalidDecl())
8724 return;
8725
8726 SynthesizedFunctionScope Scope(*this, FD);
8727
8728 // Add a context note for diagnostics produced after this point.
8729 Scope.addContextNote(UseLoc);
8730
8731 {
8732 // Build and set up the function body.
8733 // The first parameter has type maybe-ref-to maybe-const T, use that to get
8734 // the type of the class being compared.
8735 auto PT = FD->getParamDecl(0)->getType();
8736 CXXRecordDecl *RD = PT.getNonReferenceType()->getAsCXXRecordDecl();
8737 SourceLocation BodyLoc =
8738 FD->getEndLoc().isValid() ? FD->getEndLoc() : FD->getLocation();
8739 StmtResult Body =
8740 DefaultedComparisonSynthesizer(*this, RD, FD, DCK, BodyLoc).build();
8741 if (Body.isInvalid()) {
8742 FD->setInvalidDecl();
8743 return;
8744 }
8745 FD->setBody(Body.get());
8746 FD->markUsed(Context);
8747 }
8748
8749 // The exception specification is needed because we are defining the
8750 // function. Note that this will reuse the body we just built.
8751 ResolveExceptionSpec(UseLoc, FD->getType()->castAs<FunctionProtoType>());
8752
8753 if (ASTMutationListener *L = getASTMutationListener())
8754 L->CompletedImplicitDefinition(FD);
8755}
8756
8757static Sema::ImplicitExceptionSpecification
8758ComputeDefaultedComparisonExceptionSpec(Sema &S, SourceLocation Loc,
8759 FunctionDecl *FD,
8760 Sema::DefaultedComparisonKind DCK) {
8761 ComputingExceptionSpec CES(S, FD, Loc);
8762 Sema::ImplicitExceptionSpecification ExceptSpec(S);
8763
8764 if (FD->isInvalidDecl())
8765 return ExceptSpec;
8766
8767 // The common case is that we just defined the comparison function. In that
8768 // case, just look at whether the body can throw.
8769 if (FD->hasBody()) {
8770 ExceptSpec.CalledStmt(FD->getBody());
8771 } else {
8772 // Otherwise, build a body so we can check it. This should ideally only
8773 // happen when we're not actually marking the function referenced. (This is
8774 // only really important for efficiency: we don't want to build and throw
8775 // away bodies for comparison functions more than we strictly need to.)
8776
8777 // Pretend to synthesize the function body in an unevaluated context.
8778 // Note that we can't actually just go ahead and define the function here:
8779 // we are not permitted to mark its callees as referenced.
8780 Sema::SynthesizedFunctionScope Scope(S, FD);
8781 EnterExpressionEvaluationContext Context(
8782 S, Sema::ExpressionEvaluationContext::Unevaluated);
8783
8784 CXXRecordDecl *RD = cast<CXXRecordDecl>(FD->getLexicalParent());
8785 SourceLocation BodyLoc =
8786 FD->getEndLoc().isValid() ? FD->getEndLoc() : FD->getLocation();
8787 StmtResult Body =
8788 DefaultedComparisonSynthesizer(S, RD, FD, DCK, BodyLoc).build();
8789 if (!Body.isInvalid())
8790 ExceptSpec.CalledStmt(Body.get());
8791
8792 // FIXME: Can we hold onto this body and just transform it to potentially
8793 // evaluated when we're asked to define the function rather than rebuilding
8794 // it? Either that, or we should only build the bits of the body that we
8795 // need (the expressions, not the statements).
8796 }
8797
8798 return ExceptSpec;
8799}
8800
8801void Sema::CheckDelayedMemberExceptionSpecs() {
8802 decltype(DelayedOverridingExceptionSpecChecks) Overriding;
8803 decltype(DelayedEquivalentExceptionSpecChecks) Equivalent;
8804
8805 std::swap(Overriding, DelayedOverridingExceptionSpecChecks);
8806 std::swap(Equivalent, DelayedEquivalentExceptionSpecChecks);
8807
8808 // Perform any deferred checking of exception specifications for virtual
8809 // destructors.
8810 for (auto &Check : Overriding)
8811 CheckOverridingFunctionExceptionSpec(Check.first, Check.second);
8812
8813 // Perform any deferred checking of exception specifications for befriended
8814 // special members.
8815 for (auto &Check : Equivalent)
8816 CheckEquivalentExceptionSpec(Check.second, Check.first);
8817}

8819namespace {
8820/// CRTP base class for visiting operations performed by a special member
8821/// function (or inherited constructor).
8822template<typename Derived>
8823struct SpecialMemberVisitor {
8824 Sema &S;
8825 CXXMethodDecl *MD;
8826 Sema::CXXSpecialMember CSM;
8827 Sema::InheritedConstructorInfo *ICI;
8828
8829 // Properties of the special member, computed for convenience.
8830 bool IsConstructor = false, IsAssignment = false, ConstArg = false;
8831
8832 SpecialMemberVisitor(Sema &S, CXXMethodDecl *MD, Sema::CXXSpecialMember CSM,
8833 Sema::InheritedConstructorInfo *ICI)
8834 : S(S), MD(MD), CSM(CSM), ICI(ICI) {
8835 switch (CSM) {
8836 case Sema::CXXDefaultConstructor:
8837 case Sema::CXXCopyConstructor:
8838 case Sema::CXXMoveConstructor:
8839 IsConstructor = true;
8840 break;
8841 case Sema::CXXCopyAssignment:
8842 case Sema::CXXMoveAssignment:
8843 IsAssignment = true;
8844 break;
8845 case Sema::CXXDestructor:
8846 break;
8847 case Sema::CXXInvalid:
8848 llvm_unreachable("invalid special member kind");
8849 }
8850
8851 if (MD->getNumParams()) {
8852 if (const ReferenceType *RT =
8853 MD->getParamDecl(0)->getType()->getAs<ReferenceType>())
8854 ConstArg = RT->getPointeeType().isConstQualified();
8855 }
8856 }
8857
8858 Derived &getDerived() { return static_cast<Derived&>(*this); }
8859
8860 /// Is this a "move" special member?
8861 bool isMove() const {
8862 return CSM == Sema::CXXMoveConstructor || CSM == Sema::CXXMoveAssignment;
8863 }
8864
8865 /// Look up the corresponding special member in the given class.
8866 Sema::SpecialMemberOverloadResult lookupIn(CXXRecordDecl *Class,
8867 unsigned Quals, bool IsMutable) {
8868 return lookupCallFromSpecialMember(S, Class, CSM, Quals,
8869 ConstArg && !IsMutable);
8870 }
8871
8872 /// Look up the constructor for the specified base class to see if it's
8873 /// overridden due to this being an inherited constructor.
8874 Sema::SpecialMemberOverloadResult lookupInheritedCtor(CXXRecordDecl *Class) {
8875 if (!ICI)
8876 return {};
8877 assert(CSM == Sema::CXXDefaultConstructor);
8878 auto *BaseCtor =
8879 cast<CXXConstructorDecl>(MD)->getInheritedConstructor().getConstructor();
8880 if (auto *MD = ICI->findConstructorForBase(Class, BaseCtor).first)
8881 return MD;
8882 return {};
8883 }
8884
8885 /// A base or member subobject.
8886 typedef llvm::PointerUnion<CXXBaseSpecifier*, FieldDecl*> Subobject;
8887
8888 /// Get the location to use for a subobject in diagnostics.
8889 static SourceLocation getSubobjectLoc(Subobject Subobj) {
8890 // FIXME: For an indirect virtual base, the direct base leading to
8891 // the indirect virtual base would be a more useful choice.
8892 if (auto *B = Subobj.dyn_cast<CXXBaseSpecifier*>())
8893 return B->getBaseTypeLoc();
8894 else
8895 return Subobj.get<FieldDecl*>()->getLocation();
8896 }
8897
8898 enum BasesToVisit {
8899 /// Visit all non-virtual (direct) bases.
8900 VisitNonVirtualBases,
8901 /// Visit all direct bases, virtual or not.
8902 VisitDirectBases,
8903 /// Visit all non-virtual bases, and all virtual bases if the class
8904 /// is not abstract.
8905 VisitPotentiallyConstructedBases,
8906 /// Visit all direct or virtual bases.
8907 VisitAllBases
8908 };
8909
8910 // Visit the bases and members of the class.
8911 bool visit(BasesToVisit Bases) {
8912 CXXRecordDecl *RD = MD->getParent();
8913
8914 if (Bases == VisitPotentiallyConstructedBases)
8915 Bases = RD->isAbstract() ? VisitNonVirtualBases : VisitAllBases;
8916
8917 for (auto &B : RD->bases())
8918 if ((Bases == VisitDirectBases || !B.isVirtual()) &&
8919 getDerived().visitBase(&B))
8920 return true;
8921
8922 if (Bases == VisitAllBases)
8923 for (auto &B : RD->vbases())
8924 if (getDerived().visitBase(&B))
8925 return true;
8926
8927 for (auto *F : RD->fields())
8928 if (!F->isInvalidDecl() && !F->isUnnamedBitfield() &&
8929 getDerived().visitField(F))
8930 return true;
8931
8932 return false;
8933 }
8934};
8935}

8937namespace {
8938struct SpecialMemberDeletionInfo
8939 : SpecialMemberVisitor<SpecialMemberDeletionInfo> {
8940 bool Diagnose;
8941
8942 SourceLocation Loc;
8943
8944 bool AllFieldsAreConst;
8945
8946 SpecialMemberDeletionInfo(Sema &S, CXXMethodDecl *MD,
8947 Sema::CXXSpecialMember CSM,
8948 Sema::InheritedConstructorInfo *ICI, bool Diagnose)
8949 : SpecialMemberVisitor(S, MD, CSM, ICI), Diagnose(Diagnose),
8950 Loc(MD->getLocation()), AllFieldsAreConst(true) {}
8951
8952 bool inUnion() const { return MD->getParent()->isUnion(); }
8953
8954 Sema::CXXSpecialMember getEffectiveCSM() {
8955 return ICI ? Sema::CXXInvalid : CSM;
8956 }
8957
8958 bool shouldDeleteForVariantObjCPtrMember(FieldDecl *FD, QualType FieldType);
8959
8960 bool visitBase(CXXBaseSpecifier *Base) { return shouldDeleteForBase(Base); }
8961 bool visitField(FieldDecl *Field) { return shouldDeleteForField(Field); }
8962
8963 bool shouldDeleteForBase(CXXBaseSpecifier *Base);
8964 bool shouldDeleteForField(FieldDecl *FD);
8965 bool shouldDeleteForAllConstMembers();
8966
8967 bool shouldDeleteForClassSubobject(CXXRecordDecl *Class, Subobject Subobj,
8968 unsigned Quals);
8969 bool shouldDeleteForSubobjectCall(Subobject Subobj,
8970 Sema::SpecialMemberOverloadResult SMOR,
8971 bool IsDtorCallInCtor);
8972
8973 bool isAccessible(Subobject Subobj, CXXMethodDecl *D);
8974};
8975}
8976
8977/// Is the given special member inaccessible when used on the given
8978/// sub-object.
8979bool SpecialMemberDeletionInfo::isAccessible(Subobject Subobj,
8980 CXXMethodDecl *target) {
8981 /// If we're operating on a base class, the object type is the
8982 /// type of this special member.
8983 QualType objectTy;
8984 AccessSpecifier access = target->getAccess();
8985 if (CXXBaseSpecifier *base = Subobj.dyn_cast<CXXBaseSpecifier*>()) {
8986 objectTy = S.Context.getTypeDeclType(MD->getParent());
8987 access = CXXRecordDecl::MergeAccess(base->getAccessSpecifier(), access);
8988
8989 // If we're operating on a field, the object type is the type of the field.
8990 } else {
8991 objectTy = S.Context.getTypeDeclType(target->getParent());
8992 }
8993
8994 return S.isMemberAccessibleForDeletion(
8995 target->getParent(), DeclAccessPair::make(target, access), objectTy);
8996}
8997
8998/// Check whether we should delete a special member due to the implicit
8999/// definition containing a call to a special member of a subobject.
9000bool SpecialMemberDeletionInfo::shouldDeleteForSubobjectCall(
9001 Subobject Subobj, Sema::SpecialMemberOverloadResult SMOR,
9002 bool IsDtorCallInCtor) {
9003 CXXMethodDecl *Decl = SMOR.getMethod();
9004 FieldDecl *Field = Subobj.dyn_cast<FieldDecl*>();
9005
9006 int DiagKind = -1;
9007
9008 if (SMOR.getKind() == Sema::SpecialMemberOverloadResult::NoMemberOrDeleted)
9009 DiagKind = !Decl ? 0 : 1;
9010 else if (SMOR.getKind() == Sema::SpecialMemberOverloadResult::Ambiguous)
9011 DiagKind = 2;
9012 else if (!isAccessible(Subobj, Decl))
9013 DiagKind = 3;
9014 else if (!IsDtorCallInCtor && Field && Field->getParent()->isUnion() &&
9015 !Decl->isTrivial()) {
9016 // A member of a union must have a trivial corresponding special member.
9017 // As a weird special case, a destructor call from a union's constructor
9018 // must be accessible and non-deleted, but need not be trivial. Such a
9019 // destructor is never actually called, but is semantically checked as
9020 // if it were.
9021 DiagKind = 4;
9022 }
9023
9024 if (DiagKind == -1)
9025 return false;
9026
9027 if (Diagnose) {
9028 if (Field) {
9029 S.Diag(Field->getLocation(),
9030 diag::note_deleted_special_member_class_subobject)
9031 << getEffectiveCSM() << MD->getParent() << /*IsField*/true
9032 << Field << DiagKind << IsDtorCallInCtor << /*IsObjCPtr*/false;
9033 } else {
9034 CXXBaseSpecifier *Base = Subobj.get<CXXBaseSpecifier*>();
9035 S.Diag(Base->getBeginLoc(),
9036 diag::note_deleted_special_member_class_subobject)
9037 << getEffectiveCSM() << MD->getParent() << /*IsField*/ false
9038 << Base->getType() << DiagKind << IsDtorCallInCtor
9039 << /*IsObjCPtr*/false;
9040 }
9041
9042 if (DiagKind == 1)
9043 S.NoteDeletedFunction(Decl);
9044 // FIXME: Explain inaccessibility if DiagKind == 3.
9045 }
9046
9047 return true;
9048}
9049
9050/// Check whether we should delete a special member function due to having a
9051/// direct or virtual base class or non-static data member of class type M.
9052bool SpecialMemberDeletionInfo::shouldDeleteForClassSubobject(
9053 CXXRecordDecl *Class, Subobject Subobj, unsigned Quals) {
9054 FieldDecl *Field = Subobj.dyn_cast<FieldDecl*>();
9055 bool IsMutable = Field && Field->isMutable();
9056
9057 // C++11 [class.ctor]p5:
9058 // -- any direct or virtual base class, or non-static data member with no
9059 // brace-or-equal-initializer, has class type M (or array thereof) and
9060 // either M has no default constructor or overload resolution as applied
9061 // to M's default constructor results in an ambiguity or in a function
9062 // that is deleted or inaccessible
9063 // C++11 [class.copy]p11, C++11 [class.copy]p23:
9064 // -- a direct or virtual base class B that cannot be copied/moved because
9065 // overload resolution, as applied to B's corresponding special member,
9066 // results in an ambiguity or a function that is deleted or inaccessible
9067 // from the defaulted special member
9068 // C++11 [class.dtor]p5:
9069 // -- any direct or virtual base class [...] has a type with a destructor
9070 // that is deleted or inaccessible
9071 if (!(CSM == Sema::CXXDefaultConstructor &&
9072 Field && Field->hasInClassInitializer()) &&
9073 shouldDeleteForSubobjectCall(Subobj, lookupIn(Class, Quals, IsMutable),
9074 false))
9075 return true;
9076
9077 // C++11 [class.ctor]p5, C++11 [class.copy]p11:
9078 // -- any direct or virtual base class or non-static data member has a
9079 // type with a destructor that is deleted or inaccessible
9080 if (IsConstructor) {
9081 Sema::SpecialMemberOverloadResult SMOR =
9082 S.LookupSpecialMember(Class, Sema::CXXDestructor,
9083 false, false, false, false, false);
9084 if (shouldDeleteForSubobjectCall(Subobj, SMOR, true))
9085 return true;
9086 }
9087
9088 return false;
9089}
9090
9091bool SpecialMemberDeletionInfo::shouldDeleteForVariantObjCPtrMember(
9092 FieldDecl *FD, QualType FieldType) {
9093 // The defaulted special functions are defined as deleted if this is a variant
9094 // member with a non-trivial ownership type, e.g., ObjC __strong or __weak
9095 // type under ARC.
9096 if (!FieldType.hasNonTrivialObjCLifetime())
9097 return false;
9098
9099 // Don't make the defaulted default constructor defined as deleted if the
9100 // member has an in-class initializer.
9101 if (CSM == Sema::CXXDefaultConstructor && FD->hasInClassInitializer())
9102 return false;
9103
9104 if (Diagnose) {
9105 auto *ParentClass = cast<CXXRecordDecl>(FD->getParent());
9106 S.Diag(FD->getLocation(),
9107 diag::note_deleted_special_member_class_subobject)
9108 << getEffectiveCSM() << ParentClass << /*IsField*/true
9109 << FD << 4 << /*IsDtorCallInCtor*/false << /*IsObjCPtr*/true;
9110 }
9111
9112 return true;
9113}
9114
9115/// Check whether we should delete a special member function due to the class
9116/// having a particular direct or virtual base class.
9117bool SpecialMemberDeletionInfo::shouldDeleteForBase(CXXBaseSpecifier *Base) {
9118 CXXRecordDecl *BaseClass = Base->getType()->getAsCXXRecordDecl();
9119 // If program is correct, BaseClass cannot be null, but if it is, the error
9120 // must be reported elsewhere.
9121 if (!BaseClass)
9122 return false;
9123 // If we have an inheriting constructor, check whether we're calling an
9124 // inherited constructor instead of a default constructor.
9125 Sema::SpecialMemberOverloadResult SMOR = lookupInheritedCtor(BaseClass);
9126 if (auto *BaseCtor = SMOR.getMethod()) {
9127 // Note that we do not check access along this path; other than that,
9128 // this is the same as shouldDeleteForSubobjectCall(Base, BaseCtor, false);
9129 // FIXME: Check that the base has a usable destructor! Sink this into
9130 // shouldDeleteForClassSubobject.
9131 if (BaseCtor->isDeleted() && Diagnose) {
9132 S.Diag(Base->getBeginLoc(),
9133 diag::note_deleted_special_member_class_subobject)
9134 << getEffectiveCSM() << MD->getParent() << /*IsField*/ false
9135 << Base->getType() << /*Deleted*/ 1 << /*IsDtorCallInCtor*/ false
9136 << /*IsObjCPtr*/false;
9137 S.NoteDeletedFunction(BaseCtor);
9138 }
9139 return BaseCtor->isDeleted();
9140 }
9141 return shouldDeleteForClassSubobject(BaseClass, Base, 0);
9142}
9143
9144/// Check whether we should delete a special member function due to the class
9145/// having a particular non-static data member.
9146bool SpecialMemberDeletionInfo::shouldDeleteForField(FieldDecl *FD) {
9147 QualType FieldType = S.Context.getBaseElementType(FD->getType());
9148 CXXRecordDecl *FieldRecord = FieldType->getAsCXXRecordDecl();
9149
9150 if (inUnion() && shouldDeleteForVariantObjCPtrMember(FD, FieldType))
9151 return true;
9152
9153 if (CSM == Sema::CXXDefaultConstructor) {
9154 // For a default constructor, all references must be initialized in-class
9155 // and, if a union, it must have a non-const member.
9156 if (FieldType->isReferenceType() && !FD->hasInClassInitializer()) {
9157 if (Diagnose)
9158 S.Diag(FD->getLocation(), diag::note_deleted_default_ctor_uninit_field)
9159 << !!ICI << MD->getParent() << FD << FieldType << /*Reference*/0;
9160 return true;
9161 }
9162 // C++11 [class.ctor]p5: any non-variant non-static data member of
9163 // const-qualified type (or array thereof) with no
9164 // brace-or-equal-initializer does not have a user-provided default
9165 // constructor.
9166 if (!inUnion() && FieldType.isConstQualified() &&
9167 !FD->hasInClassInitializer() &&
9168 (!FieldRecord || !FieldRecord->hasUserProvidedDefaultConstructor())) {
9169 if (Diagnose)
9170 S.Diag(FD->getLocation(), diag::note_deleted_default_ctor_uninit_field)
9171 << !!ICI << MD->getParent() << FD << FD->getType() << /*Const*/1;
9172 return true;
9173 }
9174
9175 if (inUnion() && !FieldType.isConstQualified())
9176 AllFieldsAreConst = false;
9177 } else if (CSM == Sema::CXXCopyConstructor) {
9178 // For a copy constructor, data members must not be of rvalue reference
9179 // type.
9180 if (FieldType->isRValueReferenceType()) {
9181 if (Diagnose)
9182 S.Diag(FD->getLocation(), diag::note_deleted_copy_ctor_rvalue_reference)
9183 << MD->getParent() << FD << FieldType;
9184 return true;
9185 }
9186 } else if (IsAssignment) {
9187 // For an assignment operator, data members must not be of reference type.
9188 if (FieldType->isReferenceType()) {
9189 if (Diagnose)
9190 S.Diag(FD->getLocation(), diag::note_deleted_assign_field)
9191 << isMove() << MD->getParent() << FD << FieldType << /*Reference*/0;
9192 return true;
9193 }
9194 if (!FieldRecord && FieldType.isConstQualified()) {
9195 // C++11 [class.copy]p23:
9196 // -- a non-static data member of const non-class type (or array thereof)
9197 if (Diagnose)
9198 S.Diag(FD->getLocation(), diag::note_deleted_assign_field)
9199 << isMove() << MD->getParent() << FD << FD->getType() << /*Const*/1;
9200 return true;
9201 }
9202 }
9203
9204 if (FieldRecord) {
9205 // Some additional restrictions exist on the variant members.
9206 if (!inUnion() && FieldRecord->isUnion() &&
9207 FieldRecord->isAnonymousStructOrUnion()) {
9208 bool AllVariantFieldsAreConst = true;
9209
9210 // FIXME: Handle anonymous unions declared within anonymous unions.
9211 for (auto *UI : FieldRecord->fields()) {
9212 QualType UnionFieldType = S.Context.getBaseElementType(UI->getType());
9213
9214 if (shouldDeleteForVariantObjCPtrMember(&*UI, UnionFieldType))
9215 return true;
9216
9217 if (!UnionFieldType.isConstQualified())
9218 AllVariantFieldsAreConst = false;
9219
9220 CXXRecordDecl *UnionFieldRecord = UnionFieldType->getAsCXXRecordDecl();
9221 if (UnionFieldRecord &&
9222 shouldDeleteForClassSubobject(UnionFieldRecord, UI,
9223 UnionFieldType.getCVRQualifiers()))
9224 return true;
9225 }
9226
9227 // At least one member in each anonymous union must be non-const
9228 if (CSM == Sema::CXXDefaultConstructor && AllVariantFieldsAreConst &&
9229 !FieldRecord->field_empty()) {
9230 if (Diagnose)
9231 S.Diag(FieldRecord->getLocation(),
9232 diag::note_deleted_default_ctor_all_const)
9233 << !!ICI << MD->getParent() << /*anonymous union*/1;
9234 return true;
9235 }
9236
9237 // Don't check the implicit member of the anonymous union type.
9238 // This is technically non-conformant but supported, and we have a
9239 // diagnostic for this elsewhere.
9240 return false;
9241 }
9242
9243 if (shouldDeleteForClassSubobject(FieldRecord, FD,
9244 FieldType.getCVRQualifiers()))
9245 return true;
9246 }
9247
9248 return false;
9249}
9250
9251/// C++11 [class.ctor] p5:
9252/// A defaulted default constructor for a class X is defined as deleted if
9253/// X is a union and all of its variant members are of const-qualified type.
9254bool SpecialMemberDeletionInfo::shouldDeleteForAllConstMembers() {
9255 // This is a silly definition, because it gives an empty union a deleted
9256 // default constructor. Don't do that.
9257 if (CSM == Sema::CXXDefaultConstructor && inUnion() && AllFieldsAreConst) {
9258 bool AnyFields = false;
9259 for (auto *F : MD->getParent()->fields())
9260 if ((AnyFields = !F->isUnnamedBitfield()))
9261 break;
9262 if (!AnyFields)
9263 return false;
9264 if (Diagnose)
9265 S.Diag(MD->getParent()->getLocation(),
9266 diag::note_deleted_default_ctor_all_const)
9267 << !!ICI << MD->getParent() << /*not anonymous union*/0;
9268 return true;
9269 }
9270 return false;
9271}
9272
9273/// Determine whether a defaulted special member function should be defined as
9274/// deleted, as specified in C++11 [class.ctor]p5, C++11 [class.copy]p11,
9275/// C++11 [class.copy]p23, and C++11 [class.dtor]p5.
9276bool Sema::ShouldDeleteSpecialMember(CXXMethodDecl *MD, CXXSpecialMember CSM,
9277 InheritedConstructorInfo *ICI,
9278 bool Diagnose) {
9279 if (MD->isInvalidDecl())
9280 return false;
9281 CXXRecordDecl *RD = MD->getParent();
9282 assert(!RD->isDependentType() && "do deletion after instantiation");
9283 if (!LangOpts.CPlusPlus11 || RD->isInvalidDecl())
9284 return false;
9285
9286 // C++11 [expr.lambda.prim]p19:
9287 // The closure type associated with a lambda-expression has a
9288 // deleted (8.4.3) default constructor and a deleted copy
9289 // assignment operator.
9290 // C++2a adds back these operators if the lambda has no lambda-capture.
9291 if (RD->isLambda() && !RD->lambdaIsDefaultConstructibleAndAssignable() &&
9292 (CSM == CXXDefaultConstructor || CSM == CXXCopyAssignment)) {
9293 if (Diagnose)
9294 Diag(RD->getLocation(), diag::note_lambda_decl);
9295 return true;
9296 }
9297
9298 // For an anonymous struct or union, the copy and assignment special members
9299 // will never be used, so skip the check. For an anonymous union declared at
9300 // namespace scope, the constructor and destructor are used.
9301 if (CSM != CXXDefaultConstructor && CSM != CXXDestructor &&
9302 RD->isAnonymousStructOrUnion())
9303 return false;
9304
9305 // C++11 [class.copy]p7, p18:
9306 // If the class definition declares a move constructor or move assignment
9307 // operator, an implicitly declared copy constructor or copy assignment
9308 // operator is defined as deleted.
9309 if (MD->isImplicit() &&
9310 (CSM == CXXCopyConstructor || CSM == CXXCopyAssignment)) {
9311 CXXMethodDecl *UserDeclaredMove = nullptr;
9312
9313 // In Microsoft mode up to MSVC 2013, a user-declared move only causes the
9314 // deletion of the corresponding copy operation, not both copy operations.
9315 // MSVC 2015 has adopted the standards conforming behavior.
9316 bool DeletesOnlyMatchingCopy =
9317 getLangOpts().MSVCCompat &&
9318 !getLangOpts().isCompatibleWithMSVC(LangOptions::MSVC2015);
9319
9320 if (RD->hasUserDeclaredMoveConstructor() &&
9321 (!DeletesOnlyMatchingCopy || CSM == CXXCopyConstructor)) {
9322 if (!Diagnose) return true;
9323
9324 // Find any user-declared move constructor.
9325 for (auto *I : RD->ctors()) {
9326 if (I->isMoveConstructor()) {
9327 UserDeclaredMove = I;
9328 break;
9329 }
9330 }
9331 assert(UserDeclaredMove);
9332 } else if (RD->hasUserDeclaredMoveAssignment() &&
9333 (!DeletesOnlyMatchingCopy || CSM == CXXCopyAssignment)) {
9334 if (!Diagnose) return true;
9335
9336 // Find any user-declared move assignment operator.
9337 for (auto *I : RD->methods()) {
9338 if (I->isMoveAssignmentOperator()) {
9339 UserDeclaredMove = I;
9340 break;
9341 }
9342 }
9343 assert(UserDeclaredMove);
9344 }
9345
9346 if (UserDeclaredMove) {
9347 Diag(UserDeclaredMove->getLocation(),
9348 diag::note_deleted_copy_user_declared_move)
9349 << (CSM == CXXCopyAssignment) << RD
9350 << UserDeclaredMove->isMoveAssignmentOperator();
9351 return true;
9352 }
9353 }
9354
9355 // Do access control from the special member function
9356 ContextRAII MethodContext(*this, MD);
9357
9358 // C++11 [class.dtor]p5:
9359 // -- for a virtual destructor, lookup of the non-array deallocation function
9360 // results in an ambiguity or in a function that is deleted or inaccessible
9361 if (CSM == CXXDestructor && MD->isVirtual()) {
9362 FunctionDecl *OperatorDelete = nullptr;
9363 DeclarationName Name =
9364 Context.DeclarationNames.getCXXOperatorName(OO_Delete);
9365 if (FindDeallocationFunction(MD->getLocation(), MD->getParent(), Name,
9366 OperatorDelete, /*Diagnose*/false)) {
9367 if (Diagnose)
9368 Diag(RD->getLocation(), diag::note_deleted_dtor_no_operator_delete);
9369 return true;
9370 }
9371 }
9372
9373 SpecialMemberDeletionInfo SMI(*this, MD, CSM, ICI, Diagnose);
9374
9375 // Per DR1611, do not consider virtual bases of constructors of abstract
9376 // classes, since we are not going to construct them.
9377 // Per DR1658, do not consider virtual bases of destructors of abstract
9378 // classes either.
9379 // Per DR2180, for assignment operators we only assign (and thus only
9380 // consider) direct bases.
9381 if (SMI.visit(SMI.IsAssignment ? SMI.VisitDirectBases
9382 : SMI.VisitPotentiallyConstructedBases))
9383 return true;
9384
9385 if (SMI.shouldDeleteForAllConstMembers())
9386 return true;
9387
9388 if (getLangOpts().CUDA) {
9389 // We should delete the special member in CUDA mode if target inference
9390 // failed.
9391 // For inherited constructors (non-null ICI), CSM may be passed so that MD
9392 // is treated as certain special member, which may not reflect what special
9393 // member MD really is. However inferCUDATargetForImplicitSpecialMember
9394 // expects CSM to match MD, therefore recalculate CSM.
9395 assert(ICI || CSM == getSpecialMember(MD));
9396 auto RealCSM = CSM;
9397 if (ICI)
9398 RealCSM = getSpecialMember(MD);
9399
9400 return inferCUDATargetForImplicitSpecialMember(RD, RealCSM, MD,
9401 SMI.ConstArg, Diagnose);
9402 }
9403
9404 return false;
9405}
9406
9407void Sema::DiagnoseDeletedDefaultedFunction(FunctionDecl *FD) {
9408 DefaultedFunctionKind DFK = getDefaultedFunctionKind(FD);
9409 assert(DFK && "not a defaultable function");
9410 assert(FD->isDefaulted() && FD->isDeleted() && "not defaulted and deleted");
9411
9412 if (DFK.isSpecialMember()) {
9413 ShouldDeleteSpecialMember(cast<CXXMethodDecl>(FD), DFK.asSpecialMember(),
9414 nullptr, /*Diagnose=*/true);
9415 } else {
9416 DefaultedComparisonAnalyzer(
9417 *this, cast<CXXRecordDecl>(FD->getLexicalDeclContext()), FD,
9418 DFK.asComparison(), DefaultedComparisonAnalyzer::ExplainDeleted)
9419 .visit();
9420 }
9421}
9422
9423/// Perform lookup for a special member of the specified kind, and determine
9424/// whether it is trivial. If the triviality can be determined without the
9425/// lookup, skip it. This is intended for use when determining whether a
9426/// special member of a containing object is trivial, and thus does not ever
9427/// perform overload resolution for default constructors.
9428///
9429/// If \p Selected is not \c NULL, \c *Selected will be filled in with the
9430/// member that was most likely to be intended to be trivial, if any.
9431///
9432/// If \p ForCall is true, look at CXXRecord::HasTrivialSpecialMembersForCall to
9433/// determine whether the special member is trivial.
9434static bool findTrivialSpecialMember(Sema &S, CXXRecordDecl *RD,
9435 Sema::CXXSpecialMember CSM, unsigned Quals,
9436 bool ConstRHS,
9437 Sema::TrivialABIHandling TAH,
9438 CXXMethodDecl **Selected) {
9439 if (Selected)
9440 *Selected = nullptr;
9441
9442 switch (CSM) {
9443 case Sema::CXXInvalid:
9444 llvm_unreachable("not a special member");
9445
9446 case Sema::CXXDefaultConstructor:
9447 // C++11 [class.ctor]p5:
9448 // A default constructor is trivial if:
9449 // - all the [direct subobjects] have trivial default constructors
9450 //
9451 // Note, no overload resolution is performed in this case.
9452 if (RD->hasTrivialDefaultConstructor())
9453 return true;
9454
9455 if (Selected) {
9456 // If there's a default constructor which could have been trivial, dig it
9457 // out. Otherwise, if there's any user-provided default constructor, point
9458 // to that as an example of why there's not a trivial one.
9459 CXXConstructorDecl *DefCtor = nullptr;
9460 if (RD->needsImplicitDefaultConstructor())
9461 S.DeclareImplicitDefaultConstructor(RD);
9462 for (auto *CI : RD->ctors()) {
9463 if (!CI->isDefaultConstructor())
9464 continue;
9465 DefCtor = CI;
9466 if (!DefCtor->isUserProvided())
9467 break;
9468 }
9469
9470 *Selected = DefCtor;
9471 }
9472
9473 return false;
9474
9475 case Sema::CXXDestructor:
9476 // C++11 [class.dtor]p5:
9477 // A destructor is trivial if:
9478 // - all the direct [subobjects] have trivial destructors
9479 if (RD->hasTrivialDestructor() ||
9480 (TAH == Sema::TAH_ConsiderTrivialABI &&
9481 RD->hasTrivialDestructorForCall()))
9482 return true;
9483
9484 if (Selected) {
9485 if (RD->needsImplicitDestructor())
9486 S.DeclareImplicitDestructor(RD);
9487 *Selected = RD->getDestructor();
9488 }
9489
9490 return false;
9491
9492 case Sema::CXXCopyConstructor:
9493 // C++11 [class.copy]p12:
9494 // A copy constructor is trivial if:
9495 // - the constructor selected to copy each direct [subobject] is trivial
9496 if (RD->hasTrivialCopyConstructor() ||
9497 (TAH == Sema::TAH_ConsiderTrivialABI &&
9498 RD->hasTrivialCopyConstructorForCall())) {
9499 if (Quals == Qualifiers::Const)
9500 // We must either select the trivial copy constructor or reach an
9501 // ambiguity; no need to actually perform overload resolution.
9502 return true;
9503 } else if (!Selected) {
9504 return false;
9505 }
9506 // In C++98, we are not supposed to perform overload resolution here, but we
9507 // treat that as a language defect, as suggested on cxx-abi-dev, to treat
9508 // cases like B as having a non-trivial copy constructor:
9509 // struct A { template<typename T> A(T&); };
9510 // struct B { mutable A a; };
9511 goto NeedOverloadResolution;
9512
9513 case Sema::CXXCopyAssignment:
9514 // C++11 [class.copy]p25:
9515 // A copy assignment operator is trivial if:
9516 // - the assignment operator selected to copy each direct [subobject] is
9517 // trivial
9518 if (RD->hasTrivialCopyAssignment()) {
9519 if (Quals == Qualifiers::Const)
9520 return true;
9521 } else if (!Selected) {
9522 return false;
9523 }
9524 // In C++98, we are not supposed to perform overload resolution here, but we
9525 // treat that as a language defect.
9526 goto NeedOverloadResolution;
9527
9528 case Sema::CXXMoveConstructor:
9529 case Sema::CXXMoveAssignment:
9530 NeedOverloadResolution:
9531 Sema::SpecialMemberOverloadResult SMOR =
9532 lookupCallFromSpecialMember(S, RD, CSM, Quals, ConstRHS);
9533
9534 // The standard doesn't describe how to behave if the lookup is ambiguous.
9535 // We treat it as not making the member non-trivial, just like the standard
9536 // mandates for the default constructor. This should rarely matter, because
9537 // the member will also be deleted.
9538 if (SMOR.getKind() == Sema::SpecialMemberOverloadResult::Ambiguous)
9539 return true;
9540
9541 if (!SMOR.getMethod()) {
9542 assert(SMOR.getKind() ==
9543 Sema::SpecialMemberOverloadResult::NoMemberOrDeleted);
9544 return false;
9545 }
9546
9547 // We deliberately don't check if we found a deleted special member. We're
9548 // not supposed to!
9549 if (Selected)
9550 *Selected = SMOR.getMethod();
9551
9552 if (TAH == Sema::TAH_ConsiderTrivialABI &&
9553 (CSM == Sema::CXXCopyConstructor || CSM == Sema::CXXMoveConstructor))
9554 return SMOR.getMethod()->isTrivialForCall();
9555 return SMOR.getMethod()->isTrivial();
9556 }
9557
9558 llvm_unreachable("unknown special method kind");
9559}
9560
9561static CXXConstructorDecl *findUserDeclaredCtor(CXXRecordDecl *RD) {
9562 for (auto *CI : RD->ctors())
9563 if (!CI->isImplicit())
9564 return CI;
9565
9566 // Look for constructor templates.
9567 typedef CXXRecordDecl::specific_decl_iterator<FunctionTemplateDecl> tmpl_iter;
9568 for (tmpl_iter TI(RD->decls_begin()), TE(RD->decls_end()); TI != TE; ++TI) {
9569 if (CXXConstructorDecl *CD =
9570 dyn_cast<CXXConstructorDecl>(TI->getTemplatedDecl()))
9571 return CD;
9572 }
9573
9574 return nullptr;
9575}
9576
9577/// The kind of subobject we are checking for triviality. The values of this
9578/// enumeration are used in diagnostics.
9579enum TrivialSubobjectKind {
9580 /// The subobject is a base class.
9581 TSK_BaseClass,
9582 /// The subobject is a non-static data member.
9583 TSK_Field,
9584 /// The object is actually the complete object.
9585 TSK_CompleteObject
9586};
9587
9588/// Check whether the special member selected for a given type would be trivial.
9589static bool checkTrivialSubobjectCall(Sema &S, SourceLocation SubobjLoc,
9590 QualType SubType, bool ConstRHS,
9591 Sema::CXXSpecialMember CSM,
9592 TrivialSubobjectKind Kind,
9593 Sema::TrivialABIHandling TAH, bool Diagnose) {
9594 CXXRecordDecl *SubRD = SubType->getAsCXXRecordDecl();
9595 if (!SubRD)
9596 return true;
9597
9598 CXXMethodDecl *Selected;
9599 if (findTrivialSpecialMember(S, SubRD, CSM, SubType.getCVRQualifiers(),
9600 ConstRHS, TAH, Diagnose ? &Selected : nullptr))
9601 return true;
9602
9603 if (Diagnose) {
9604 if (ConstRHS)
9605 SubType.addConst();
9606
9607 if (!Selected && CSM == Sema::CXXDefaultConstructor) {
9608 S.Diag(SubobjLoc, diag::note_nontrivial_no_def_ctor)
9609 << Kind << SubType.getUnqualifiedType();
9610 if (CXXConstructorDecl *CD = findUserDeclaredCtor(SubRD))
9611 S.Diag(CD->getLocation(), diag::note_user_declared_ctor);
9612 } else if (!Selected)
9613 S.Diag(SubobjLoc, diag::note_nontrivial_no_copy)
9614 << Kind << SubType.getUnqualifiedType() << CSM << SubType;
9615 else if (Selected->isUserProvided()) {
9616 if (Kind == TSK_CompleteObject)
9617 S.Diag(Selected->getLocation(), diag::note_nontrivial_user_provided)
9618 << Kind << SubType.getUnqualifiedType() << CSM;
9619 else {
9620 S.Diag(SubobjLoc, diag::note_nontrivial_user_provided)
9621 << Kind << SubType.getUnqualifiedType() << CSM;
9622 S.Diag(Selected->getLocation(), diag::note_declared_at);
9623 }
9624 } else {
9625 if (Kind != TSK_CompleteObject)
9626 S.Diag(SubobjLoc, diag::note_nontrivial_subobject)
9627 << Kind << SubType.getUnqualifiedType() << CSM;
9628
9629 // Explain why the defaulted or deleted special member isn't trivial.
9630 S.SpecialMemberIsTrivial(Selected, CSM, Sema::TAH_IgnoreTrivialABI,
9631 Diagnose);
9632 }
9633 }
9634
9635 return false;
9636}
9637
9638/// Check whether the members of a class type allow a special member to be
9639/// trivial.
9640static bool checkTrivialClassMembers(Sema &S, CXXRecordDecl *RD,
9641 Sema::CXXSpecialMember CSM,
9642 bool ConstArg,
9643 Sema::TrivialABIHandling TAH,
9644 bool Diagnose) {
9645 for (const auto *FI : RD->fields()) {
9646 if (FI->isInvalidDecl() || FI->isUnnamedBitfield())
9647 continue;
9648
9649 QualType FieldType = S.Context.getBaseElementType(FI->getType());
9650
9651 // Pretend anonymous struct or union members are members of this class.
9652 if (FI->isAnonymousStructOrUnion()) {
9653 if (!checkTrivialClassMembers(S, FieldType->getAsCXXRecordDecl(),
9654 CSM, ConstArg, TAH, Diagnose))
9655 return false;
9656 continue;
9657 }
9658
9659 // C++11 [class.ctor]p5:
9660 // A default constructor is trivial if [...]
9661 // -- no non-static data member of its class has a
9662 // brace-or-equal-initializer
9663 if (CSM == Sema::CXXDefaultConstructor && FI->hasInClassInitializer()) {
9664 if (Diagnose)
9665 S.Diag(FI->getLocation(), diag::note_nontrivial_default_member_init)
9666 << FI;
9667 return false;
9668 }
9669
9670 // Objective C ARC 4.3.5:
9671 // [...] nontrivally ownership-qualified types are [...] not trivially
9672 // default constructible, copy constructible, move constructible, copy
9673 // assignable, move assignable, or destructible [...]
9674 if (FieldType.hasNonTrivialObjCLifetime()) {
9675 if (Diagnose)
9676 S.Diag(FI->getLocation(), diag::note_nontrivial_objc_ownership)
9677 << RD << FieldType.getObjCLifetime();
9678 return false;
9679 }
9680
9681 bool ConstRHS = ConstArg && !FI->isMutable();
9682 if (!checkTrivialSubobjectCall(S, FI->getLocation(), FieldType, ConstRHS,
9683 CSM, TSK_Field, TAH, Diagnose))
9684 return false;
9685 }
9686
9687 return true;
9688}
9689
9690/// Diagnose why the specified class does not have a trivial special member of
9691/// the given kind.
9692void Sema::DiagnoseNontrivial(const CXXRecordDecl *RD, CXXSpecialMember CSM) {
9693 QualType Ty = Context.getRecordType(RD);
9694
9695 bool ConstArg = (CSM == CXXCopyConstructor || CSM == CXXCopyAssignment);
9696 checkTrivialSubobjectCall(*this, RD->getLocation(), Ty, ConstArg, CSM,
9697 TSK_CompleteObject, TAH_IgnoreTrivialABI,
9698 /*Diagnose*/true);
9699}
9700
9701/// Determine whether a defaulted or deleted special member function is trivial,
9702/// as specified in C++11 [class.ctor]p5, C++11 [class.copy]p12,
9703/// C++11 [class.copy]p25, and C++11 [class.dtor]p5.
9704bool Sema::SpecialMemberIsTrivial(CXXMethodDecl *MD, CXXSpecialMember CSM,
9705 TrivialABIHandling TAH, bool Diagnose) {
9706 assert(!MD->isUserProvided() && CSM != CXXInvalid && "not special enough");
9707
9708 CXXRecordDecl *RD = MD->getParent();
9709
9710 bool ConstArg = false;
9711
9712 // C++11 [class.copy]p12, p25: [DR1593]
9713 // A [special member] is trivial if [...] its parameter-type-list is
9714 // equivalent to the parameter-type-list of an implicit declaration [...]
9715 switch (CSM) {
9716 case CXXDefaultConstructor:
9717 case CXXDestructor:
9718 // Trivial default constructors and destructors cannot have parameters.
9719 break;
9720
9721 case CXXCopyConstructor:
9722 case CXXCopyAssignment: {
9723 // Trivial copy operations always have const, non-volatile parameter types.
9724 ConstArg = true;
9725 const ParmVarDecl *Param0 = MD->getParamDecl(0);
9726 const ReferenceType *RT = Param0->getType()->getAs<ReferenceType>();
9727 if (!RT || RT->getPointeeType().getCVRQualifiers() != Qualifiers::Const) {
9728 if (Diagnose)
9729 Diag(Param0->getLocation(), diag::note_nontrivial_param_type)
9730 << Param0->getSourceRange() << Param0->getType()
9731 << Context.getLValueReferenceType(
9732 Context.getRecordType(RD).withConst());
9733 return false;
9734 }
9735 break;
9736 }
9737
9738 case CXXMoveConstructor:
9739 case CXXMoveAssignment: {
9740 // Trivial move operations always have non-cv-qualified parameters.
9741 const ParmVarDecl *Param0 = MD->getParamDecl(0);
9742 const RValueReferenceType *RT =
9743 Param0->getType()->getAs<RValueReferenceType>();
9744 if (!RT || RT->getPointeeType().getCVRQualifiers()) {
9745 if (Diagnose)
9746 Diag(Param0->getLocation(), diag::note_nontrivial_param_type)
9747 << Param0->getSourceRange() << Param0->getType()
9748 << Context.getRValueReferenceType(Context.getRecordType(RD));
9749 return false;
9750 }
9751 break;
9752 }
9753
9754 case CXXInvalid:
9755 llvm_unreachable("not a special member");
9756 }
9757
9758 if (MD->getMinRequiredArguments() < MD->getNumParams()) {
9759 if (Diagnose)
9760 Diag(MD->getParamDecl(MD->getMinRequiredArguments())->getLocation(),
9761 diag::note_nontrivial_default_arg)
9762 << MD->getParamDecl(MD->getMinRequiredArguments())->getSourceRange();
9763 return false;
9764 }
9765 if (MD->isVariadic()) {
9766 if (Diagnose)
9767 Diag(MD->getLocation(), diag::note_nontrivial_variadic);
9768 return false;
9769 }
9770
9771 // C++11 [class.ctor]p5, C++11 [class.dtor]p5:
9772 // A copy/move [constructor or assignment operator] is trivial if
9773 // -- the [member] selected to copy/move each direct base class subobject
9774 // is trivial
9775 //
9776 // C++11 [class.copy]p12, C++11 [class.copy]p25:
9777 // A [default constructor or destructor] is trivial if
9778 // -- all the direct base classes have trivial [default constructors or
9779 // destructors]
9780 for (const auto &BI : RD->bases())
9781 if (!checkTrivialSubobjectCall(*this, BI.getBeginLoc(), BI.getType(),
9782 ConstArg, CSM, TSK_BaseClass, TAH, Diagnose))
9783 return false;
9784
9785 // C++11 [class.ctor]p5, C++11 [class.dtor]p5:
9786 // A copy/move [constructor or assignment operator] for a class X is
9787 // trivial if
9788 // -- for each non-static data member of X that is of class type (or array
9789 // thereof), the constructor selected to copy/move that member is
9790 // trivial
9791 //
9792 // C++11 [class.copy]p12, C++11 [class.copy]p25:
9793 // A [default constructor or destructor] is trivial if
9794 // -- for all of the non-static data members of its class that are of class
9795 // type (or array thereof), each such class has a trivial [default
9796 // constructor or destructor]
9797 if (!checkTrivialClassMembers(*this, RD, CSM, ConstArg, TAH, Diagnose))
9798 return false;
9799
9800 // C++11 [class.dtor]p5:
9801 // A destructor is trivial if [...]
9802 // -- the destructor is not virtual
9803 if (CSM == CXXDestructor && MD->isVirtual()) {
9804 if (Diagnose)
9805 Diag(MD->getLocation(), diag::note_nontrivial_virtual_dtor) << RD;
9806 return false;
9807 }
9808
9809 // C++11 [class.ctor]p5, C++11 [class.copy]p12, C++11 [class.copy]p25:
9810 // A [special member] for class X is trivial if [...]
9811 // -- class X has no virtual functions and no virtual base classes
9812 if (CSM != CXXDestructor && MD->getParent()->isDynamicClass()) {
9813 if (!Diagnose)
9814 return false;
9815
9816 if (RD->getNumVBases()) {
9817 // Check for virtual bases. We already know that the corresponding
9818 // member in all bases is trivial, so vbases must all be direct.
9819 CXXBaseSpecifier &BS = *RD->vbases_begin();
9820 assert(BS.isVirtual());
9821 Diag(BS.getBeginLoc(), diag::note_nontrivial_has_virtual) << RD << 1;
9822 return false;
9823 }
9824
9825 // Must have a virtual method.
9826 for (const auto *MI : RD->methods()) {
9827 if (MI->isVirtual()) {
9828 SourceLocation MLoc = MI->getBeginLoc();
9829 Diag(MLoc, diag::note_nontrivial_has_virtual) << RD << 0;
9830 return false;
9831 }
9832 }
9833
9834 llvm_unreachable("dynamic class with no vbases and no virtual functions");
9835 }
9836
9837 // Looks like it's trivial!
9838 return true;
9839}
9840
9841namespace {
9842struct FindHiddenVirtualMethod {
9843 Sema *S;
9844 CXXMethodDecl *Method;
9845 llvm::SmallPtrSet<const CXXMethodDecl *, 8> OverridenAndUsingBaseMethods;
9846 SmallVector<CXXMethodDecl *, 8> OverloadedMethods;
9847
9848private:
9849 /// Check whether any most overridden method from MD in Methods
9850 static bool CheckMostOverridenMethods(
9851 const CXXMethodDecl *MD,
9852 const llvm::SmallPtrSetImpl<const CXXMethodDecl *> &Methods) {
9853 if (MD->size_overridden_methods() == 0)
9854 return Methods.count(MD->getCanonicalDecl());
9855 for (const CXXMethodDecl *O : MD->overridden_methods())
9856 if (CheckMostOverridenMethods(O, Methods))
9857 return true;
9858 return false;
9859 }
9860
9861public:
9862 /// Member lookup function that determines whether a given C++
9863 /// method overloads virtual methods in a base class without overriding any,
9864 /// to be used with CXXRecordDecl::lookupInBases().
9865 bool operator()(const CXXBaseSpecifier *Specifier, CXXBasePath &Path) {
9866 RecordDecl *BaseRecord =
9867 Specifier->getType()->castAs<RecordType>()->getDecl();
9868
9869 DeclarationName Name = Method->getDeclName();
9870 assert(Name.getNameKind() == DeclarationName::Identifier);
9871
9872 bool foundSameNameMethod = false;
9873 SmallVector<CXXMethodDecl *, 8> overloadedMethods;
9874 for (Path.Decls = BaseRecord->lookup(Name).begin();
9875 Path.Decls != DeclContext::lookup_iterator(); ++Path.Decls) {
9876 NamedDecl *D = *Path.Decls;
9877 if (CXXMethodDecl *MD = dyn_cast<CXXMethodDecl>(D)) {
9878 MD = MD->getCanonicalDecl();
9879 foundSameNameMethod = true;
9880 // Interested only in hidden virtual methods.
9881 if (!MD->isVirtual())
9882 continue;
9883 // If the method we are checking overrides a method from its base
9884 // don't warn about the other overloaded methods. Clang deviates from
9885 // GCC by only diagnosing overloads of inherited virtual functions that
9886 // do not override any other virtual functions in the base. GCC's
9887 // -Woverloaded-virtual diagnoses any derived function hiding a virtual
9888 // function from a base class. These cases may be better served by a
9889 // warning (not specific to virtual functions) on call sites when the
9890 // call would select a different function from the base class, were it
9891 // visible.
9892 // See FIXME in test/SemaCXX/warn-overload-virtual.cpp for an example.
9893 if (!S->IsOverload(Method, MD, false))
9894 return true;
9895 // Collect the overload only if its hidden.
9896 if (!CheckMostOverridenMethods(MD, OverridenAndUsingBaseMethods))
9897 overloadedMethods.push_back(MD);
9898 }
9899 }
9900
9901 if (foundSameNameMethod)
9902 OverloadedMethods.append(overloadedMethods.begin(),
9903 overloadedMethods.end());
9904 return foundSameNameMethod;
9905 }
9906};
9907} // end anonymous namespace
9908
9909/// Add the most overridden methods from MD to Methods
9910static void AddMostOverridenMethods(const CXXMethodDecl *MD,
9911 llvm::SmallPtrSetImpl<const CXXMethodDecl *>& Methods) {
9912 if (MD->size_overridden_methods() == 0)
9913 Methods.insert(MD->getCanonicalDecl());
9914 else
9915 for (const CXXMethodDecl *O : MD->overridden_methods())
9916 AddMostOverridenMethods(O, Methods);
9917}
9918
9919/// Check if a method overloads virtual methods in a base class without
9920/// overriding any.
9921void Sema::FindHiddenVirtualMethods(CXXMethodDecl *MD,
9922 SmallVectorImpl<CXXMethodDecl*> &OverloadedMethods) {
9923 if (!MD->getDeclName().isIdentifier())
9924 return;
9925
9926 CXXBasePaths Paths(/*FindAmbiguities=*/true, // true to look in all bases.
9927 /*bool RecordPaths=*/false,
9928 /*bool DetectVirtual=*/false);
9929 FindHiddenVirtualMethod FHVM;
9930 FHVM.Method = MD;
9931 FHVM.S = this;
9932
9933 // Keep the base methods that were overridden or introduced in the subclass
9934 // by 'using' in a set. A base method not in this set is hidden.
9935 CXXRecordDecl *DC = MD->getParent();
9936 DeclContext::lookup_result R = DC->lookup(MD->getDeclName());
9937 for (DeclContext::lookup_iterator I = R.begin(), E = R.end(); I != E; ++I) {
9938 NamedDecl *ND = *I;
9939 if (UsingShadowDecl *shad = dyn_cast<UsingShadowDecl>(*I))
9940 ND = shad->getTargetDecl();
9941 if (CXXMethodDecl *MD = dyn_cast<CXXMethodDecl>(ND))
9942 AddMostOverridenMethods(MD, FHVM.OverridenAndUsingBaseMethods);
9943 }
9944
9945 if (DC->lookupInBases(FHVM, Paths))
9946 OverloadedMethods = FHVM.OverloadedMethods;
9947}
9948
9949void Sema::NoteHiddenVirtualMethods(CXXMethodDecl *MD,
9950 SmallVectorImpl<CXXMethodDecl*> &OverloadedMethods) {
9951 for (unsigned i = 0, e = OverloadedMethods.size(); i != e; ++i) {
9952 CXXMethodDecl *overloadedMD = OverloadedMethods[i];
9953 PartialDiagnostic PD = PDiag(
9954 diag::note_hidden_overloaded_virtual_declared_here) << overloadedMD;
9955 HandleFunctionTypeMismatch(PD, MD->getType(), overloadedMD->getType());
9956 Diag(overloadedMD->getLocation(), PD);
9957 }
9958}
9959
9960/// Diagnose methods which overload virtual methods in a base class
9961/// without overriding any.
9962void Sema::DiagnoseHiddenVirtualMethods(CXXMethodDecl *MD) {
9963 if (MD->isInvalidDecl())
9964 return;
9965
9966 if (Diags.isIgnored(diag::warn_overloaded_virtual, MD->getLocation()))
9967 return;
9968
9969 SmallVector<CXXMethodDecl *, 8> OverloadedMethods;
9970 FindHiddenVirtualMethods(MD, OverloadedMethods);
9971 if (!OverloadedMethods.empty()) {
9972 Diag(MD->getLocation(), diag::warn_overloaded_virtual)
9973 << MD << (OverloadedMethods.size() > 1);
9974
9975 NoteHiddenVirtualMethods(MD, OverloadedMethods);
9976 }
9977}
9978
9979void Sema::checkIllFormedTrivialABIStruct(CXXRecordDecl &RD) {
9980 auto PrintDiagAndRemoveAttr = [&](unsigned N) {
9981 // No diagnostics if this is a template instantiation.
9982 if (!isTemplateInstantiation(RD.getTemplateSpecializationKind())) {
9983 Diag(RD.getAttr<TrivialABIAttr>()->getLocation(),
9984 diag::ext_cannot_use_trivial_abi) << &RD;
9985 Diag(RD.getAttr<TrivialABIAttr>()->getLocation(),
9986 diag::note_cannot_use_trivial_abi_reason) << &RD << N;
9987 }
9988 RD.dropAttr<TrivialABIAttr>();
9989 };
9990
9991 // Ill-formed if the copy and move constructors are deleted.
9992 auto HasNonDeletedCopyOrMoveConstructor = [&]() {
9993 // If the type is dependent, then assume it might have
9994 // implicit copy or move ctor because we won't know yet at this point.
9995 if (RD.isDependentType())
9996 return true;
9997 if (RD.needsImplicitCopyConstructor() &&
9998 !RD.defaultedCopyConstructorIsDeleted())
9999 return true;
10000 if (RD.needsImplicitMoveConstructor() &&
10001 !RD.defaultedMoveConstructorIsDeleted())
10002 return true;
10003 for (const CXXConstructorDecl *CD : RD.ctors())
10004 if (CD->isCopyOrMoveConstructor() && !CD->isDeleted())
10005 return true;
10006 return false;
10007 };
10008
10009 if (!HasNonDeletedCopyOrMoveConstructor()) {
10010 PrintDiagAndRemoveAttr(0);
10011 return;
10012 }
10013
10014 // Ill-formed if the struct has virtual functions.
10015 if (RD.isPolymorphic()) {
10016 PrintDiagAndRemoveAttr(1);
10017 return;
10018 }
10019
10020 for (const auto &B : RD.bases()) {
10021 // Ill-formed if the base class is non-trivial for the purpose of calls or a
10022 // virtual base.
10023 if (!B.getType()->isDependentType() &&
10024 !B.getType()->getAsCXXRecordDecl()->canPassInRegisters()) {
10025 PrintDiagAndRemoveAttr(2);
10026 return;
10027 }
10028
10029 if (B.isVirtual()) {
10030 PrintDiagAndRemoveAttr(3);
10031 return;
10032 }
10033 }
10034
10035 for (const auto *FD : RD.fields()) {
10036 // Ill-formed if the field is an ObjectiveC pointer or of a type that is
10037 // non-trivial for the purpose of calls.
10038 QualType FT = FD->getType();
10039 if (FT.getObjCLifetime() == Qualifiers::OCL_Weak) {
10040 PrintDiagAndRemoveAttr(4);
10041 return;
10042 }
10043
10044 if (const auto *RT = FT->getBaseElementTypeUnsafe()->getAs<RecordType>())
10045 if (!RT->isDependentType() &&
10046 !cast<CXXRecordDecl>(RT->getDecl())->canPassInRegisters()) {
10047 PrintDiagAndRemoveAttr(5);
10048 return;
10049 }
10050 }
10051}
10052
10053void Sema::ActOnFinishCXXMemberSpecification(
10054 Scope *S, SourceLocation RLoc, Decl *TagDecl, SourceLocation LBrac,
10055 SourceLocation RBrac, const ParsedAttributesView &AttrList) {
10056 if (!TagDecl)
10057 return;
10058
10059 AdjustDeclIfTemplate(TagDecl);
10060
10061 for (const ParsedAttr &AL : AttrList) {
10062 if (AL.getKind() != ParsedAttr::AT_Visibility)
10063 continue;
10064 AL.setInvalid();
10065 Diag(AL.getLoc(), diag::warn_attribute_after_definition_ignored) << AL;
10066 }
10067
10068 ActOnFields(S, RLoc, TagDecl, llvm::makeArrayRef(
10069 // strict aliasing violation!
10070 reinterpret_cast<Decl**>(FieldCollector->getCurFields()),
10071 FieldCollector->getCurNumFields()), LBrac, RBrac, AttrList);
10072
10073 CheckCompletedCXXClass(S, cast<CXXRecordDecl>(TagDecl));
10074}
10075
10076/// Find the equality comparison functions that should be implicitly declared
10077/// in a given class definition, per C++2a [class.compare.default]p3.
10078static void findImplicitlyDeclaredEqualityComparisons(
10079 ASTContext &Ctx, CXXRecordDecl *RD,
10080 llvm::SmallVectorImpl<FunctionDecl *> &Spaceships) {
10081 DeclarationName EqEq = Ctx.DeclarationNames.getCXXOperatorName(OO_EqualEqual);
10082 if (!RD->lookup(EqEq).empty())
10083 // Member operator== explicitly declared: no implicit operator==s.
10084 return;
10085
10086 // Traverse friends looking for an '==' or a '<=>'.
10087 for (FriendDecl *Friend : RD->friends()) {
10088 FunctionDecl *FD = dyn_cast_or_null<FunctionDecl>(Friend->getFriendDecl());
10089 if (!FD) continue;
10090
10091 if (FD->getOverloadedOperator() == OO_EqualEqual) {
10092 // Friend operator== explicitly declared: no implicit operator==s.
10093 Spaceships.clear();
10094 return;
10095 }
10096
10097 if (FD->getOverloadedOperator() == OO_Spaceship &&
10098 FD->isExplicitlyDefaulted())
10099 Spaceships.push_back(FD);
10100 }
10101
10102 // Look for members named 'operator<=>'.
10103 DeclarationName Cmp = Ctx.DeclarationNames.getCXXOperatorName(OO_Spaceship);
10104 for (NamedDecl *ND : RD->lookup(Cmp)) {
10105 // Note that we could find a non-function here (either a function template
10106 // or a using-declaration). Neither case results in an implicit
10107 // 'operator=='.
10108 if (auto *FD = dyn_cast<FunctionDecl>(ND))
10109 if (FD->isExplicitlyDefaulted())
10110 Spaceships.push_back(FD);
10111 }
10112}
10113
10114/// AddImplicitlyDeclaredMembersToClass - Adds any implicitly-declared
10115/// special functions, such as the default constructor, copy
10116/// constructor, or destructor, to the given C++ class (C++
10117/// [special]p1). This routine can only be executed just before the
10118/// definition of the class is complete.
10119void Sema::AddImplicitlyDeclaredMembersToClass(CXXRecordDecl *ClassDecl) {
10120 // Don't add implicit special members to templated classes.
10121 // FIXME: This means unqualified lookups for 'operator=' within a class
10122 // template don't work properly.
10123 if (!ClassDecl->isDependentType()) {
10124 if (ClassDecl->needsImplicitDefaultConstructor()) {
10125 ++getASTContext().NumImplicitDefaultConstructors;
10126
10127 if (ClassDecl->hasInheritedConstructor())
10128 DeclareImplicitDefaultConstructor(ClassDecl);
10129 }
10130
10131 if (ClassDecl->needsImplicitCopyConstructor()) {
10132 ++getASTContext().NumImplicitCopyConstructors;
10133
10134 // If the properties or semantics of the copy constructor couldn't be
10135 // determined while the class was being declared, force a declaration
10136 // of it now.
10137 if (ClassDecl->needsOverloadResolutionForCopyConstructor() ||
10138 ClassDecl->hasInheritedConstructor())
10139 DeclareImplicitCopyConstructor(ClassDecl);
10140 // For the MS ABI we need to know whether the copy ctor is deleted. A
10141 // prerequisite for deleting the implicit copy ctor is that the class has
10142 // a move ctor or move assignment that is either user-declared or whose
10143 // semantics are inherited from a subobject. FIXME: We should provide a
10144 // more direct way for CodeGen to ask whether the constructor was deleted.
10145 else if (Context.getTargetInfo().getCXXABI().isMicrosoft() &&
10146 (ClassDecl->hasUserDeclaredMoveConstructor() ||
10147 ClassDecl->needsOverloadResolutionForMoveConstructor() ||
10148 ClassDecl->hasUserDeclaredMoveAssignment() ||
10149 ClassDecl->needsOverloadResolutionForMoveAssignment()))
10150 DeclareImplicitCopyConstructor(ClassDecl);
10151 }
10152
10153 if (getLangOpts().CPlusPlus11 &&
10154 ClassDecl->needsImplicitMoveConstructor()) {
10155 ++getASTContext().NumImplicitMoveConstructors;
10156
10157 if (ClassDecl->needsOverloadResolutionForMoveConstructor() ||
10158 ClassDecl->hasInheritedConstructor())
10159 DeclareImplicitMoveConstructor(ClassDecl);
10160 }
10161
10162 if (ClassDecl->needsImplicitCopyAssignment()) {
10163 ++getASTContext().NumImplicitCopyAssignmentOperators;
10164
10165 // If we have a dynamic class, then the copy assignment operator may be
10166 // virtual, so we have to declare it immediately. This ensures that, e.g.,
10167 // it shows up in the right place in the vtable and that we diagnose
10168 // problems with the implicit exception specification.
10169 if (ClassDecl->isDynamicClass() ||
10170 ClassDecl->needsOverloadResolutionForCopyAssignment() ||
10171 ClassDecl->hasInheritedAssignment())
10172 DeclareImplicitCopyAssignment(ClassDecl);
10173 }
10174
10175 if (getLangOpts().CPlusPlus11 && ClassDecl->needsImplicitMoveAssignment()) {
10176 ++getASTContext().NumImplicitMoveAssignmentOperators;
10177
10178 // Likewise for the move assignment operator.
10179 if (ClassDecl->isDynamicClass() ||
10180 ClassDecl->needsOverloadResolutionForMoveAssignment() ||
10181 ClassDecl->hasInheritedAssignment())
10182 DeclareImplicitMoveAssignment(ClassDecl);
10183 }
10184
10185 if (ClassDecl->needsImplicitDestructor()) {
10186 ++getASTContext().NumImplicitDestructors;
10187
10188 // If we have a dynamic class, then the destructor may be virtual, so we
10189 // have to declare the destructor immediately. This ensures that, e.g., it
10190 // shows up in the right place in the vtable and that we diagnose problems
10191 // with the implicit exception specification.
10192 if (ClassDecl->isDynamicClass() ||
10193 ClassDecl->needsOverloadResolutionForDestructor())
10194 DeclareImplicitDestructor(ClassDecl);
10195 }
10196 }
10197
10198 // C++2a [class.compare.default]p3:
10199 // If the member-specification does not explicitly declare any member or
10200 // friend named operator==, an == operator function is declared implicitly
10201 // for each defaulted three-way comparison operator function defined in
10202 // the member-specification
10203 // FIXME: Consider doing this lazily.
10204 // We do this during the initial parse for a class template, not during
10205 // instantiation, so that we can handle unqualified lookups for 'operator=='
10206 // when parsing the template.
10207 if (getLangOpts().CPlusPlus20 && !inTemplateInstantiation()) {
10208 llvm::SmallVector<FunctionDecl *, 4> DefaultedSpaceships;
10209 findImplicitlyDeclaredEqualityComparisons(Context, ClassDecl,
10210 DefaultedSpaceships);
10211 for (auto *FD : DefaultedSpaceships)
10212 DeclareImplicitEqualityComparison(ClassDecl, FD);
10213 }
10214}
10215
10216unsigned
10217Sema::ActOnReenterTemplateScope(Decl *D,
10218 llvm::function_ref<Scope *()> EnterScope) {
10219 if (!D)
10220 return 0;
10221 AdjustDeclIfTemplate(D);
10222
10223 // In order to get name lookup right, reenter template scopes in order from
10224 // outermost to innermost.
10225 SmallVector<TemplateParameterList *, 4> ParameterLists;
10226 DeclContext *LookupDC = dyn_cast<DeclContext>(D);
10227
10228 if (DeclaratorDecl *DD = dyn_cast<DeclaratorDecl>(D)) {
10229 for (unsigned i = 0; i < DD->getNumTemplateParameterLists(); ++i)
10230 ParameterLists.push_back(DD->getTemplateParameterList(i));
10231
10232 if (FunctionDecl *FD = dyn_cast<FunctionDecl>(D)) {
10233 if (FunctionTemplateDecl *FTD = FD->getDescribedFunctionTemplate())
10234 ParameterLists.push_back(FTD->getTemplateParameters());
10235 } else if (VarDecl *VD = dyn_cast<VarDecl>(D)) {
10236 LookupDC = VD->getDeclContext();
10237
10238 if (VarTemplateDecl *VTD = VD->getDescribedVarTemplate())
10239 ParameterLists.push_back(VTD->getTemplateParameters());
10240 else if (auto *PSD = dyn_cast<VarTemplatePartialSpecializationDecl>(D))
10241 ParameterLists.push_back(PSD->getTemplateParameters());
10242 }
10243 } else if (TagDecl *TD = dyn_cast<TagDecl>(D)) {
10244 for (unsigned i = 0; i < TD->getNumTemplateParameterLists(); ++i)
10245 ParameterLists.push_back(TD->getTemplateParameterList(i));
10246
10247 if (CXXRecordDecl *RD = dyn_cast<CXXRecordDecl>(TD)) {
10248 if (ClassTemplateDecl *CTD = RD->getDescribedClassTemplate())
10249 ParameterLists.push_back(CTD->getTemplateParameters());
10250 else if (auto *PSD = dyn_cast<ClassTemplatePartialSpecializationDecl>(D))
10251 ParameterLists.push_back(PSD->getTemplateParameters());
10252 }
10253 }
10254 // FIXME: Alias declarations and concepts.
10255
10256 unsigned Count = 0;
10257 Scope *InnermostTemplateScope = nullptr;
10258 for (TemplateParameterList *Params : ParameterLists) {
10259 // Ignore explicit specializations; they don't contribute to the template
10260 // depth.
10261 if (Params->size() == 0)
10262 continue;
10263
10264 InnermostTemplateScope = EnterScope();
10265 for (NamedDecl *Param : *Params) {
10266 if (Param->getDeclName()) {
10267 InnermostTemplateScope->AddDecl(Param);
10268 IdResolver.AddDecl(Param);
10269 }
10270 }
10271 ++Count;
10272 }
10273
10274 // Associate the new template scopes with the corresponding entities.
10275 if (InnermostTemplateScope) {
10276 assert(LookupDC && "no enclosing DeclContext for template lookup");
10277 EnterTemplatedContext(InnermostTemplateScope, LookupDC);
10278 }
10279
10280 return Count;
10281}

10287 PushDeclContext(S, Record);
