13251namespace {
13252/// RAII object to register a special member as being currently declared.
13253struct DeclaringSpecialMember {
13254 Sema &S;
13255 Sema::SpecialMemberDecl D;
13256 Sema::ContextRAII SavedContext;
13257 bool WasAlreadyBeingDeclared;
13258
13259 DeclaringSpecialMember(Sema &S, CXXRecordDecl *RD, Sema::CXXSpecialMember CSM)
13260 : S(S), D(RD, CSM), SavedContext(S, RD) {
13261 WasAlreadyBeingDeclared = !S.SpecialMembersBeingDeclared.insert(D).second;
13262 if (WasAlreadyBeingDeclared)
13263 // This almost never happens, but if it does, ensure that our cache
13264 // doesn't contain a stale result.
13265 S.SpecialMemberCache.clear();
13266 else {
13267 // Register a note to be produced if we encounter an error while
13268 // declaring the special member.
13269 Sema::CodeSynthesisContext Ctx;
13270 Ctx.Kind = Sema::CodeSynthesisContext::DeclaringSpecialMember;
13271 // FIXME: We don't have a location to use here. Using the class's
13272 // location maintains the fiction that we declare all special members
13273 // with the class, but (1) it's not clear that lying about that helps our
13274 // users understand what's going on, and (2) there may be outer contexts
13275 // on the stack (some of which are relevant) and printing them exposes
13276 // our lies.
13277 Ctx.PointOfInstantiation = RD->getLocation();
13278 Ctx.Entity = RD;
13279 Ctx.SpecialMember = CSM;
13280 S.pushCodeSynthesisContext(Ctx);
13281 }
13282 }
13283 ~DeclaringSpecialMember() {
13284 if (!WasAlreadyBeingDeclared) {
13285 S.SpecialMembersBeingDeclared.erase(D);
13286 S.popCodeSynthesisContext();
13287 }
13288 }
13289
13290 /// Are we already trying to declare this special member?
13291 bool isAlreadyBeingDeclared() const {
13292 return WasAlreadyBeingDeclared;
13293 }
13294};
13295}
13296
13297void Sema::CheckImplicitSpecialMemberDeclaration(Scope *S, FunctionDecl *FD) {
13298 // Look up any existing declarations, but don't trigger declaration of all
13299 // implicit special members with this name.
13300 DeclarationName Name = FD->getDeclName();
13301 LookupResult R(*this, Name, SourceLocation(), LookupOrdinaryName,
13302 ForExternalRedeclaration);
13303 for (auto *D : FD->getParent()->lookup(Name))
13304 if (auto *Acceptable = R.getAcceptableDecl(D))
13305 R.addDecl(Acceptable);
13306 R.resolveKind();
13307 R.suppressDiagnostics();
13308
13309 CheckFunctionDeclaration(S, FD, R, /*IsMemberSpecialization*/false);
13310}
13311
13312void Sema::setupImplicitSpecialMemberType(CXXMethodDecl *SpecialMem,
13313 QualType ResultTy,
13314 ArrayRef<QualType> Args) {
13315 // Build an exception specification pointing back at this constructor.
13316 FunctionProtoType::ExtProtoInfo EPI = getImplicitMethodEPI(*this, SpecialMem);
13317
13318 LangAS AS = getDefaultCXXMethodAddrSpace();
13319 if (AS != LangAS::Default) {
13320 EPI.TypeQuals.addAddressSpace(AS);
13321 }
13322
13323 auto QT = Context.getFunctionType(ResultTy, Args, EPI);
13324 SpecialMem->setType(QT);
13325
13326 // During template instantiation of implicit special member functions we need
13327 // a reliable TypeSourceInfo for the function prototype in order to allow
13328 // functions to be substituted.
13329 if (inTemplateInstantiation() &&
13330 cast<CXXRecordDecl>(SpecialMem->getParent())->isLambda()) {
13331 TypeSourceInfo *TSI =
13332 Context.getTrivialTypeSourceInfo(SpecialMem->getType());
13333 SpecialMem->setTypeSourceInfo(TSI);
13334 }
13335}
13336
13337CXXConstructorDecl *Sema::DeclareImplicitDefaultConstructor(
13338 CXXRecordDecl *ClassDecl) {
13339 // C++ [class.ctor]p5:
13340 // A default constructor for a class X is a constructor of class X
13341 // that can be called without an argument. If there is no
13342 // user-declared constructor for class X, a default constructor is
13343 // implicitly declared. An implicitly-declared default constructor
13344 // is an inline public member of its class.
13345 assert(ClassDecl->needsImplicitDefaultConstructor() &&
13346 "Should not build implicit default constructor!");
13347
13348 DeclaringSpecialMember DSM(*this, ClassDecl, CXXDefaultConstructor);
13349 if (DSM.isAlreadyBeingDeclared())
13350 return nullptr;
13351
13352 bool Constexpr = defaultedSpecialMemberIsConstexpr(*this, ClassDecl,
13353 CXXDefaultConstructor,
13354 false);
13355
13356 // Create the actual constructor declaration.
13357 CanQualType ClassType
13358 = Context.getCanonicalType(Context.getTypeDeclType(ClassDecl));
13359 SourceLocation ClassLoc = ClassDecl->getLocation();
13360 DeclarationName Name
13361 = Context.DeclarationNames.getCXXConstructorName(ClassType);
13362 DeclarationNameInfo NameInfo(Name, ClassLoc);
13363 CXXConstructorDecl *DefaultCon = CXXConstructorDecl::Create(
13364 Context, ClassDecl, ClassLoc, NameInfo, /*Type*/ QualType(),
13365 /*TInfo=*/nullptr, ExplicitSpecifier(),
13366 getCurFPFeatures().isFPConstrained(),
13367 /*isInline=*/true, /*isImplicitlyDeclared=*/true,
13368 Constexpr ? ConstexprSpecKind::Constexpr
13369 : ConstexprSpecKind::Unspecified);
13370 DefaultCon->setAccess(AS_public);
13371 DefaultCon->setDefaulted();
13372
13373 if (getLangOpts().CUDA) {
13374 inferCUDATargetForImplicitSpecialMember(ClassDecl, CXXDefaultConstructor,
13375 DefaultCon,
13376 /* ConstRHS */ false,
13377 /* Diagnose */ false);
13378 }
13379
13380 setupImplicitSpecialMemberType(DefaultCon, Context.VoidTy, None);
13381
13382 // We don't need to use SpecialMemberIsTrivial here; triviality for default
13383 // constructors is easy to compute.
13384 DefaultCon->setTrivial(ClassDecl->hasTrivialDefaultConstructor());
13385
13386 // Note that we have declared this constructor.
13387 ++getASTContext().NumImplicitDefaultConstructorsDeclared;
13388
13389 Scope *S = getScopeForContext(ClassDecl);
13390 CheckImplicitSpecialMemberDeclaration(S, DefaultCon);
13391
13392 if (ShouldDeleteSpecialMember(DefaultCon, CXXDefaultConstructor))
13393 SetDeclDeleted(DefaultCon, ClassLoc);
13394
13395 if (S)
13396 PushOnScopeChains(DefaultCon, S, false);
13397 ClassDecl->addDecl(DefaultCon);
13398
13399 return DefaultCon;
13400}
13401
13402void Sema::DefineImplicitDefaultConstructor(SourceLocation CurrentLocation,
13403 CXXConstructorDecl *Constructor) {
13404 assert((Constructor->isDefaulted() && Constructor->isDefaultConstructor() &&
13405 !Constructor->doesThisDeclarationHaveABody() &&
13406 !Constructor->isDeleted()) &&
13407 "DefineImplicitDefaultConstructor - call it for implicit default ctor");
13408 if (Constructor->willHaveBody() || Constructor->isInvalidDecl())
13409 return;
13410
13411 CXXRecordDecl *ClassDecl = Constructor->getParent();
13412 assert(ClassDecl && "DefineImplicitDefaultConstructor - invalid constructor");
13413
13414 SynthesizedFunctionScope Scope(*this, Constructor);
13415
13416 // The exception specification is needed because we are defining the
13417 // function.
13418 ResolveExceptionSpec(CurrentLocation,
13419 Constructor->getType()->castAs<FunctionProtoType>());
13420 MarkVTableUsed(CurrentLocation, ClassDecl);
13421
13422 // Add a context note for diagnostics produced after this point.
13423 Scope.addContextNote(CurrentLocation);
13424
13425 if (SetCtorInitializers(Constructor, /*AnyErrors=*/false)) {
13426 Constructor->setInvalidDecl();
13427 return;
13428 }
13429
13430 SourceLocation Loc = Constructor->getEndLoc().isValid()
13431 ? Constructor->getEndLoc()
13432 : Constructor->getLocation();
13433 Constructor->setBody(new (Context) CompoundStmt(Loc));
13434 Constructor->markUsed(Context);
13435
13436 if (ASTMutationListener *L = getASTMutationListener()) {
13437 L->CompletedImplicitDefinition(Constructor);
13438 }
13439
13440 DiagnoseUninitializedFields(*this, Constructor);
13441}
13442
13443void Sema::ActOnFinishDelayedMemberInitializers(Decl *D) {
13444 // Perform any delayed checks on exception specifications.
13445 CheckDelayedMemberExceptionSpecs();
13446}
13447
13448/// Find or create the fake constructor we synthesize to model constructing an
13449/// object of a derived class via a constructor of a base class.
13450CXXConstructorDecl *
13451Sema::findInheritingConstructor(SourceLocation Loc,
13452 CXXConstructorDecl *BaseCtor,
13453 ConstructorUsingShadowDecl *Shadow) {
13454 CXXRecordDecl *Derived = Shadow->getParent();
13455 SourceLocation UsingLoc = Shadow->getLocation();
13456
13457 // FIXME: Add a new kind of DeclarationName for an inherited constructor.
13458 // For now we use the name of the base class constructor as a member of the
13459 // derived class to indicate a (fake) inherited constructor name.
13460 DeclarationName Name = BaseCtor->getDeclName();
13461
13462 // Check to see if we already have a fake constructor for this inherited
13463 // constructor call.
13464 for (NamedDecl *Ctor : Derived->lookup(Name))
13465 if (declaresSameEntity(cast<CXXConstructorDecl>(Ctor)
13466 ->getInheritedConstructor()
13467 .getConstructor(),
13468 BaseCtor))
13469 return cast<CXXConstructorDecl>(Ctor);
13470
13471 DeclarationNameInfo NameInfo(Name, UsingLoc);
13472 TypeSourceInfo *TInfo =
13473 Context.getTrivialTypeSourceInfo(BaseCtor->getType(), UsingLoc);
13474 FunctionProtoTypeLoc ProtoLoc =
13475 TInfo->getTypeLoc().IgnoreParens().castAs<FunctionProtoTypeLoc>();
13476
13477 // Check the inherited constructor is valid and find the list of base classes
13478 // from which it was inherited.
13479 InheritedConstructorInfo ICI(*this, Loc, Shadow);
13480
13481 bool Constexpr =
13482 BaseCtor->isConstexpr() &&
13483 defaultedSpecialMemberIsConstexpr(*this, Derived, CXXDefaultConstructor,
13484 false, BaseCtor, &ICI);
13485
13486 CXXConstructorDecl *DerivedCtor = CXXConstructorDecl::Create(
13487 Context, Derived, UsingLoc, NameInfo, TInfo->getType(), TInfo,
13488 BaseCtor->getExplicitSpecifier(), getCurFPFeatures().isFPConstrained(),
13489 /*isInline=*/true,
13490 /*isImplicitlyDeclared=*/true,
13491 Constexpr ? BaseCtor->getConstexprKind() : ConstexprSpecKind::Unspecified,
13492 InheritedConstructor(Shadow, BaseCtor),
13493 BaseCtor->getTrailingRequiresClause());
13494 if (Shadow->isInvalidDecl())
13495 DerivedCtor->setInvalidDecl();
13496
13497 // Build an unevaluated exception specification for this fake constructor.
13498 const FunctionProtoType *FPT = TInfo->getType()->castAs<FunctionProtoType>();
13499 FunctionProtoType::ExtProtoInfo EPI = FPT->getExtProtoInfo();
13500 EPI.ExceptionSpec.Type = EST_Unevaluated;
13501 EPI.ExceptionSpec.SourceDecl = DerivedCtor;
13502 DerivedCtor->setType(Context.getFunctionType(FPT->getReturnType(),
13503 FPT->getParamTypes(), EPI));
13504
13505 // Build the parameter declarations.
13506 SmallVector<ParmVarDecl *, 16> ParamDecls;
13507 for (unsigned I = 0, N = FPT->getNumParams(); I != N; ++I) {
13508 TypeSourceInfo *TInfo =
13509 Context.getTrivialTypeSourceInfo(FPT->getParamType(I), UsingLoc);
13510 ParmVarDecl *PD = ParmVarDecl::Create(
13511 Context, DerivedCtor, UsingLoc, UsingLoc, /*IdentifierInfo=*/nullptr,
13512 FPT->getParamType(I), TInfo, SC_None, /*DefArg=*/nullptr);
13513 PD->setScopeInfo(0, I);
13514 PD->setImplicit();
13515 // Ensure attributes are propagated onto parameters (this matters for
13516 // format, pass_object_size, ...).
13517 mergeDeclAttributes(PD, BaseCtor->getParamDecl(I));
13518 ParamDecls.push_back(PD);
13519 ProtoLoc.setParam(I, PD);
13520 }
13521
13522 // Set up the new constructor.
13523 assert(!BaseCtor->isDeleted() && "should not use deleted constructor");
13524 DerivedCtor->setAccess(BaseCtor->getAccess());
13525 DerivedCtor->setParams(ParamDecls);
13526 Derived->addDecl(DerivedCtor);
13527
13528 if (ShouldDeleteSpecialMember(DerivedCtor, CXXDefaultConstructor, &ICI))
13529 SetDeclDeleted(DerivedCtor, UsingLoc);
13530
13531 return DerivedCtor;
13532}
13533
13534void Sema::NoteDeletedInheritingConstructor(CXXConstructorDecl *Ctor) {
13535 InheritedConstructorInfo ICI(*this, Ctor->getLocation(),
13536 Ctor->getInheritedConstructor().getShadowDecl());
13537 ShouldDeleteSpecialMember(Ctor, CXXDefaultConstructor, &ICI,
13538 /*Diagnose*/true);
13539}
13540
13541void Sema::DefineInheritingConstructor(SourceLocation CurrentLocation,
13542 CXXConstructorDecl *Constructor) {
13543 CXXRecordDecl *ClassDecl = Constructor->getParent();
13544 assert(Constructor->getInheritedConstructor() &&
13545 !Constructor->doesThisDeclarationHaveABody() &&
13546 !Constructor->isDeleted());
13547 if (Constructor->willHaveBody() || Constructor->isInvalidDecl())
13548 return;
13549
13550 // Initializations are performed "as if by a defaulted default constructor",
13551 // so enter the appropriate scope.
13552 SynthesizedFunctionScope Scope(*this, Constructor);
13553
13554 // The exception specification is needed because we are defining the
13555 // function.
13556 ResolveExceptionSpec(CurrentLocation,
13557 Constructor->getType()->castAs<FunctionProtoType>());
13558 MarkVTableUsed(CurrentLocation, ClassDecl);
13559
13560 // Add a context note for diagnostics produced after this point.
13561 Scope.addContextNote(CurrentLocation);
13562
13563 ConstructorUsingShadowDecl *Shadow =
13564 Constructor->getInheritedConstructor().getShadowDecl();
13565 CXXConstructorDecl *InheritedCtor =
13566 Constructor->getInheritedConstructor().getConstructor();
13567
13568 // [class.inhctor.init]p1:
13569 // initialization proceeds as if a defaulted default constructor is used to
13570 // initialize the D object and each base class subobject from which the
13571 // constructor was inherited
13572
13573 InheritedConstructorInfo ICI(*this, CurrentLocation, Shadow);
13574 CXXRecordDecl *RD = Shadow->getParent();
13575 SourceLocation InitLoc = Shadow->getLocation();
13576
13577 // Build explicit initializers for all base classes from which the
13578 // constructor was inherited.
13579 SmallVector<CXXCtorInitializer*, 8> Inits;
13580 for (bool VBase : {false, true}) {
13581 for (CXXBaseSpecifier &B : VBase ? RD->vbases() : RD->bases()) {
13582 if (B.isVirtual() != VBase)
13583 continue;
13584
13585 auto *BaseRD = B.getType()->getAsCXXRecordDecl();
13586 if (!BaseRD)
13587 continue;
13588
13589 auto BaseCtor = ICI.findConstructorForBase(BaseRD, InheritedCtor);
13590 if (!BaseCtor.first)
13591 continue;
13592
13593 MarkFunctionReferenced(CurrentLocation, BaseCtor.first);
13594 ExprResult Init = new (Context) CXXInheritedCtorInitExpr(
13595 InitLoc, B.getType(), BaseCtor.first, VBase, BaseCtor.second);
13596
13597 auto *TInfo = Context.getTrivialTypeSourceInfo(B.getType(), InitLoc);
13598 Inits.push_back(new (Context) CXXCtorInitializer(
13599 Context, TInfo, VBase, InitLoc, Init.get(), InitLoc,
13600 SourceLocation()));
13601 }
13602 }
13603
13604 // We now proceed as if for a defaulted default constructor, with the relevant
13605 // initializers replaced.
13606
13607 if (SetCtorInitializers(Constructor, /*AnyErrors*/false, Inits)) {
13608 Constructor->setInvalidDecl();
13609 return;
13610 }
13611
13612 Constructor->setBody(new (Context) CompoundStmt(InitLoc));
13613 Constructor->markUsed(Context);
13614
13615 if (ASTMutationListener *L = getASTMutationListener()) {
13616 L->CompletedImplicitDefinition(Constructor);
13617 }
13618
13619 DiagnoseUninitializedFields(*this, Constructor);
13620}
13621
13622CXXDestructorDecl *Sema::DeclareImplicitDestructor(CXXRecordDecl *ClassDecl) {
13623 // C++ [class.dtor]p2:
13624 // If a class has no user-declared destructor, a destructor is
13625 // declared implicitly. An implicitly-declared destructor is an
13626 // inline public member of its class.
13627 assert(ClassDecl->needsImplicitDestructor());
13628
13629 DeclaringSpecialMember DSM(*this, ClassDecl, CXXDestructor);
13630 if (DSM.isAlreadyBeingDeclared())
13631 return nullptr;
13632
13633 bool Constexpr = defaultedSpecialMemberIsConstexpr(*this, ClassDecl,
13634 CXXDestructor,
13635 false);
13636
13637 // Create the actual destructor declaration.
13638 CanQualType ClassType
13639 = Context.getCanonicalType(Context.getTypeDeclType(ClassDecl));
13640 SourceLocation ClassLoc = ClassDecl->getLocation();
13641 DeclarationName Name
13642 = Context.DeclarationNames.getCXXDestructorName(ClassType);
13643 DeclarationNameInfo NameInfo(Name, ClassLoc);
13644 CXXDestructorDecl *Destructor = CXXDestructorDecl::Create(
13645 Context, ClassDecl, ClassLoc, NameInfo, QualType(), nullptr,
13646 getCurFPFeatures().isFPConstrained(),
13647 /*isInline=*/true,
13648 /*isImplicitlyDeclared=*/true,
13649 Constexpr ? ConstexprSpecKind::Constexpr
13650 : ConstexprSpecKind::Unspecified);
13651 Destructor->setAccess(AS_public);
13652 Destructor->setDefaulted();
13653
13654 if (getLangOpts().CUDA) {
13655 inferCUDATargetForImplicitSpecialMember(ClassDecl, CXXDestructor,
13656 Destructor,
13657 /* ConstRHS */ false,
13658 /* Diagnose */ false);
13659 }
13660
13661 setupImplicitSpecialMemberType(Destructor, Context.VoidTy, None);
13662
13663 // We don't need to use SpecialMemberIsTrivial here; triviality for
13664 // destructors is easy to compute.
13665 Destructor->setTrivial(ClassDecl->hasTrivialDestructor());
13666 Destructor->setTrivialForCall(ClassDecl->hasAttr<TrivialABIAttr>() ||
13667 ClassDecl->hasTrivialDestructorForCall());
13668
13669 // Note that we have declared this destructor.
13670 ++getASTContext().NumImplicitDestructorsDeclared;
13671
13672 Scope *S = getScopeForContext(ClassDecl);
13673 CheckImplicitSpecialMemberDeclaration(S, Destructor);
13674
13675 // We can't check whether an implicit destructor is deleted before we complete
13676 // the definition of the class, because its validity depends on the alignment
13677 // of the class. We'll check this from ActOnFields once the class is complete.
13678 if (ClassDecl->isCompleteDefinition() &&
13679 ShouldDeleteSpecialMember(Destructor, CXXDestructor))
13680 SetDeclDeleted(Destructor, ClassLoc);
13681
13682 // Introduce this destructor into its scope.
13683 if (S)
13684 PushOnScopeChains(Destructor, S, false);
13685 ClassDecl->addDecl(Destructor);
13686
13687 return Destructor;
13688}
13689
13690void Sema::DefineImplicitDestructor(SourceLocation CurrentLocation,
13691 CXXDestructorDecl *Destructor) {
13692 assert((Destructor->isDefaulted() &&
13693 !Destructor->doesThisDeclarationHaveABody() &&
13694 !Destructor->isDeleted()) &&
13695 "DefineImplicitDestructor - call it for implicit default dtor");
13696 if (Destructor->willHaveBody() || Destructor->isInvalidDecl())
13697 return;
13698
13699 CXXRecordDecl *ClassDecl = Destructor->getParent();
13700 assert(ClassDecl && "DefineImplicitDestructor - invalid destructor");
13701
13702 SynthesizedFunctionScope Scope(*this, Destructor);
13703
13704 // The exception specification is needed because we are defining the
13705 // function.
13706 ResolveExceptionSpec(CurrentLocation,
13707 Destructor->getType()->castAs<FunctionProtoType>());
13708 MarkVTableUsed(CurrentLocation, ClassDecl);
13709
13710 // Add a context note for diagnostics produced after this point.
13711 Scope.addContextNote(CurrentLocation);
13712
13713 MarkBaseAndMemberDestructorsReferenced(Destructor->getLocation(),
13714 Destructor->getParent());
13715
13716 if (CheckDestructor(Destructor)) {
13717 Destructor->setInvalidDecl();
13718 return;
13719 }
13720
13721 SourceLocation Loc = Destructor->getEndLoc().isValid()
13722 ? Destructor->getEndLoc()
13723 : Destructor->getLocation();
13724 Destructor->setBody(new (Context) CompoundStmt(Loc));
13725 Destructor->markUsed(Context);
13726
13727 if (ASTMutationListener *L = getASTMutationListener()) {
13728 L->CompletedImplicitDefinition(Destructor);
13729 }
13730}
13731
13732void Sema::CheckCompleteDestructorVariant(SourceLocation CurrentLocation,
13733 CXXDestructorDecl *Destructor) {
13734 if (Destructor->isInvalidDecl())
13735 return;
13736
13737 CXXRecordDecl *ClassDecl = Destructor->getParent();
13738 assert(Context.getTargetInfo().getCXXABI().isMicrosoft() &&
13739 "implicit complete dtors unneeded outside MS ABI");
13740 assert(ClassDecl->getNumVBases() > 0 &&
13741 "complete dtor only exists for classes with vbases");
13742
13743 SynthesizedFunctionScope Scope(*this, Destructor);
13744
13745 // Add a context note for diagnostics produced after this point.
13746 Scope.addContextNote(CurrentLocation);
13747
13748 MarkVirtualBaseDestructorsReferenced(Destructor->getLocation(), ClassDecl);
13749}

13751/// Perform any semantic analysis which needs to be delayed until all
13752/// pending class member declarations have been parsed.
13753void Sema::ActOnFinishCXXMemberDecls() {
13754 // If the context is an invalid C++ class, just suppress these checks.
13755 if (CXXRecordDecl *Record = dyn_cast<CXXRecordDecl>(CurContext)) {
13756 if (Record->isInvalidDecl()) {
13757 DelayedOverridingExceptionSpecChecks.clear();
13758 DelayedEquivalentExceptionSpecChecks.clear();
13759 return;
13760 }
13761 checkForMultipleExportedDefaultConstructors(*this, Record);
13762 }
13763}
13764
13765void Sema::ActOnFinishCXXNonNestedClass() {
13766 referenceDLLExportedClassMethods();
13767
13768 if (!DelayedDllExportMemberFunctions.empty()) {
13769 SmallVector<CXXMethodDecl*, 4> WorkList;
13770 std::swap(DelayedDllExportMemberFunctions, WorkList);
13771 for (CXXMethodDecl *M : WorkList) {
13772 DefineDefaultedFunction(*this, M, M->getLocation());
13773
13774 // Pass the method to the consumer to get emitted. This is not necessary
13775 // for explicit instantiation definitions, as they will get emitted
13776 // anyway.
13777 if (M->getParent()->getTemplateSpecializationKind() !=
13778 TSK_ExplicitInstantiationDefinition)
13779 ActOnFinishInlineFunctionDef(M);
13780 }
13781 }
13782}
13783
13784void Sema::referenceDLLExportedClassMethods() {
13785 if (!DelayedDllExportClasses.empty()) {
13786 // Calling ReferenceDllExportedMembers might cause the current function to
13787 // be called again, so use a local copy of DelayedDllExportClasses.
13788 SmallVector<CXXRecordDecl *, 4> WorkList;
13789 std::swap(DelayedDllExportClasses, WorkList);
13790 for (CXXRecordDecl *Class : WorkList)
13791 ReferenceDllExportedMembers(*this, Class);
13792 }
13793}
13794
13795void Sema::AdjustDestructorExceptionSpec(CXXDestructorDecl *Destructor) {
13796 assert(getLangOpts().CPlusPlus11 &&
13797 "adjusting dtor exception specs was introduced in c++11");
13798
13799 if (Destructor->isDependentContext())
13800 return;
13801
13802 // C++11 [class.dtor]p3:
13803 // A declaration of a destructor that does not have an exception-
13804 // specification is implicitly considered to have the same exception-
13805 // specification as an implicit declaration.
13806 const auto *DtorType = Destructor->getType()->castAs<FunctionProtoType>();
13807 if (DtorType->hasExceptionSpec())
13808 return;
13809
13810 // Replace the destructor's type, building off the existing one. Fortunately,
13811 // the only thing of interest in the destructor type is its extended info.
13812 // The return and arguments are fixed.
13813 FunctionProtoType::ExtProtoInfo EPI = DtorType->getExtProtoInfo();
13814 EPI.ExceptionSpec.Type = EST_Unevaluated;
13815 EPI.ExceptionSpec.SourceDecl = Destructor;
13816 Destructor->setType(Context.getFunctionType(Context.VoidTy, None, EPI));
13817
13818 // FIXME: If the destructor has a body that could throw, and the newly created
13819 // spec doesn't allow exceptions, we should emit a warning, because this
13820 // change in behavior can break conforming C++03 programs at runtime.
13821 // However, we don't have a body or an exception specification yet, so it
13822 // needs to be done somewhere else.
13823}

13955/// When generating a defaulted copy or move assignment operator, if a field
13956/// should be copied with __builtin_memcpy rather than via explicit assignments,
13957/// do so. This optimization only applies for arrays of scalars, and for arrays
13958/// of class type where the selected copy/move-assignment operator is trivial.
13959static StmtResult
13960buildMemcpyForAssignmentOp(Sema &S, SourceLocation Loc, QualType T,
13961 const ExprBuilder &ToB, const ExprBuilder &FromB) {
13962 // Compute the size of the memory buffer to be copied.
13963 QualType SizeType = S.Context.getSizeType();
13964 llvm::APInt Size(S.Context.getTypeSize(SizeType),
13965 S.Context.getTypeSizeInChars(T).getQuantity());
13966
13967 // Take the address of the field references for "from" and "to". We
13968 // directly construct UnaryOperators here because semantic analysis
13969 // does not permit us to take the address of an xvalue.
13970 Expr *From = FromB.build(S, Loc);
13971 From = UnaryOperator::Create(
13972 S.Context, From, UO_AddrOf, S.Context.getPointerType(From->getType()),
13973 VK_PRValue, OK_Ordinary, Loc, false, S.CurFPFeatureOverrides());
13974 Expr *To = ToB.build(S, Loc);
13975 To = UnaryOperator::Create(
13976 S.Context, To, UO_AddrOf, S.Context.getPointerType(To->getType()),
13977 VK_PRValue, OK_Ordinary, Loc, false, S.CurFPFeatureOverrides());
13978
13979 const Type *E = T->getBaseElementTypeUnsafe();
13980 bool NeedsCollectableMemCpy =
13981 E->isRecordType() &&
13982 E->castAs<RecordType>()->getDecl()->hasObjectMember();
13983
13984 // Create a reference to the __builtin_objc_memmove_collectable function
13985 StringRef MemCpyName = NeedsCollectableMemCpy ?
13986 "__builtin_objc_memmove_collectable" :
13987 "__builtin_memcpy";
13988 LookupResult R(S, &S.Context.Idents.get(MemCpyName), Loc,
13989 Sema::LookupOrdinaryName);
13990 S.LookupName(R, S.TUScope, true);
13991
13992 FunctionDecl *MemCpy = R.getAsSingle<FunctionDecl>();
13993 if (!MemCpy)
13994 // Something went horribly wrong earlier, and we will have complained
13995 // about it.
13996 return StmtError();
13997
13998 ExprResult MemCpyRef = S.BuildDeclRefExpr(MemCpy, S.Context.BuiltinFnTy,
13999 VK_PRValue, Loc, nullptr);
14000 assert(MemCpyRef.isUsable() && "Builtin reference cannot fail");
14001
14002 Expr *CallArgs[] = {
14003 To, From, IntegerLiteral::Create(S.Context, Size, SizeType, Loc)
14004 };
14005 ExprResult Call = S.BuildCallExpr(/*Scope=*/nullptr, MemCpyRef.get(),
14006 Loc, CallArgs, Loc);
14007
14008 assert(!Call.isInvalid() && "Call to __builtin_memcpy cannot fail!");
14009 return Call.getAs<Stmt>();
14010}
14011
14012/// Builds a statement that copies/moves the given entity from \p From to
14013/// \c To.
14014///
14015/// This routine is used to copy/move the members of a class with an
14016/// implicitly-declared copy/move assignment operator. When the entities being
14017/// copied are arrays, this routine builds for loops to copy them.
14018///
14019/// \param S The Sema object used for type-checking.
14020///
14021/// \param Loc The location where the implicit copy/move is being generated.
14022///
14023/// \param T The type of the expressions being copied/moved. Both expressions
14024/// must have this type.
14025///
14026/// \param To The expression we are copying/moving to.
14027///
14028/// \param From The expression we are copying/moving from.
14029///
14030/// \param CopyingBaseSubobject Whether we're copying/moving a base subobject.
14031/// Otherwise, it's a non-static member subobject.
14032///
14033/// \param Copying Whether we're copying or moving.
14034///
14035/// \param Depth Internal parameter recording the depth of the recursion.
14036///
14037/// \returns A statement or a loop that copies the expressions, or StmtResult(0)
14038/// if a memcpy should be used instead.
14039static StmtResult
14040buildSingleCopyAssignRecursively(Sema &S, SourceLocation Loc, QualType T,
14041 const ExprBuilder &To, const ExprBuilder &From,
14042 bool CopyingBaseSubobject, bool Copying,
14043 unsigned Depth = 0) {
14044 // C++11 [class.copy]p28:
14045 // Each subobject is assigned in the manner appropriate to its type:
14046 //
14047 // - if the subobject is of class type, as if by a call to operator= with
14048 // the subobject as the object expression and the corresponding
14049 // subobject of x as a single function argument (as if by explicit
14050 // qualification; that is, ignoring any possible virtual overriding
14051 // functions in more derived classes);
14052 //
14053 // C++03 [class.copy]p13:
14054 // - if the subobject is of class type, the copy assignment operator for
14055 // the class is used (as if by explicit qualification; that is,
14056 // ignoring any possible virtual overriding functions in more derived
14057 // classes);
14058 if (const RecordType *RecordTy = T->getAs<RecordType>()) {
14059 CXXRecordDecl *ClassDecl = cast<CXXRecordDecl>(RecordTy->getDecl());
14060
14061 // Look for operator=.
14062 DeclarationName Name
14063 = S.Context.DeclarationNames.getCXXOperatorName(OO_Equal);
14064 LookupResult OpLookup(S, Name, Loc, Sema::LookupOrdinaryName);
14065 S.LookupQualifiedName(OpLookup, ClassDecl, false);
14066
14067 // Prior to C++11, filter out any result that isn't a copy/move-assignment
14068 // operator.
14069 if (!S.getLangOpts().CPlusPlus11) {
14070 LookupResult::Filter F = OpLookup.makeFilter();
14071 while (F.hasNext()) {
14072 NamedDecl *D = F.next();
14073 if (CXXMethodDecl *Method = dyn_cast<CXXMethodDecl>(D))
14074 if (Method->isCopyAssignmentOperator() ||
14075 (!Copying && Method->isMoveAssignmentOperator()))
14076 continue;
14077
14078 F.erase();
14079 }
14080 F.done();
14081 }
14082
14083 // Suppress the protected check (C++ [class.protected]) for each of the
14084 // assignment operators we found. This strange dance is required when
14085 // we're assigning via a base classes's copy-assignment operator. To
14086 // ensure that we're getting the right base class subobject (without
14087 // ambiguities), we need to cast "this" to that subobject type; to
14088 // ensure that we don't go through the virtual call mechanism, we need
14089 // to qualify the operator= name with the base class (see below). However,
14090 // this means that if the base class has a protected copy assignment
14091 // operator, the protected member access check will fail. So, we
14092 // rewrite "protected" access to "public" access in this case, since we
14093 // know by construction that we're calling from a derived class.
14094 if (CopyingBaseSubobject) {
14095 for (LookupResult::iterator L = OpLookup.begin(), LEnd = OpLookup.end();
14096 L != LEnd; ++L) {
14097 if (L.getAccess() == AS_protected)
14098 L.setAccess(AS_public);
14099 }
14100 }
14101
14102 // Create the nested-name-specifier that will be used to qualify the
14103 // reference to operator=; this is required to suppress the virtual
14104 // call mechanism.
14105 CXXScopeSpec SS;
14106 const Type *CanonicalT = S.Context.getCanonicalType(T.getTypePtr());
14107 SS.MakeTrivial(S.Context,
14108 NestedNameSpecifier::Create(S.Context, nullptr, false,
14109 CanonicalT),
14110 Loc);
14111
14112 // Create the reference to operator=.
14113 ExprResult OpEqualRef
14114 = S.BuildMemberReferenceExpr(To.build(S, Loc), T, Loc, /*IsArrow=*/false,
14115 SS, /*TemplateKWLoc=*/SourceLocation(),
14116 /*FirstQualifierInScope=*/nullptr,
14117 OpLookup,
14118 /*TemplateArgs=*/nullptr, /*S*/nullptr,
14119 /*SuppressQualifierCheck=*/true);
14120 if (OpEqualRef.isInvalid())
14121 return StmtError();
14122
14123 // Build the call to the assignment operator.
14124
14125 Expr *FromInst = From.build(S, Loc);
14126 ExprResult Call = S.BuildCallToMemberFunction(/*Scope=*/nullptr,
14127 OpEqualRef.getAs<Expr>(),
14128 Loc, FromInst, Loc);
14129 if (Call.isInvalid())
14130 return StmtError();
14131
14132 // If we built a call to a trivial 'operator=' while copying an array,
14133 // bail out. We'll replace the whole shebang with a memcpy.
14134 CXXMemberCallExpr *CE = dyn_cast<CXXMemberCallExpr>(Call.get());
14135 if (CE && CE->getMethodDecl()->isTrivial() && Depth)
14136 return StmtResult((Stmt*)nullptr);
14137
14138 // Convert to an expression-statement, and clean up any produced
14139 // temporaries.
14140 return S.ActOnExprStmt(Call);
14141 }
14142
14143 // - if the subobject is of scalar type, the built-in assignment
14144 // operator is used.
14145 const ConstantArrayType *ArrayTy = S.Context.getAsConstantArrayType(T);
14146 if (!ArrayTy) {
14147 ExprResult Assignment = S.CreateBuiltinBinOp(
14148 Loc, BO_Assign, To.build(S, Loc), From.build(S, Loc));
14149 if (Assignment.isInvalid())
14150 return StmtError();
14151 return S.ActOnExprStmt(Assignment);
14152 }
14153
14154 // - if the subobject is an array, each element is assigned, in the
14155 // manner appropriate to the element type;
14156
14157 // Construct a loop over the array bounds, e.g.,
14158 //
14159 // for (__SIZE_TYPE__ i0 = 0; i0 != array-size; ++i0)
14160 //
14161 // that will copy each of the array elements.
14162 QualType SizeType = S.Context.getSizeType();
14163
14164 // Create the iteration variable.
14165 IdentifierInfo *IterationVarName = nullptr;
14166 {
14167 SmallString<8> Str;
14168 llvm::raw_svector_ostream OS(Str);
14169 OS << "__i" << Depth;
14170 IterationVarName = &S.Context.Idents.get(OS.str());
14171 }
14172 VarDecl *IterationVar = VarDecl::Create(S.Context, S.CurContext, Loc, Loc,
14173 IterationVarName, SizeType,
14174 S.Context.getTrivialTypeSourceInfo(SizeType, Loc),
14175 SC_None);
14176
14177 // Initialize the iteration variable to zero.
14178 llvm::APInt Zero(S.Context.getTypeSize(SizeType), 0);
14179 IterationVar->setInit(IntegerLiteral::Create(S.Context, Zero, SizeType, Loc));
14180
14181 // Creates a reference to the iteration variable.
14182 RefBuilder IterationVarRef(IterationVar, SizeType);
14183 LvalueConvBuilder IterationVarRefRVal(IterationVarRef);
14184
14185 // Create the DeclStmt that holds the iteration variable.
14186 Stmt *InitStmt = new (S.Context) DeclStmt(DeclGroupRef(IterationVar),Loc,Loc);
14187
14188 // Subscript the "from" and "to" expressions with the iteration variable.
14189 SubscriptBuilder FromIndexCopy(From, IterationVarRefRVal);
14190 MoveCastBuilder FromIndexMove(FromIndexCopy);
14191 const ExprBuilder *FromIndex;
14192 if (Copying)
14193 FromIndex = &FromIndexCopy;
14194 else
14195 FromIndex = &FromIndexMove;
14196
14197 SubscriptBuilder ToIndex(To, IterationVarRefRVal);
14198
14199 // Build the copy/move for an individual element of the array.
14200 StmtResult Copy =
14201 buildSingleCopyAssignRecursively(S, Loc, ArrayTy->getElementType(),
14202 ToIndex, *FromIndex, CopyingBaseSubobject,
14203 Copying, Depth + 1);
14204 // Bail out if copying fails or if we determined that we should use memcpy.
14205 if (Copy.isInvalid() || !Copy.get())
14206 return Copy;
14207
14208 // Create the comparison against the array bound.
14209 llvm::APInt Upper
14210 = ArrayTy->getSize().zextOrTrunc(S.Context.getTypeSize(SizeType));
14211 Expr *Comparison = BinaryOperator::Create(
14212 S.Context, IterationVarRefRVal.build(S, Loc),
14213 IntegerLiteral::Create(S.Context, Upper, SizeType, Loc), BO_NE,
14214 S.Context.BoolTy, VK_PRValue, OK_Ordinary, Loc,
14215 S.CurFPFeatureOverrides());
14216
14217 // Create the pre-increment of the iteration variable. We can determine
14218 // whether the increment will overflow based on the value of the array
14219 // bound.
14220 Expr *Increment = UnaryOperator::Create(
14221 S.Context, IterationVarRef.build(S, Loc), UO_PreInc, SizeType, VK_LValue,
14222 OK_Ordinary, Loc, Upper.isMaxValue(), S.CurFPFeatureOverrides());
14223
14224 // Construct the loop that copies all elements of this array.
14225 return S.ActOnForStmt(
14226 Loc, Loc, InitStmt,
14227 S.ActOnCondition(nullptr, Loc, Comparison, Sema::ConditionKind::Boolean),
14228 S.MakeFullDiscardedValueExpr(Increment), Loc, Copy.get());
14229}
14230
14231static StmtResult
14232buildSingleCopyAssign(Sema &S, SourceLocation Loc, QualType T,
14233 const ExprBuilder &To, const ExprBuilder &From,
14234 bool CopyingBaseSubobject, bool Copying) {
14235 // Maybe we should use a memcpy?
14236 if (T->isArrayType() && !T.isConstQualified() && !T.isVolatileQualified() &&
14237 T.isTriviallyCopyableType(S.Context))
14238 return buildMemcpyForAssignmentOp(S, Loc, T, To, From);
14239
14240 StmtResult Result(buildSingleCopyAssignRecursively(S, Loc, T, To, From,
14241 CopyingBaseSubobject,
14242 Copying, 0));
14243
14244 // If we ended up picking a trivial assignment operator for an array of a
14245 // non-trivially-copyable class type, just emit a memcpy.
14246 if (!Result.isInvalid() && !Result.get())
14247 return buildMemcpyForAssignmentOp(S, Loc, T, To, From);
14248
14249 return Result;
14250}
14251
14252CXXMethodDecl *Sema::DeclareImplicitCopyAssignment(CXXRecordDecl *ClassDecl) {
14253 // Note: The following rules are largely analoguous to the copy
14254 // constructor rules. Note that virtual bases are not taken into account
14255 // for determining the argument type of the operator. Note also that
14256 // operators taking an object instead of a reference are allowed.
14257 assert(ClassDecl->needsImplicitCopyAssignment());
14258
14259 DeclaringSpecialMember DSM(*this, ClassDecl, CXXCopyAssignment);
14260 if (DSM.isAlreadyBeingDeclared())
14261 return nullptr;
14262
14263 QualType ArgType = Context.getTypeDeclType(ClassDecl);
14264 LangAS AS = getDefaultCXXMethodAddrSpace();
14265 if (AS != LangAS::Default)
14266 ArgType = Context.getAddrSpaceQualType(ArgType, AS);
14267 QualType RetType = Context.getLValueReferenceType(ArgType);
14268 bool Const = ClassDecl->implicitCopyAssignmentHasConstParam();
14269 if (Const)
14270 ArgType = ArgType.withConst();
14271
14272 ArgType = Context.getLValueReferenceType(ArgType);
14273
14274 bool Constexpr = defaultedSpecialMemberIsConstexpr(*this, ClassDecl,
14275 CXXCopyAssignment,
14276 Const);
14277
14278 // An implicitly-declared copy assignment operator is an inline public
14279 // member of its class.
14280 DeclarationName Name = Context.DeclarationNames.getCXXOperatorName(OO_Equal);
14281 SourceLocation ClassLoc = ClassDecl->getLocation();
14282 DeclarationNameInfo NameInfo(Name, ClassLoc);
14283 CXXMethodDecl *CopyAssignment = CXXMethodDecl::Create(
14284 Context, ClassDecl, ClassLoc, NameInfo, QualType(),
14285 /*TInfo=*/nullptr, /*StorageClass=*/SC_None,
14286 getCurFPFeatures().isFPConstrained(),
14287 /*isInline=*/true,
14288 Constexpr ? ConstexprSpecKind::Constexpr : ConstexprSpecKind::Unspecified,
14289 SourceLocation());
14290 CopyAssignment->setAccess(AS_public);
14291 CopyAssignment->setDefaulted();
14292 CopyAssignment->setImplicit();
14293
14294 if (getLangOpts().CUDA) {
14295 inferCUDATargetForImplicitSpecialMember(ClassDecl, CXXCopyAssignment,
14296 CopyAssignment,
14297 /* ConstRHS */ Const,
14298 /* Diagnose */ false);
14299 }
14300
14301 setupImplicitSpecialMemberType(CopyAssignment, RetType, ArgType);
14302
14303 // Add the parameter to the operator.
14304 ParmVarDecl *FromParam = ParmVarDecl::Create(Context, CopyAssignment,
14305 ClassLoc, ClassLoc,
14306 /*Id=*/nullptr, ArgType,
14307 /*TInfo=*/nullptr, SC_None,
14308 nullptr);
14309 CopyAssignment->setParams(FromParam);
14310
14311 CopyAssignment->setTrivial(
14312 ClassDecl->needsOverloadResolutionForCopyAssignment()
14313 ? SpecialMemberIsTrivial(CopyAssignment, CXXCopyAssignment)
14314 : ClassDecl->hasTrivialCopyAssignment());
14315
14316 // Note that we have added this copy-assignment operator.
14317 ++getASTContext().NumImplicitCopyAssignmentOperatorsDeclared;
14318
14319 Scope *S = getScopeForContext(ClassDecl);
14320 CheckImplicitSpecialMemberDeclaration(S, CopyAssignment);
14321
14322 if (ShouldDeleteSpecialMember(CopyAssignment, CXXCopyAssignment)) {
14323 ClassDecl->setImplicitCopyAssignmentIsDeleted();
14324 SetDeclDeleted(CopyAssignment, ClassLoc);
14325 }
14326
14327 if (S)
14328 PushOnScopeChains(CopyAssignment, S, false);
14329 ClassDecl->addDecl(CopyAssignment);
14330
14331 return CopyAssignment;
14332}
14333
14334/// Diagnose an implicit copy operation for a class which is odr-used, but
14335/// which is deprecated because the class has a user-declared copy constructor,
14336/// copy assignment operator, or destructor.
14337static void diagnoseDeprecatedCopyOperation(Sema &S, CXXMethodDecl *CopyOp) {
14338 assert(CopyOp->isImplicit());
14339
14340 CXXRecordDecl *RD = CopyOp->getParent();
14341 CXXMethodDecl *UserDeclaredOperation = nullptr;
14342
14343 // In Microsoft mode, assignment operations don't affect constructors and
14344 // vice versa.
14345 if (RD->hasUserDeclaredDestructor()) {
14346 UserDeclaredOperation = RD->getDestructor();
14347 } else if (!isa<CXXConstructorDecl>(CopyOp) &&
14348 RD->hasUserDeclaredCopyConstructor() &&
14349 !S.getLangOpts().MSVCCompat) {
14350 // Find any user-declared copy constructor.
14351 for (auto *I : RD->ctors()) {
14352 if (I->isCopyConstructor()) {
14353 UserDeclaredOperation = I;
14354 break;
14355 }
14356 }
14357 assert(UserDeclaredOperation);
14358 } else if (isa<CXXConstructorDecl>(CopyOp) &&
14359 RD->hasUserDeclaredCopyAssignment() &&
14360 !S.getLangOpts().MSVCCompat) {
14361 // Find any user-declared move assignment operator.
14362 for (auto *I : RD->methods()) {
14363 if (I->isCopyAssignmentOperator()) {
14364 UserDeclaredOperation = I;
14365 break;
14366 }
14367 }
14368 assert(UserDeclaredOperation);
14369 }
14370
14371 if (UserDeclaredOperation) {
14372 bool UDOIsUserProvided = UserDeclaredOperation->isUserProvided();
14373 bool UDOIsDestructor = isa<CXXDestructorDecl>(UserDeclaredOperation);
14374 bool IsCopyAssignment = !isa<CXXConstructorDecl>(CopyOp);
14375 unsigned DiagID =
14376 (UDOIsUserProvided && UDOIsDestructor)
14377 ? diag::warn_deprecated_copy_with_user_provided_dtor
14378 : (UDOIsUserProvided && !UDOIsDestructor)
14379 ? diag::warn_deprecated_copy_with_user_provided_copy
14380 : (!UDOIsUserProvided && UDOIsDestructor)
14381 ? diag::warn_deprecated_copy_with_dtor
14382 : diag::warn_deprecated_copy;
14383 S.Diag(UserDeclaredOperation->getLocation(), DiagID)
14384 << RD << IsCopyAssignment;
14385 }
14386}
14387
14388void Sema::DefineImplicitCopyAssignment(SourceLocation CurrentLocation,
14389 CXXMethodDecl *CopyAssignOperator) {
14390 assert((CopyAssignOperator->isDefaulted() &&
14391 CopyAssignOperator->isOverloadedOperator() &&
14392 CopyAssignOperator->getOverloadedOperator() == OO_Equal &&
14393 !CopyAssignOperator->doesThisDeclarationHaveABody() &&
14394 !CopyAssignOperator->isDeleted()) &&
14395 "DefineImplicitCopyAssignment called for wrong function");
14396 if (CopyAssignOperator->willHaveBody() || CopyAssignOperator->isInvalidDecl())
14397 return;
14398
14399 CXXRecordDecl *ClassDecl = CopyAssignOperator->getParent();
14400 if (ClassDecl->isInvalidDecl()) {
14401 CopyAssignOperator->setInvalidDecl();
14402 return;
14403 }
14404
14405 SynthesizedFunctionScope Scope(*this, CopyAssignOperator);
14406
14407 // The exception specification is needed because we are defining the
14408 // function.
14409 ResolveExceptionSpec(CurrentLocation,
14410 CopyAssignOperator->getType()->castAs<FunctionProtoType>());
14411
14412 // Add a context note for diagnostics produced after this point.
14413 Scope.addContextNote(CurrentLocation);
14414
14415 // C++11 [class.copy]p18:
14416 // The [definition of an implicitly declared copy assignment operator] is
14417 // deprecated if the class has a user-declared copy constructor or a
14418 // user-declared destructor.
14419 if (getLangOpts().CPlusPlus11 && CopyAssignOperator->isImplicit())
14420 diagnoseDeprecatedCopyOperation(*this, CopyAssignOperator);
14421
14422 // C++0x [class.copy]p30:
14423 // The implicitly-defined or explicitly-defaulted copy assignment operator
14424 // for a non-union class X performs memberwise copy assignment of its
14425 // subobjects. The direct base classes of X are assigned first, in the
14426 // order of their declaration in the base-specifier-list, and then the
14427 // immediate non-static data members of X are assigned, in the order in
14428 // which they were declared in the class definition.
14429
14430 // The statements that form the synthesized function body.
14431 SmallVector<Stmt*, 8> Statements;
14432
14433 // The parameter for the "other" object, which we are copying from.
14434 ParmVarDecl *Other = CopyAssignOperator->getParamDecl(0);
14435 Qualifiers OtherQuals = Other->getType().getQualifiers();
14436 QualType OtherRefType = Other->getType();
14437 if (const LValueReferenceType *OtherRef
14438 = OtherRefType->getAs<LValueReferenceType>()) {
14439 OtherRefType = OtherRef->getPointeeType();
14440 OtherQuals = OtherRefType.getQualifiers();
14441 }
14442
14443 // Our location for everything implicitly-generated.
14444 SourceLocation Loc = CopyAssignOperator->getEndLoc().isValid()
14445 ? CopyAssignOperator->getEndLoc()
14446 : CopyAssignOperator->getLocation();
14447
14448 // Builds a DeclRefExpr for the "other" object.
14449 RefBuilder OtherRef(Other, OtherRefType);
14450
14451 // Builds the "this" pointer.
14452 ThisBuilder This;
14453
14454 // Assign base classes.
14455 bool Invalid = false;
14456 for (auto &Base : ClassDecl->bases()) {
14457 // Form the assignment:
14458 // static_cast<Base*>(this)->Base::operator=(static_cast<Base&>(other));
14459 QualType BaseType = Base.getType().getUnqualifiedType();
14460 if (!BaseType->isRecordType()) {
14461 Invalid = true;
14462 continue;
14463 }
14464
14465 CXXCastPath BasePath;
14466 BasePath.push_back(&Base);
14467
14468 // Construct the "from" expression, which is an implicit cast to the
14469 // appropriately-qualified base type.
14470 CastBuilder From(OtherRef, Context.getQualifiedType(BaseType, OtherQuals),
14471 VK_LValue, BasePath);
14472
14473 // Dereference "this".
14474 DerefBuilder DerefThis(This);
14475 CastBuilder To(DerefThis,
14476 Context.getQualifiedType(
14477 BaseType, CopyAssignOperator->getMethodQualifiers()),
14478 VK_LValue, BasePath);
14479
14480 // Build the copy.
14481 StmtResult Copy = buildSingleCopyAssign(*this, Loc, BaseType,
14482 To, From,
14483 /*CopyingBaseSubobject=*/true,
14484 /*Copying=*/true);
14485 if (Copy.isInvalid()) {
14486 CopyAssignOperator->setInvalidDecl();
14487 return;
14488 }
14489
14490 // Success! Record the copy.
14491 Statements.push_back(Copy.getAs<Expr>());
14492 }
14493
14494 // Assign non-static members.
14495 for (auto *Field : ClassDecl->fields()) {
14496 // FIXME: We should form some kind of AST representation for the implied
14497 // memcpy in a union copy operation.
14498 if (Field->isUnnamedBitfield() || Field->getParent()->isUnion())
14499 continue;
14500
14501 if (Field->isInvalidDecl()) {
14502 Invalid = true;
14503 continue;
14504 }
14505
14506 // Check for members of reference type; we can't copy those.
14507 if (Field->getType()->isReferenceType()) {
14508 Diag(ClassDecl->getLocation(), diag::err_uninitialized_member_for_assign)
14509 << Context.getTagDeclType(ClassDecl) << 0 << Field->getDeclName();
14510 Diag(Field->getLocation(), diag::note_declared_at);
14511 Invalid = true;
14512 continue;
14513 }
14514
14515 // Check for members of const-qualified, non-class type.
14516 QualType BaseType = Context.getBaseElementType(Field->getType());
14517 if (!BaseType->getAs<RecordType>() && BaseType.isConstQualified()) {
14518 Diag(ClassDecl->getLocation(), diag::err_uninitialized_member_for_assign)
14519 << Context.getTagDeclType(ClassDecl) << 1 << Field->getDeclName();
14520 Diag(Field->getLocation(), diag::note_declared_at);
14521 Invalid = true;
14522 continue;
14523 }
14524
14525 // Suppress assigning zero-width bitfields.
14526 if (Field->isZeroLengthBitField(Context))
14527 continue;
14528
14529 QualType FieldType = Field->getType().getNonReferenceType();
14530 if (FieldType->isIncompleteArrayType()) {
14531 assert(ClassDecl->hasFlexibleArrayMember() &&
14532 "Incomplete array type is not valid");
14533 continue;
14534 }
14535
14536 // Build references to the field in the object we're copying from and to.
14537 CXXScopeSpec SS; // Intentionally empty
14538 LookupResult MemberLookup(*this, Field->getDeclName(), Loc,
14539 LookupMemberName);
14540 MemberLookup.addDecl(Field);
14541 MemberLookup.resolveKind();
14542
14543 MemberBuilder From(OtherRef, OtherRefType, /*IsArrow=*/false, MemberLookup);
14544
14545 MemberBuilder To(This, getCurrentThisType(), /*IsArrow=*/true, MemberLookup);
14546
14547 // Build the copy of this field.
14548 StmtResult Copy = buildSingleCopyAssign(*this, Loc, FieldType,
14549 To, From,
14550 /*CopyingBaseSubobject=*/false,
14551 /*Copying=*/true);
14552 if (Copy.isInvalid()) {
14553 CopyAssignOperator->setInvalidDecl();
14554 return;
14555 }
14556
14557 // Success! Record the copy.
14558 Statements.push_back(Copy.getAs<Stmt>());
14559 }
14560
14561 if (!Invalid) {
14562 // Add a "return *this;"
14563 ExprResult ThisObj = CreateBuiltinUnaryOp(Loc, UO_Deref, This.build(*this, Loc));
14564
14565 StmtResult Return = BuildReturnStmt(Loc, ThisObj.get());
14566 if (Return.isInvalid())
14567 Invalid = true;
14568 else
14569 Statements.push_back(Return.getAs<Stmt>());
14570 }
14571
14572 if (Invalid) {
14573 CopyAssignOperator->setInvalidDecl();
14574 return;
14575 }
14576
14577 StmtResult Body;
14578 {
14579 CompoundScopeRAII CompoundScope(*this);
14580 Body = ActOnCompoundStmt(Loc, Loc, Statements,
14581 /*isStmtExpr=*/false);
14582 assert(!Body.isInvalid() && "Compound statement creation cannot fail");
14583 }
14584 CopyAssignOperator->setBody(Body.getAs<Stmt>());
14585 CopyAssignOperator->markUsed(Context);
14586
14587 if (ASTMutationListener *L = getASTMutationListener()) {
14588 L->CompletedImplicitDefinition(CopyAssignOperator);
14589 }
14590}
14591
14592CXXMethodDecl *Sema::DeclareImplicitMoveAssignment(CXXRecordDecl *ClassDecl) {
14593 assert(ClassDecl->needsImplicitMoveAssignment());
14594
14595 DeclaringSpecialMember DSM(*this, ClassDecl, CXXMoveAssignment);
14596 if (DSM.isAlreadyBeingDeclared())
14597 return nullptr;
14598
14599 // Note: The following rules are largely analoguous to the move
14600 // constructor rules.
14601
14602 QualType ArgType = Context.getTypeDeclType(ClassDecl);
14603 LangAS AS = getDefaultCXXMethodAddrSpace();
14604 if (AS != LangAS::Default)
14605 ArgType = Context.getAddrSpaceQualType(ArgType, AS);
14606 QualType RetType = Context.getLValueReferenceType(ArgType);
14607 ArgType = Context.getRValueReferenceType(ArgType);
14608
14609 bool Constexpr = defaultedSpecialMemberIsConstexpr(*this, ClassDecl,
14610 CXXMoveAssignment,
14611 false);
14612
14613 // An implicitly-declared move assignment operator is an inline public
14614 // member of its class.
14615 DeclarationName Name = Context.DeclarationNames.getCXXOperatorName(OO_Equal);
14616 SourceLocation ClassLoc = ClassDecl->getLocation();
14617 DeclarationNameInfo NameInfo(Name, ClassLoc);
14618 CXXMethodDecl *MoveAssignment = CXXMethodDecl::Create(
14619 Context, ClassDecl, ClassLoc, NameInfo, QualType(),
14620 /*TInfo=*/nullptr, /*StorageClass=*/SC_None,
14621 getCurFPFeatures().isFPConstrained(),
14622 /*isInline=*/true,
14623 Constexpr ? ConstexprSpecKind::Constexpr : ConstexprSpecKind::Unspecified,
14624 SourceLocation());
14625 MoveAssignment->setAccess(AS_public);
14626 MoveAssignment->setDefaulted();
14627 MoveAssignment->setImplicit();
14628
14629 if (getLangOpts().CUDA) {
14630 inferCUDATargetForImplicitSpecialMember(ClassDecl, CXXMoveAssignment,
14631 MoveAssignment,
14632 /* ConstRHS */ false,
14633 /* Diagnose */ false);
14634 }
14635
14636 setupImplicitSpecialMemberType(MoveAssignment, RetType, ArgType);
14637
14638 // Add the parameter to the operator.
14639 ParmVarDecl *FromParam = ParmVarDecl::Create(Context, MoveAssignment,
14640 ClassLoc, ClassLoc,
14641 /*Id=*/nullptr, ArgType,
14642 /*TInfo=*/nullptr, SC_None,
14643 nullptr);
14644 MoveAssignment->setParams(FromParam);
14645
14646 MoveAssignment->setTrivial(
14647 ClassDecl->needsOverloadResolutionForMoveAssignment()
14648 ? SpecialMemberIsTrivial(MoveAssignment, CXXMoveAssignment)
14649 : ClassDecl->hasTrivialMoveAssignment());
14650
14651 // Note that we have added this copy-assignment operator.
14652 ++getASTContext().NumImplicitMoveAssignmentOperatorsDeclared;
14653
14654 Scope *S = getScopeForContext(ClassDecl);
14655 CheckImplicitSpecialMemberDeclaration(S, MoveAssignment);
14656
14657 if (ShouldDeleteSpecialMember(MoveAssignment, CXXMoveAssignment)) {
14658 ClassDecl->setImplicitMoveAssignmentIsDeleted();
14659 SetDeclDeleted(MoveAssignment, ClassLoc);
14660 }
14661
14662 if (S)
14663 PushOnScopeChains(MoveAssignment, S, false);
14664 ClassDecl->addDecl(MoveAssignment);
14665
14666 return MoveAssignment;
14667}
14668
14669/// Check if we're implicitly defining a move assignment operator for a class
14670/// with virtual bases. Such a move assignment might move-assign the virtual
14671/// base multiple times.
14672static void checkMoveAssignmentForRepeatedMove(Sema &S, CXXRecordDecl *Class,
14673 SourceLocation CurrentLocation) {
14674 assert(!Class->isDependentContext() && "should not define dependent move");
14675
14676 // Only a virtual base could get implicitly move-assigned multiple times.
14677 // Only a non-trivial move assignment can observe this. We only want to
14678 // diagnose if we implicitly define an assignment operator that assigns
14679 // two base classes, both of which move-assign the same virtual base.
14680 if (Class->getNumVBases() == 0 || Class->hasTrivialMoveAssignment() ||
14681 Class->getNumBases() < 2)
14682 return;
14683
14684 llvm::SmallVector<CXXBaseSpecifier *, 16> Worklist;
14685 typedef llvm::DenseMap<CXXRecordDecl*, CXXBaseSpecifier*> VBaseMap;
14686 VBaseMap VBases;
14687
14688 for (auto &BI : Class->bases()) {
14689 Worklist.push_back(&BI);
14690 while (!Worklist.empty()) {
14691 CXXBaseSpecifier *BaseSpec = Worklist.pop_back_val();
14692 CXXRecordDecl *Base = BaseSpec->getType()->getAsCXXRecordDecl();
14693
14694 // If the base has no non-trivial move assignment operators,
14695 // we don't care about moves from it.
14696 if (!Base->hasNonTrivialMoveAssignment())
14697 continue;
14698
14699 // If there's nothing virtual here, skip it.
14700 if (!BaseSpec->isVirtual() && !Base->getNumVBases())
14701 continue;
14702
14703 // If we're not actually going to call a move assignment for this base,
14704 // or the selected move assignment is trivial, skip it.
14705 Sema::SpecialMemberOverloadResult SMOR =
14706 S.LookupSpecialMember(Base, Sema::CXXMoveAssignment,
14707 /*ConstArg*/false, /*VolatileArg*/false,
14708 /*RValueThis*/true, /*ConstThis*/false,
14709 /*VolatileThis*/false);
14710 if (!SMOR.getMethod() || SMOR.getMethod()->isTrivial() ||
14711 !SMOR.getMethod()->isMoveAssignmentOperator())
14712 continue;
14713
14714 if (BaseSpec->isVirtual()) {
14715 // We're going to move-assign this virtual base, and its move
14716 // assignment operator is not trivial. If this can happen for
14717 // multiple distinct direct bases of Class, diagnose it. (If it
14718 // only happens in one base, we'll diagnose it when synthesizing
14719 // that base class's move assignment operator.)
14720 CXXBaseSpecifier *&Existing =
14721 VBases.insert(std::make_pair(Base->getCanonicalDecl(), &BI))
14722 .first->second;
14723 if (Existing && Existing != &BI) {
14724 S.Diag(CurrentLocation, diag::warn_vbase_moved_multiple_times)
14725 << Class << Base;
14726 S.Diag(Existing->getBeginLoc(), diag::note_vbase_moved_here)
14727 << (Base->getCanonicalDecl() ==
14728 Existing->getType()->getAsCXXRecordDecl()->getCanonicalDecl())
14729 << Base << Existing->getType() << Existing->getSourceRange();
14730 S.Diag(BI.getBeginLoc(), diag::note_vbase_moved_here)
14731 << (Base->getCanonicalDecl() ==
14732 BI.getType()->getAsCXXRecordDecl()->getCanonicalDecl())
14733 << Base << BI.getType() << BaseSpec->getSourceRange();
14734
14735 // Only diagnose each vbase once.
14736 Existing = nullptr;
14737 }
14738 } else {
14739 // Only walk over bases that have defaulted move assignment operators.
14740 // We assume that any user-provided move assignment operator handles
14741 // the multiple-moves-of-vbase case itself somehow.
14742 if (!SMOR.getMethod()->isDefaulted())
14743 continue;
14744
14745 // We're going to move the base classes of Base. Add them to the list.
14746 for (auto &BI : Base->bases())
14747 Worklist.push_back(&BI);
14748 }
14749 }
14750 }
14751}
14752
14753void Sema::DefineImplicitMoveAssignment(SourceLocation CurrentLocation,
14754 CXXMethodDecl *MoveAssignOperator) {
14755 assert((MoveAssignOperator->isDefaulted() &&
14756 MoveAssignOperator->isOverloadedOperator() &&
14757 MoveAssignOperator->getOverloadedOperator() == OO_Equal &&
14758 !MoveAssignOperator->doesThisDeclarationHaveABody() &&
14759 !MoveAssignOperator->isDeleted()) &&
14760 "DefineImplicitMoveAssignment called for wrong function");
14761 if (MoveAssignOperator->willHaveBody() || MoveAssignOperator->isInvalidDecl())
14762 return;
14763
14764 CXXRecordDecl *ClassDecl = MoveAssignOperator->getParent();
14765 if (ClassDecl->isInvalidDecl()) {
14766 MoveAssignOperator->setInvalidDecl();
14767 return;
14768 }
14769
14770 // C++0x [class.copy]p28:
14771 // The implicitly-defined or move assignment operator for a non-union class
14772 // X performs memberwise move assignment of its subobjects. The direct base
14773 // classes of X are assigned first, in the order of their declaration in the
14774 // base-specifier-list, and then the immediate non-static data members of X
14775 // are assigned, in the order in which they were declared in the class
14776 // definition.
14777
14778 // Issue a warning if our implicit move assignment operator will move
14779 // from a virtual base more than once.
14780 checkMoveAssignmentForRepeatedMove(*this, ClassDecl, CurrentLocation);
14781
14782 SynthesizedFunctionScope Scope(*this, MoveAssignOperator);
14783
14784 // The exception specification is needed because we are defining the
14785 // function.
14786 ResolveExceptionSpec(CurrentLocation,
14787 MoveAssignOperator->getType()->castAs<FunctionProtoType>());
14788
14789 // Add a context note for diagnostics produced after this point.
14790 Scope.addContextNote(CurrentLocation);
14791
14792 // The statements that form the synthesized function body.
14793 SmallVector<Stmt*, 8> Statements;
14794
14795 // The parameter for the "other" object, which we are move from.
14796 ParmVarDecl *Other = MoveAssignOperator->getParamDecl(0);
14797 QualType OtherRefType =
14798 Other->getType()->castAs<RValueReferenceType>()->getPointeeType();
14799
14800 // Our location for everything implicitly-generated.
14801 SourceLocation Loc = MoveAssignOperator->getEndLoc().isValid()
14802 ? MoveAssignOperator->getEndLoc()
14803 : MoveAssignOperator->getLocation();
14804
14805 // Builds a reference to the "other" object.
14806 RefBuilder OtherRef(Other, OtherRefType);
14807 // Cast to rvalue.
14808 MoveCastBuilder MoveOther(OtherRef);
14809
14810 // Builds the "this" pointer.
14811 ThisBuilder This;
14812
14813 // Assign base classes.
14814 bool Invalid = false;
14815 for (auto &Base : ClassDecl->bases()) {
14816 // C++11 [class.copy]p28:
14817 // It is unspecified whether subobjects representing virtual base classes
14818 // are assigned more than once by the implicitly-defined copy assignment
14819 // operator.
14820 // FIXME: Do not assign to a vbase that will be assigned by some other base
14821 // class. For a move-assignment, this can result in the vbase being moved
14822 // multiple times.
14823
14824 // Form the assignment:
14825 // static_cast<Base*>(this)->Base::operator=(static_cast<Base&&>(other));
14826 QualType BaseType = Base.getType().getUnqualifiedType();
14827 if (!BaseType->isRecordType()) {
14828 Invalid = true;
14829 continue;
14830 }
14831
14832 CXXCastPath BasePath;
14833 BasePath.push_back(&Base);
14834
14835 // Construct the "from" expression, which is an implicit cast to the
14836 // appropriately-qualified base type.
14837 CastBuilder From(OtherRef, BaseType, VK_XValue, BasePath);
14838
14839 // Dereference "this".
14840 DerefBuilder DerefThis(This);
14841
14842 // Implicitly cast "this" to the appropriately-qualified base type.
14843 CastBuilder To(DerefThis,
14844 Context.getQualifiedType(
14845 BaseType, MoveAssignOperator->getMethodQualifiers()),
14846 VK_LValue, BasePath);
14847
14848 // Build the move.
14849 StmtResult Move = buildSingleCopyAssign(*this, Loc, BaseType,
14850 To, From,
14851 /*CopyingBaseSubobject=*/true,
14852 /*Copying=*/false);
14853 if (Move.isInvalid()) {
14854 MoveAssignOperator->setInvalidDecl();
14855 return;
14856 }
14857
14858 // Success! Record the move.
14859 Statements.push_back(Move.getAs<Expr>());
14860 }
14861
14862 // Assign non-static members.
14863 for (auto *Field : ClassDecl->fields()) {
14864 // FIXME: We should form some kind of AST representation for the implied
14865 // memcpy in a union copy operation.
14866 if (Field->isUnnamedBitfield() || Field->getParent()->isUnion())
14867 continue;
14868
14869 if (Field->isInvalidDecl()) {
14870 Invalid = true;
14871 continue;
14872 }
14873
14874 // Check for members of reference type; we can't move those.
14875 if (Field->getType()->isReferenceType()) {
14876 Diag(ClassDecl->getLocation(), diag::err_uninitialized_member_for_assign)
14877 << Context.getTagDeclType(ClassDecl) << 0 << Field->getDeclName();
14878 Diag(Field->getLocation(), diag::note_declared_at);
14879 Invalid = true;
14880 continue;
14881 }
14882
14883 // Check for members of const-qualified, non-class type.
14884 QualType BaseType = Context.getBaseElementType(Field->getType());
14885 if (!BaseType->getAs<RecordType>() && BaseType.isConstQualified()) {
14886 Diag(ClassDecl->getLocation(), diag::err_uninitialized_member_for_assign)
14887 << Context.getTagDeclType(ClassDecl) << 1 << Field->getDeclName();
14888 Diag(Field->getLocation(), diag::note_declared_at);
14889 Invalid = true;
14890 continue;
14891 }
14892
14893 // Suppress assigning zero-width bitfields.
14894 if (Field->isZeroLengthBitField(Context))
14895 continue;
14896
14897 QualType FieldType = Field->getType().getNonReferenceType();
14898 if (FieldType->isIncompleteArrayType()) {
14899 assert(ClassDecl->hasFlexibleArrayMember() &&
14900 "Incomplete array type is not valid");
14901 continue;
14902 }
14903
14904 // Build references to the field in the object we're copying from and to.
14905 LookupResult MemberLookup(*this, Field->getDeclName(), Loc,
14906 LookupMemberName);
14907 MemberLookup.addDecl(Field);
14908 MemberLookup.resolveKind();
14909 MemberBuilder From(MoveOther, OtherRefType,
14910 /*IsArrow=*/false, MemberLookup);
14911 MemberBuilder To(This, getCurrentThisType(),
14912 /*IsArrow=*/true, MemberLookup);
14913
14914 assert(!From.build(*this, Loc)->isLValue() && // could be xvalue or prvalue
14915 "Member reference with rvalue base must be rvalue except for reference "
14916 "members, which aren't allowed for move assignment.");
14917
14918 // Build the move of this field.
14919 StmtResult Move = buildSingleCopyAssign(*this, Loc, FieldType,
14920 To, From,
14921 /*CopyingBaseSubobject=*/false,
14922 /*Copying=*/false);
14923 if (Move.isInvalid()) {
14924 MoveAssignOperator->setInvalidDecl();
14925 return;
14926 }
14927
14928 // Success! Record the copy.
14929 Statements.push_back(Move.getAs<Stmt>());
14930 }
14931
14932 if (!Invalid) {
14933 // Add a "return *this;"
14934 ExprResult ThisObj =
14935 CreateBuiltinUnaryOp(Loc, UO_Deref, This.build(*this, Loc));
14936
14937 StmtResult Return = BuildReturnStmt(Loc, ThisObj.get());
14938 if (Return.isInvalid())
14939 Invalid = true;
14940 else
14941 Statements.push_back(Return.getAs<Stmt>());
14942 }
14943
14944 if (Invalid) {
14945 MoveAssignOperator->setInvalidDecl();
14946 return;
14947 }
14948
14949 StmtResult Body;
14950 {
14951 CompoundScopeRAII CompoundScope(*this);
14952 Body = ActOnCompoundStmt(Loc, Loc, Statements,
14953 /*isStmtExpr=*/false);
14954 assert(!Body.isInvalid() && "Compound statement creation cannot fail");
14955 }
14956 MoveAssignOperator->setBody(Body.getAs<Stmt>());
14957 MoveAssignOperator->markUsed(Context);
14958
14959 if (ASTMutationListener *L = getASTMutationListener()) {
14960 L->CompletedImplicitDefinition(MoveAssignOperator);
14961 }
14962}
14963
14964CXXConstructorDecl *Sema::DeclareImplicitCopyConstructor(
14965 CXXRecordDecl *ClassDecl) {
14966 // C++ [class.copy]p4:
14967 // If the class definition does not explicitly declare a copy
14968 // constructor, one is declared implicitly.
14969 assert(ClassDecl->needsImplicitCopyConstructor());
14970
14971 DeclaringSpecialMember DSM(*this, ClassDecl, CXXCopyConstructor);
14972 if (DSM.isAlreadyBeingDeclared())
14973 return nullptr;
14974
14975 QualType ClassType = Context.getTypeDeclType(ClassDecl);
14976 QualType ArgType = ClassType;
14977 bool Const = ClassDecl->implicitCopyConstructorHasConstParam();
14978 if (Const)
14979 ArgType = ArgType.withConst();
14980
14981 LangAS AS = getDefaultCXXMethodAddrSpace();
14982 if (AS != LangAS::Default)
14983 ArgType = Context.getAddrSpaceQualType(ArgType, AS);
14984
14985 ArgType = Context.getLValueReferenceType(ArgType);
14986
14987 bool Constexpr = defaultedSpecialMemberIsConstexpr(*this, ClassDecl,
14988 CXXCopyConstructor,
14989 Const);
14990
14991 DeclarationName Name
14992 = Context.DeclarationNames.getCXXConstructorName(
14993 Context.getCanonicalType(ClassType));
14994 SourceLocation ClassLoc = ClassDecl->getLocation();
14995 DeclarationNameInfo NameInfo(Name, ClassLoc);
14996
14997 // An implicitly-declared copy constructor is an inline public
14998 // member of its class.
14999 CXXConstructorDecl *CopyConstructor = CXXConstructorDecl::Create(
15000 Context, ClassDecl, ClassLoc, NameInfo, QualType(), /*TInfo=*/nullptr,
15001 ExplicitSpecifier(), getCurFPFeatures().isFPConstrained(),
15002 /*isInline=*/true,
15003 /*isImplicitlyDeclared=*/true,
15004 Constexpr ? ConstexprSpecKind::Constexpr
15005 : ConstexprSpecKind::Unspecified);
15006 CopyConstructor->setAccess(AS_public);
15007 CopyConstructor->setDefaulted();
15008
15009 if (getLangOpts().CUDA) {
15010 inferCUDATargetForImplicitSpecialMember(ClassDecl, CXXCopyConstructor,
15011 CopyConstructor,
15012 /* ConstRHS */ Const,
15013 /* Diagnose */ false);
15014 }
15015
15016 setupImplicitSpecialMemberType(CopyConstructor, Context.VoidTy, ArgType);
15017
15018 // During template instantiation of special member functions we need a
15019 // reliable TypeSourceInfo for the parameter types in order to allow functions
15020 // to be substituted.
15021 TypeSourceInfo *TSI = nullptr;
15022 if (inTemplateInstantiation() && ClassDecl->isLambda())
15023 TSI = Context.getTrivialTypeSourceInfo(ArgType);
15024
15025 // Add the parameter to the constructor.
15026 ParmVarDecl *FromParam =
15027 ParmVarDecl::Create(Context, CopyConstructor, ClassLoc, ClassLoc,
15028 /*IdentifierInfo=*/nullptr, ArgType,
15029 /*TInfo=*/TSI, SC_None, nullptr);
15030 CopyConstructor->setParams(FromParam);
15031
15032 CopyConstructor->setTrivial(
15033 ClassDecl->needsOverloadResolutionForCopyConstructor()
15034 ? SpecialMemberIsTrivial(CopyConstructor, CXXCopyConstructor)
15035 : ClassDecl->hasTrivialCopyConstructor());
15036
15037 CopyConstructor->setTrivialForCall(
15038 ClassDecl->hasAttr<TrivialABIAttr>() ||
15039 (ClassDecl->needsOverloadResolutionForCopyConstructor()
15040 ? SpecialMemberIsTrivial(CopyConstructor, CXXCopyConstructor,
15041 TAH_ConsiderTrivialABI)
15042 : ClassDecl->hasTrivialCopyConstructorForCall()));
15043
15044 // Note that we have declared this constructor.
15045 ++getASTContext().NumImplicitCopyConstructorsDeclared;
15046
15047 Scope *S = getScopeForContext(ClassDecl);
15048 CheckImplicitSpecialMemberDeclaration(S, CopyConstructor);
15049
15050 if (ShouldDeleteSpecialMember(CopyConstructor, CXXCopyConstructor)) {
15051 ClassDecl->setImplicitCopyConstructorIsDeleted();
15052 SetDeclDeleted(CopyConstructor, ClassLoc);
15053 }
15054
15055 if (S)
15056 PushOnScopeChains(CopyConstructor, S, false);
15057 ClassDecl->addDecl(CopyConstructor);
15058
15059 return CopyConstructor;
15060}
15061
15062void Sema::DefineImplicitCopyConstructor(SourceLocation CurrentLocation,
15063 CXXConstructorDecl *CopyConstructor) {
15064 assert((CopyConstructor->isDefaulted() &&
15065 CopyConstructor->isCopyConstructor() &&
15066 !CopyConstructor->doesThisDeclarationHaveABody() &&
15067 !CopyConstructor->isDeleted()) &&
15068 "DefineImplicitCopyConstructor - call it for implicit copy ctor");
15069 if (CopyConstructor->willHaveBody() || CopyConstructor->isInvalidDecl())
15070 return;
15071
15072 CXXRecordDecl *ClassDecl = CopyConstructor->getParent();
15073 assert(ClassDecl && "DefineImplicitCopyConstructor - invalid constructor");
15074
15075 SynthesizedFunctionScope Scope(*this, CopyConstructor);
15076
15077 // The exception specification is needed because we are defining the
15078 // function.
15079 ResolveExceptionSpec(CurrentLocation,
15080 CopyConstructor->getType()->castAs<FunctionProtoType>());
15081 MarkVTableUsed(CurrentLocation, ClassDecl);
15082
15083 // Add a context note for diagnostics produced after this point.
15084 Scope.addContextNote(CurrentLocation);
15085
15086 // C++11 [class.copy]p7:
15087 // The [definition of an implicitly declared copy constructor] is
15088 // deprecated if the class has a user-declared copy assignment operator
15089 // or a user-declared destructor.
15090 if (getLangOpts().CPlusPlus11 && CopyConstructor->isImplicit())
15091 diagnoseDeprecatedCopyOperation(*this, CopyConstructor);
15092
15093 if (SetCtorInitializers(CopyConstructor, /*AnyErrors=*/false)) {
15094 CopyConstructor->setInvalidDecl();
15095 } else {
15096 SourceLocation Loc = CopyConstructor->getEndLoc().isValid()
15097 ? CopyConstructor->getEndLoc()
15098 : CopyConstructor->getLocation();
15099 Sema::CompoundScopeRAII CompoundScope(*this);
15100 CopyConstructor->setBody(
15101 ActOnCompoundStmt(Loc, Loc, None, /*isStmtExpr=*/false).getAs<Stmt>());
15102 CopyConstructor->markUsed(Context);
15103 }
15104
15105 if (ASTMutationListener *L = getASTMutationListener()) {
15106 L->CompletedImplicitDefinition(CopyConstructor);
15107 }
15108}

15110CXXConstructorDecl *Sema::DeclareImplicitMoveConstructor(
15111 CXXRecordDecl *ClassDecl) {
15112 assert(ClassDecl->needsImplicitMoveConstructor());
15113
15114 DeclaringSpecialMember DSM(*this, ClassDecl, CXXMoveConstructor);
15115 if (DSM.isAlreadyBeingDeclared())
15116 return nullptr;
15117
15118 QualType ClassType = Context.getTypeDeclType(ClassDecl);
15119
15120 QualType ArgType = ClassType;
15121 LangAS AS = getDefaultCXXMethodAddrSpace();
15122 if (AS != LangAS::Default)
15123 ArgType = Context.getAddrSpaceQualType(ClassType, AS);
15124 ArgType = Context.getRValueReferenceType(ArgType);
15125
15126 bool Constexpr = defaultedSpecialMemberIsConstexpr(*this, ClassDecl,
15127 CXXMoveConstructor,
15128 false);
15129
15130 DeclarationName Name
15131 = Context.DeclarationNames.getCXXConstructorName(
15132 Context.getCanonicalType(ClassType));
15133 SourceLocation ClassLoc = ClassDecl->getLocation();
15134 DeclarationNameInfo NameInfo(Name, ClassLoc);
15135
15136 // C++11 [class.copy]p11:
15137 // An implicitly-declared copy/move constructor is an inline public
15138 // member of its class.
15139 CXXConstructorDecl *MoveConstructor = CXXConstructorDecl::Create(
15140 Context, ClassDecl, ClassLoc, NameInfo, QualType(), /*TInfo=*/nullptr,
15141 ExplicitSpecifier(), getCurFPFeatures().isFPConstrained(),
15142 /*isInline=*/true,
15143 /*isImplicitlyDeclared=*/true,
15144 Constexpr ? ConstexprSpecKind::Constexpr
15145 : ConstexprSpecKind::Unspecified);
15146 MoveConstructor->setAccess(AS_public);
15147 MoveConstructor->setDefaulted();
15148
15149 if (getLangOpts().CUDA) {
15150 inferCUDATargetForImplicitSpecialMember(ClassDecl, CXXMoveConstructor,
15151 MoveConstructor,
15152 /* ConstRHS */ false,
15153 /* Diagnose */ false);
15154 }
15155
15156 setupImplicitSpecialMemberType(MoveConstructor, Context.VoidTy, ArgType);
15157
15158 // Add the parameter to the constructor.
15159 ParmVarDecl *FromParam = ParmVarDecl::Create(Context, MoveConstructor,
15160 ClassLoc, ClassLoc,
15161 /*IdentifierInfo=*/nullptr,
15162 ArgType, /*TInfo=*/nullptr,
15163 SC_None, nullptr);
15164 MoveConstructor->setParams(FromParam);
15165
15166 MoveConstructor->setTrivial(
15167 ClassDecl->needsOverloadResolutionForMoveConstructor()
15168 ? SpecialMemberIsTrivial(MoveConstructor, CXXMoveConstructor)
15169 : ClassDecl->hasTrivialMoveConstructor());
15170
15171 MoveConstructor->setTrivialForCall(
15172 ClassDecl->hasAttr<TrivialABIAttr>() ||
15173 (ClassDecl->needsOverloadResolutionForMoveConstructor()
15174 ? SpecialMemberIsTrivial(MoveConstructor, CXXMoveConstructor,
15175 TAH_ConsiderTrivialABI)
15176 : ClassDecl->hasTrivialMoveConstructorForCall()));
15177
15178 // Note that we have declared this constructor.
15179 ++getASTContext().NumImplicitMoveConstructorsDeclared;
15180
15181 Scope *S = getScopeForContext(ClassDecl);
15182 CheckImplicitSpecialMemberDeclaration(S, MoveConstructor);
15183
15184 if (ShouldDeleteSpecialMember(MoveConstructor, CXXMoveConstructor)) {
15185 ClassDecl->setImplicitMoveConstructorIsDeleted();
15186 SetDeclDeleted(MoveConstructor, ClassLoc);
15187 }
15188
15189 if (S)
15190 PushOnScopeChains(MoveConstructor, S, false);
15191 ClassDecl->addDecl(MoveConstructor);
15192
15193 return MoveConstructor;
15194}
