17214void Sema::SetDeclDefaulted(Decl *Dcl, SourceLocation DefaultLoc) {
17215 if (!Dcl || Dcl->isInvalidDecl())
17216 return;
17217
17218 auto *FD = dyn_cast<FunctionDecl>(Dcl);
17219 if (!FD) {
17220 if (auto *FTD = dyn_cast<FunctionTemplateDecl>(Dcl)) {
17221 if (getDefaultedFunctionKind(FTD->getTemplatedDecl()).isComparison()) {
17222 Diag(DefaultLoc, diag::err_defaulted_comparison_template);
17223 return;
17224 }
17225 }
17226
17227 Diag(DefaultLoc, diag::err_default_special_members)
17228 << getLangOpts().CPlusPlus20;
17229 return;
17230 }
17231
17232 // Reject if this can't possibly be a defaultable function.
17233 DefaultedFunctionKind DefKind = getDefaultedFunctionKind(FD);
17234 if (!DefKind &&
17235 // A dependent function that doesn't locally look defaultable can
17236 // still instantiate to a defaultable function if it's a constructor
17237 // or assignment operator.
17238 (!FD->isDependentContext() ||
17239 (!isa<CXXConstructorDecl>(FD) &&
17240 FD->getDeclName().getCXXOverloadedOperator() != OO_Equal))) {
17241 Diag(DefaultLoc, diag::err_default_special_members)
17242 << getLangOpts().CPlusPlus20;
17243 return;
17244 }
17245
17246 // Issue compatibility warning. We already warned if the operator is
17247 // 'operator<=>' when parsing the '<=>' token.
17248 if (DefKind.isComparison() &&
17249 DefKind.asComparison() != DefaultedComparisonKind::ThreeWay) {
17250 Diag(DefaultLoc, getLangOpts().CPlusPlus20
17251 ? diag::warn_cxx17_compat_defaulted_comparison
17252 : diag::ext_defaulted_comparison);
17253 }
17254
17255 FD->setDefaulted();
17256 FD->setExplicitlyDefaulted();
17257
17258 // Defer checking functions that are defaulted in a dependent context.
17259 if (FD->isDependentContext())
17260 return;
17261
17262 // Unset that we will have a body for this function. We might not,
17263 // if it turns out to be trivial, and we don't need this marking now
17264 // that we've marked it as defaulted.
17265 FD->setWillHaveBody(false);
17266
17267 if (DefKind.isComparison()) {
17268 // If this comparison's defaulting occurs within the definition of its
17269 // lexical class context, we have to do the checking when complete.
17270 if (auto const *RD = dyn_cast<CXXRecordDecl>(FD->getLexicalDeclContext()))
17271 if (!RD->isCompleteDefinition())
17272 return;
17273 }
17274
17275 // If this member fn was defaulted on its first declaration, we will have
17276 // already performed the checking in CheckCompletedCXXClass. Such a
17277 // declaration doesn't trigger an implicit definition.
17278 if (isa<CXXMethodDecl>(FD)) {
17279 const FunctionDecl *Primary = FD;
17280 if (const FunctionDecl *Pattern = FD->getTemplateInstantiationPattern())
17281 // Ask the template instantiation pattern that actually had the
17282 // '= default' on it.
17283 Primary = Pattern;
17284 if (Primary->getCanonicalDecl()->isDefaulted())
17285 return;
17286 }
17287
17288 if (DefKind.isComparison()) {
17289 if (CheckExplicitlyDefaultedComparison(nullptr, FD, DefKind.asComparison()))
17290 FD->setInvalidDecl();
17291 else
17292 DefineDefaultedComparison(DefaultLoc, FD, DefKind.asComparison());
17293 } else {
17294 auto *MD = cast<CXXMethodDecl>(FD);
17295
17296 if (CheckExplicitlyDefaultedSpecialMember(MD, DefKind.asSpecialMember()))
17297 MD->setInvalidDecl();
17298 else
17299 DefineDefaultedFunction(*this, MD, DefaultLoc);
17300 }
17301}
17302
17303static void SearchForReturnInStmt(Sema &Self, Stmt *S) {
17304 for (Stmt *SubStmt : S->children()) {
17305 if (!SubStmt)
17306 continue;
17307 if (isa<ReturnStmt>(SubStmt))
17308 Self.Diag(SubStmt->getBeginLoc(),
17309 diag::err_return_in_constructor_handler);
17310 if (!isa<Expr>(SubStmt))
17311 SearchForReturnInStmt(Self, SubStmt);
17312 }
17313}
17314
17315void Sema::DiagnoseReturnInConstructorExceptionHandler(CXXTryStmt *TryBlock) {
17316 for (unsigned I = 0, E = TryBlock->getNumHandlers(); I != E; ++I) {
17317 CXXCatchStmt *Handler = TryBlock->getHandler(I);
17318 SearchForReturnInStmt(*this, Handler);
17319 }
17320}
17321
17322bool Sema::CheckOverridingFunctionAttributes(const CXXMethodDecl *New,
17323 const CXXMethodDecl *Old) {
17324 const auto *NewFT = New->getType()->castAs<FunctionProtoType>();
17325 const auto *OldFT = Old->getType()->castAs<FunctionProtoType>();
17326
17327 if (OldFT->hasExtParameterInfos()) {
17328 for (unsigned I = 0, E = OldFT->getNumParams(); I != E; ++I)
17329 // A parameter of the overriding method should be annotated with noescape
17330 // if the corresponding parameter of the overridden method is annotated.
17331 if (OldFT->getExtParameterInfo(I).isNoEscape() &&
17332 !NewFT->getExtParameterInfo(I).isNoEscape()) {
17333 Diag(New->getParamDecl(I)->getLocation(),
17334 diag::warn_overriding_method_missing_noescape);
17335 Diag(Old->getParamDecl(I)->getLocation(),
17336 diag::note_overridden_marked_noescape);
17337 }
17338 }
17339
17340 // Virtual overrides must have the same code_seg.
17341 const auto *OldCSA = Old->getAttr<CodeSegAttr>();
17342 const auto *NewCSA = New->getAttr<CodeSegAttr>();
17343 if ((NewCSA || OldCSA) &&
17344 (!OldCSA || !NewCSA || NewCSA->getName() != OldCSA->getName())) {
17345 Diag(New->getLocation(), diag::err_mismatched_code_seg_override);
17346 Diag(Old->getLocation(), diag::note_previous_declaration);
17347 return true;
17348 }
17349
17350 CallingConv NewCC = NewFT->getCallConv(), OldCC = OldFT->getCallConv();
17351
17352 // If the calling conventions match, everything is fine
17353 if (NewCC == OldCC)
17354 return false;
17355
17356 // If the calling conventions mismatch because the new function is static,
17357 // suppress the calling convention mismatch error; the error about static
17358 // function override (err_static_overrides_virtual from
17359 // Sema::CheckFunctionDeclaration) is more clear.
17360 if (New->getStorageClass() == SC_Static)
17361 return false;
17362
17363 Diag(New->getLocation(),
17364 diag::err_conflicting_overriding_cc_attributes)
17365 << New->getDeclName() << New->getType() << Old->getType();
17366 Diag(Old->getLocation(), diag::note_overridden_virtual_function);
17367 return true;
17368}
17369
17370bool Sema::CheckOverridingFunctionReturnType(const CXXMethodDecl *New,
17371 const CXXMethodDecl *Old) {
17372 QualType NewTy = New->getType()->castAs<FunctionType>()->getReturnType();
17373 QualType OldTy = Old->getType()->castAs<FunctionType>()->getReturnType();
17374
17375 if (Context.hasSameType(NewTy, OldTy) ||
17376 NewTy->isDependentType() || OldTy->isDependentType())
17377 return false;
17378
17379 // Check if the return types are covariant
17380 QualType NewClassTy, OldClassTy;
17381
17382 /// Both types must be pointers or references to classes.
17383 if (const PointerType *NewPT = NewTy->getAs<PointerType>()) {
17384 if (const PointerType *OldPT = OldTy->getAs<PointerType>()) {
17385 NewClassTy = NewPT->getPointeeType();
17386 OldClassTy = OldPT->getPointeeType();
17387 }
17388 } else if (const ReferenceType *NewRT = NewTy->getAs<ReferenceType>()) {
17389 if (const ReferenceType *OldRT = OldTy->getAs<ReferenceType>()) {
17390 if (NewRT->getTypeClass() == OldRT->getTypeClass()) {
17391 NewClassTy = NewRT->getPointeeType();
17392 OldClassTy = OldRT->getPointeeType();
17393 }
17394 }
17395 }
17396
17397 // The return types aren't either both pointers or references to a class type.
17398 if (NewClassTy.isNull()) {
17399 Diag(New->getLocation(),
17400 diag::err_different_return_type_for_overriding_virtual_function)
17401 << New->getDeclName() << NewTy << OldTy
17402 << New->getReturnTypeSourceRange();
17403 Diag(Old->getLocation(), diag::note_overridden_virtual_function)
17404 << Old->getReturnTypeSourceRange();
17405
17406 return true;
17407 }
17408
17409 if (!Context.hasSameUnqualifiedType(NewClassTy, OldClassTy)) {
17410 // C++14 [class.virtual]p8:
17411 // If the class type in the covariant return type of D::f differs from
17412 // that of B::f, the class type in the return type of D::f shall be
17413 // complete at the point of declaration of D::f or shall be the class
17414 // type D.
17415 if (const RecordType *RT = NewClassTy->getAs<RecordType>()) {
17416 if (!RT->isBeingDefined() &&
17417 RequireCompleteType(New->getLocation(), NewClassTy,
17418 diag::err_covariant_return_incomplete,
17419 New->getDeclName()))
17420 return true;
17421 }
17422
17423 // Check if the new class derives from the old class.
17424 if (!IsDerivedFrom(New->getLocation(), NewClassTy, OldClassTy)) {
17425 Diag(New->getLocation(), diag::err_covariant_return_not_derived)
17426 << New->getDeclName() << NewTy << OldTy
17427 << New->getReturnTypeSourceRange();
17428 Diag(Old->getLocation(), diag::note_overridden_virtual_function)
17429 << Old->getReturnTypeSourceRange();
17430 return true;
17431 }
17432
17433 // Check if we the conversion from derived to base is valid.
17434 if (CheckDerivedToBaseConversion(
17435 NewClassTy, OldClassTy,
17436 diag::err_covariant_return_inaccessible_base,
17437 diag::err_covariant_return_ambiguous_derived_to_base_conv,
17438 New->getLocation(), New->getReturnTypeSourceRange(),
17439 New->getDeclName(), nullptr)) {
17440 // FIXME: this note won't trigger for delayed access control
17441 // diagnostics, and it's impossible to get an undelayed error
17442 // here from access control during the original parse because
17443 // the ParsingDeclSpec/ParsingDeclarator are still in scope.
17444 Diag(Old->getLocation(), diag::note_overridden_virtual_function)
17445 << Old->getReturnTypeSourceRange();
17446 return true;
17447 }
17448 }
17449
17450 // The qualifiers of the return types must be the same.
17451 if (NewTy.getLocalCVRQualifiers() != OldTy.getLocalCVRQualifiers()) {
17452 Diag(New->getLocation(),
17453 diag::err_covariant_return_type_different_qualifications)
17454 << New->getDeclName() << NewTy << OldTy
17455 << New->getReturnTypeSourceRange();
17456 Diag(Old->getLocation(), diag::note_overridden_virtual_function)
17457 << Old->getReturnTypeSourceRange();
17458 return true;
17459 }
17460
17461
17462 // The new class type must have the same or less qualifiers as the old type.
17463 if (NewClassTy.isMoreQualifiedThan(OldClassTy)) {
17464 Diag(New->getLocation(),
17465 diag::err_covariant_return_type_class_type_more_qualified)
17466 << New->getDeclName() << NewTy << OldTy
17467 << New->getReturnTypeSourceRange();
17468 Diag(Old->getLocation(), diag::note_overridden_virtual_function)
17469 << Old->getReturnTypeSourceRange();
17470 return true;
17471 }
17472
17473 return false;
17474}
17475
17476/// Mark the given method pure.
17477///
17478/// \param Method the method to be marked pure.
17479///
17480/// \param InitRange the source range that covers the "0" initializer.
17481bool Sema::CheckPureMethod(CXXMethodDecl *Method, SourceRange InitRange) {
17482 SourceLocation EndLoc = InitRange.getEnd();
17483 if (EndLoc.isValid())
17484 Method->setRangeEnd(EndLoc);
17485
17486 if (Method->isVirtual() || Method->getParent()->isDependentContext()) {
17487 Method->setPure();
17488 return false;
17489 }
17490
17491 if (!Method->isInvalidDecl())
17492 Diag(Method->getLocation(), diag::err_non_virtual_pure)
17493 << Method->getDeclName() << InitRange;
17494 return true;
17495}
17496
17497void Sema::ActOnPureSpecifier(Decl *D, SourceLocation ZeroLoc) {
17498 if (D->getFriendObjectKind())
17499 Diag(D->getLocation(), diag::err_pure_friend);
17500 else if (auto *M = dyn_cast<CXXMethodDecl>(D))
17501 CheckPureMethod(M, ZeroLoc);
17502 else
17503 Diag(D->getLocation(), diag::err_illegal_initializer);
17504}
17505
17506/// Determine whether the given declaration is a global variable or
17507/// static data member.
17508static bool isNonlocalVariable(const Decl *D) {
17509 if (const VarDecl *Var = dyn_cast_or_null<VarDecl>(D))
17510 return Var->hasGlobalStorage();
17511
17512 return false;
17513}
17514
17515/// Invoked when we are about to parse an initializer for the declaration
17516/// 'Dcl'.
17517///
17518/// After this method is called, according to [C++ 3.4.1p13], if 'Dcl' is a
17519/// static data member of class X, names should be looked up in the scope of
17520/// class X. If the declaration had a scope specifier, a scope will have
17521/// been created and passed in for this purpose. Otherwise, S will be null.
17522void Sema::ActOnCXXEnterDeclInitializer(Scope *S, Decl *D) {
17523 // If there is no declaration, there was an error parsing it.
17524 if (!D || D->isInvalidDecl())
17525 return;
17526
17527 // We will always have a nested name specifier here, but this declaration
17528 // might not be out of line if the specifier names the current namespace:
17529 // extern int n;
17530 // int ::n = 0;
17531 if (S && D->isOutOfLine())
17532 EnterDeclaratorContext(S, D->getDeclContext());
17533
17534 // If we are parsing the initializer for a static data member, push a
17535 // new expression evaluation context that is associated with this static
17536 // data member.
17537 if (isNonlocalVariable(D))
17538 PushExpressionEvaluationContext(
17539 ExpressionEvaluationContext::PotentiallyEvaluated, D);
17540}
17541
17542/// Invoked after we are finished parsing an initializer for the declaration D.
17543void Sema::ActOnCXXExitDeclInitializer(Scope *S, Decl *D) {
17544 // If there is no declaration, there was an error parsing it.
17545 if (!D || D->isInvalidDecl())
17546 return;
17547
17548 if (isNonlocalVariable(D))
17549 PopExpressionEvaluationContext();
17550
17551 if (S && D->isOutOfLine())
17552 ExitDeclaratorContext(S);
17553}
17554
17555/// ActOnCXXConditionDeclarationExpr - Parsed a condition declaration of a
17556/// C++ if/switch/while/for statement.
17557/// e.g: "if (int x = f()) {...}"
17558DeclResult Sema::ActOnCXXConditionDeclaration(Scope *S, Declarator &D) {
17559 // C++ 6.4p2:
17560 // The declarator shall not specify a function or an array.
17561 // The type-specifier-seq shall not contain typedef and shall not declare a
17562 // new class or enumeration.
17563 assert(D.getDeclSpec().getStorageClassSpec() != DeclSpec::SCS_typedef &&
17564 "Parser allowed 'typedef' as storage class of condition decl.");
17565
17566 Decl *Dcl = ActOnDeclarator(S, D);
17567 if (!Dcl)
17568 return true;
17569
17570 if (isa<FunctionDecl>(Dcl)) { // The declarator shall not specify a function.
17571 Diag(Dcl->getLocation(), diag::err_invalid_use_of_function_type)
17572 << D.getSourceRange();
17573 return true;
17574 }
17575
17576 return Dcl;
17577}
17578
17579void Sema::LoadExternalVTableUses() {
17580 if (!ExternalSource)
17581 return;
17582
17583 SmallVector<ExternalVTableUse, 4> VTables;
17584 ExternalSource->ReadUsedVTables(VTables);
17585 SmallVector<VTableUse, 4> NewUses;
17586 for (unsigned I = 0, N = VTables.size(); I != N; ++I) {
17587 llvm::DenseMap<CXXRecordDecl *, bool>::iterator Pos
17588 = VTablesUsed.find(VTables[I].Record);
17589 // Even if a definition wasn't required before, it may be required now.
17590 if (Pos != VTablesUsed.end()) {
17591 if (!Pos->second && VTables[I].DefinitionRequired)
17592 Pos->second = true;
17593 continue;
17594 }
17595
17596 VTablesUsed[VTables[I].Record] = VTables[I].DefinitionRequired;
17597 NewUses.push_back(VTableUse(VTables[I].Record, VTables[I].Location));
17598 }
17599
17600 VTableUses.insert(VTableUses.begin(), NewUses.begin(), NewUses.end());
17601}
17602
17603void Sema::MarkVTableUsed(SourceLocation Loc, CXXRecordDecl *Class,
17604 bool DefinitionRequired) {
17605 // Ignore any vtable uses in unevaluated operands or for classes that do
17606 // not have a vtable.
17607 if (!Class->isDynamicClass() || Class->isDependentContext() ||
17608 CurContext->isDependentContext() || isUnevaluatedContext())
17609 return;
17610 // Do not mark as used if compiling for the device outside of the target
17611 // region.
17612 if (TUKind != TU_Prefix && LangOpts.OpenMP && LangOpts.OpenMPIsDevice &&
17613 !isInOpenMPDeclareTargetContext() &&
17614 !isInOpenMPTargetExecutionDirective()) {
17615 if (!DefinitionRequired)
17616 MarkVirtualMembersReferenced(Loc, Class);
17617 return;
17618 }
17619
17620 // Try to insert this class into the map.
17621 LoadExternalVTableUses();
17622 Class = Class->getCanonicalDecl();
17623 std::pair<llvm::DenseMap<CXXRecordDecl *, bool>::iterator, bool>
17624 Pos = VTablesUsed.insert(std::make_pair(Class, DefinitionRequired));
17625 if (!Pos.second) {
17626 // If we already had an entry, check to see if we are promoting this vtable
17627 // to require a definition. If so, we need to reappend to the VTableUses
17628 // list, since we may have already processed the first entry.
17629 if (DefinitionRequired && !Pos.first->second) {
17630 Pos.first->second = true;
17631 } else {
17632 // Otherwise, we can early exit.
17633 return;
17634 }
17635 } else {
17636 // The Microsoft ABI requires that we perform the destructor body
17637 // checks (i.e. operator delete() lookup) when the vtable is marked used, as
17638 // the deleting destructor is emitted with the vtable, not with the
17639 // destructor definition as in the Itanium ABI.
17640 if (Context.getTargetInfo().getCXXABI().isMicrosoft()) {
17641 CXXDestructorDecl *DD = Class->getDestructor();
17642 if (DD && DD->isVirtual() && !DD->isDeleted()) {
17643 if (Class->hasUserDeclaredDestructor() && !DD->isDefined()) {
17644 // If this is an out-of-line declaration, marking it referenced will
17645 // not do anything. Manually call CheckDestructor to look up operator
17646 // delete().
17647 ContextRAII SavedContext(*this, DD);
17648 CheckDestructor(DD);
17649 } else {
17650 MarkFunctionReferenced(Loc, Class->getDestructor());
17651 }
17652 }
17653 }
17654 }
17655
17656 // Local classes need to have their virtual members marked
17657 // immediately. For all other classes, we mark their virtual members
17658 // at the end of the translation unit.
17659 if (Class->isLocalClass())
17660 MarkVirtualMembersReferenced(Loc, Class);
17661 else
17662 VTableUses.push_back(std::make_pair(Class, Loc));
17663}
17664
17665bool Sema::DefineUsedVTables() {
17666 LoadExternalVTableUses();
17667 if (VTableUses.empty())
17668 return false;
17669
17670 // Note: The VTableUses vector could grow as a result of marking
17671 // the members of a class as "used", so we check the size each
17672 // time through the loop and prefer indices (which are stable) to
17673 // iterators (which are not).
17674 bool DefinedAnything = false;
17675 for (unsigned I = 0; I != VTableUses.size(); ++I) {
17676 CXXRecordDecl *Class = VTableUses[I].first->getDefinition();
17677 if (!Class)
17678 continue;
17679 TemplateSpecializationKind ClassTSK =
17680 Class->getTemplateSpecializationKind();
17681
17682 SourceLocation Loc = VTableUses[I].second;
17683
17684 bool DefineVTable = true;
17685
17686 // If this class has a key function, but that key function is
17687 // defined in another translation unit, we don't need to emit the
17688 // vtable even though we're using it.
17689 const CXXMethodDecl *KeyFunction = Context.getCurrentKeyFunction(Class);
17690 if (KeyFunction && !KeyFunction->hasBody()) {
17691 // The key function is in another translation unit.
17692 DefineVTable = false;
17693 TemplateSpecializationKind TSK =
17694 KeyFunction->getTemplateSpecializationKind();
17695 assert(TSK != TSK_ExplicitInstantiationDefinition &&
17696 TSK != TSK_ImplicitInstantiation &&
17697 "Instantiations don't have key functions");
17698 (void)TSK;
17699 } else if (!KeyFunction) {
17700 // If we have a class with no key function that is the subject
17701 // of an explicit instantiation declaration, suppress the
17702 // vtable; it will live with the explicit instantiation
17703 // definition.
17704 bool IsExplicitInstantiationDeclaration =
17705 ClassTSK == TSK_ExplicitInstantiationDeclaration;
17706 for (auto R : Class->redecls()) {
17707 TemplateSpecializationKind TSK
17708 = cast<CXXRecordDecl>(R)->getTemplateSpecializationKind();
17709 if (TSK == TSK_ExplicitInstantiationDeclaration)
17710 IsExplicitInstantiationDeclaration = true;
17711 else if (TSK == TSK_ExplicitInstantiationDefinition) {
17712 IsExplicitInstantiationDeclaration = false;
17713 break;
17714 }
17715 }
17716
17717 if (IsExplicitInstantiationDeclaration)
17718 DefineVTable = false;
17719 }
17720
17721 // The exception specifications for all virtual members may be needed even
17722 // if we are not providing an authoritative form of the vtable in this TU.
17723 // We may choose to emit it available_externally anyway.
17724 if (!DefineVTable) {
17725 MarkVirtualMemberExceptionSpecsNeeded(Loc, Class);
17726 continue;
17727 }
17728
17729 // Mark all of the virtual members of this class as referenced, so
17730 // that we can build a vtable. Then, tell the AST consumer that a
17731 // vtable for this class is required.
17732 DefinedAnything = true;
17733 MarkVirtualMembersReferenced(Loc, Class);
17734 CXXRecordDecl *Canonical = Class->getCanonicalDecl();
17735 if (VTablesUsed[Canonical])
17736 Consumer.HandleVTable(Class);
17737
17738 // Warn if we're emitting a weak vtable. The vtable will be weak if there is
17739 // no key function or the key function is inlined. Don't warn in C++ ABIs
17740 // that lack key functions, since the user won't be able to make one.
17741 if (Context.getTargetInfo().getCXXABI().hasKeyFunctions() &&
17742 Class->isExternallyVisible() && ClassTSK != TSK_ImplicitInstantiation &&
17743 ClassTSK != TSK_ExplicitInstantiationDefinition) {
17744 const FunctionDecl *KeyFunctionDef = nullptr;
17745 if (!KeyFunction || (KeyFunction->hasBody(KeyFunctionDef) &&
17746 KeyFunctionDef->isInlined()))
17747 Diag(Class->getLocation(), diag::warn_weak_vtable) << Class;
17748 }
17749 }
17750 VTableUses.clear();
17751
17752 return DefinedAnything;
17753}
17754
17755void Sema::MarkVirtualMemberExceptionSpecsNeeded(SourceLocation Loc,
17756 const CXXRecordDecl *RD) {
17757 for (const auto *I : RD->methods())
17758 if (I->isVirtual() && !I->isPure())
17759 ResolveExceptionSpec(Loc, I->getType()->castAs<FunctionProtoType>());
17760}
17761
17762void Sema::MarkVirtualMembersReferenced(SourceLocation Loc,
17763 const CXXRecordDecl *RD,
17764 bool ConstexprOnly) {
17765 // Mark all functions which will appear in RD's vtable as used.
17766 CXXFinalOverriderMap FinalOverriders;
17767 RD->getFinalOverriders(FinalOverriders);
17768 for (CXXFinalOverriderMap::const_iterator I = FinalOverriders.begin(),
17769 E = FinalOverriders.end();
17770 I != E; ++I) {
17771 for (OverridingMethods::const_iterator OI = I->second.begin(),
17772 OE = I->second.end();
17773 OI != OE; ++OI) {
17774 assert(OI->second.size() > 0 && "no final overrider");
17775 CXXMethodDecl *Overrider = OI->second.front().Method;
17776
17777 // C++ [basic.def.odr]p2:
17778 // [...] A virtual member function is used if it is not pure. [...]
17779 if (!Overrider->isPure() && (!ConstexprOnly || Overrider->isConstexpr()))
17780 MarkFunctionReferenced(Loc, Overrider);
17781 }
17782 }
17783
17784 // Only classes that have virtual bases need a VTT.
17785 if (RD->getNumVBases() == 0)
17786 return;
17787
17788 for (const auto &I : RD->bases()) {
17789 const auto *Base =
17790 cast<CXXRecordDecl>(I.getType()->castAs<RecordType>()->getDecl());
17791 if (Base->getNumVBases() == 0)
17792 continue;
17793 MarkVirtualMembersReferenced(Loc, Base);
17794 }
17795}
17796
17797/// SetIvarInitializers - This routine builds initialization ASTs for the
17798/// Objective-C implementation whose ivars need be initialized.
17799void Sema::SetIvarInitializers(ObjCImplementationDecl *ObjCImplementation) {
17800 if (!getLangOpts().CPlusPlus)
17801 return;
17802 if (ObjCInterfaceDecl *OID = ObjCImplementation->getClassInterface()) {
17803 SmallVector<ObjCIvarDecl*, 8> ivars;
17804 CollectIvarsToConstructOrDestruct(OID, ivars);
17805 if (ivars.empty())
17806 return;
17807 SmallVector<CXXCtorInitializer*, 32> AllToInit;
17808 for (unsigned i = 0; i < ivars.size(); i++) {
17809 FieldDecl *Field = ivars[i];
17810 if (Field->isInvalidDecl())
17811 continue;
17812
17813 CXXCtorInitializer *Member;
17814 InitializedEntity InitEntity = InitializedEntity::InitializeMember(Field);
17815 InitializationKind InitKind =
17816 InitializationKind::CreateDefault(ObjCImplementation->getLocation());
17817
17818 InitializationSequence InitSeq(*this, InitEntity, InitKind, None);
17819 ExprResult MemberInit =
17820 InitSeq.Perform(*this, InitEntity, InitKind, None);
17821 MemberInit = MaybeCreateExprWithCleanups(MemberInit);
17822 // Note, MemberInit could actually come back empty if no initialization
17823 // is required (e.g., because it would call a trivial default constructor)
17824 if (!MemberInit.get() || MemberInit.isInvalid())
17825 continue;
17826
17827 Member =
17828 new (Context) CXXCtorInitializer(Context, Field, SourceLocation(),
17829 SourceLocation(),
17830 MemberInit.getAs<Expr>(),
17831 SourceLocation());
17832 AllToInit.push_back(Member);
17833
17834 // Be sure that the destructor is accessible and is marked as referenced.
17835 if (const RecordType *RecordTy =
17836 Context.getBaseElementType(Field->getType())
17837 ->getAs<RecordType>()) {
17838 CXXRecordDecl *RD = cast<CXXRecordDecl>(RecordTy->getDecl());
17839 if (CXXDestructorDecl *Destructor = LookupDestructor(RD)) {
17840 MarkFunctionReferenced(Field->getLocation(), Destructor);
17841 CheckDestructorAccess(Field->getLocation(), Destructor,
17842 PDiag(diag::err_access_dtor_ivar)
17843 << Context.getBaseElementType(Field->getType()));
17844 }
17845 }
17846 }
17847 ObjCImplementation->setIvarInitializers(Context,
17848 AllToInit.data(), AllToInit.size());
17849 }
17850}
17851
17852static
17853void DelegatingCycleHelper(CXXConstructorDecl* Ctor,
17854 llvm::SmallPtrSet<CXXConstructorDecl*, 4> &Valid,
17855 llvm::SmallPtrSet<CXXConstructorDecl*, 4> &Invalid,
17856 llvm::SmallPtrSet<CXXConstructorDecl*, 4> &Current,
17857 Sema &S) {
17858 if (Ctor->isInvalidDecl())
17859 return;
17860
17861 CXXConstructorDecl *Target = Ctor->getTargetConstructor();
17862
17863 // Target may not be determinable yet, for instance if this is a dependent
17864 // call in an uninstantiated template.
17865 if (Target) {
17866 const FunctionDecl *FNTarget = nullptr;
17867 (void)Target->hasBody(FNTarget);
17868 Target = const_cast<CXXConstructorDecl*>(
17869 cast_or_null<CXXConstructorDecl>(FNTarget));
17870 }
17871
17872 CXXConstructorDecl *Canonical = Ctor->getCanonicalDecl(),
17873 // Avoid dereferencing a null pointer here.
17874 *TCanonical = Target? Target->getCanonicalDecl() : nullptr;
17875
17876 if (!Current.insert(Canonical).second)
17877 return;
17878
17879 // We know that beyond here, we aren't chaining into a cycle.
17880 if (!Target || !Target->isDelegatingConstructor() ||
17881 Target->isInvalidDecl() || Valid.count(TCanonical)) {
17882 Valid.insert(Current.begin(), Current.end());
17883 Current.clear();
17884 // We've hit a cycle.
17885 } else if (TCanonical == Canonical || Invalid.count(TCanonical) ||
17886 Current.count(TCanonical)) {
17887 // If we haven't diagnosed this cycle yet, do so now.
17888 if (!Invalid.count(TCanonical)) {
17889 S.Diag((*Ctor->init_begin())->getSourceLocation(),
17890 diag::warn_delegating_ctor_cycle)
17891 << Ctor;
17892
17893 // Don't add a note for a function delegating directly to itself.
17894 if (TCanonical != Canonical)
17895 S.Diag(Target->getLocation(), diag::note_it_delegates_to);
17896
17897 CXXConstructorDecl *C = Target;
17898 while (C->getCanonicalDecl() != Canonical) {
17899 const FunctionDecl *FNTarget = nullptr;
17900 (void)C->getTargetConstructor()->hasBody(FNTarget);
17901 assert(FNTarget && "Ctor cycle through bodiless function");
17902
17903 C = const_cast<CXXConstructorDecl*>(
17904 cast<CXXConstructorDecl>(FNTarget));
17905 S.Diag(C->getLocation(), diag::note_which_delegates_to);
17906 }
17907 }
17908
17909 Invalid.insert(Current.begin(), Current.end());
17910 Current.clear();
17911 } else {
17912 DelegatingCycleHelper(Target, Valid, Invalid, Current, S);
17913 }
17914}
17915
17916
17917void Sema::CheckDelegatingCtorCycles() {
17918 llvm::SmallPtrSet<CXXConstructorDecl*, 4> Valid, Invalid, Current;
17919
17920 for (DelegatingCtorDeclsType::iterator
17921 I = DelegatingCtorDecls.begin(ExternalSource),
17922 E = DelegatingCtorDecls.end();
17923 I != E; ++I)
17924 DelegatingCycleHelper(*I, Valid, Invalid, Current, *this);
17925
17926 for (auto CI = Invalid.begin(), CE = Invalid.end(); CI != CE; ++CI)
17927 (*CI)->setInvalidDecl();
17928}

17930namespace {
17931 /// AST visitor that finds references to the 'this' expression.
17932 class FindCXXThisExpr : public RecursiveASTVisitor<FindCXXThisExpr> {
17933 Sema &S;
17934
17935 public:
17936 explicit FindCXXThisExpr(Sema &S) : S(S) { }
17937
17938 bool VisitCXXThisExpr(CXXThisExpr *E) {
17939 S.Diag(E->getLocation(), diag::err_this_static_member_func)
17940 << E->isImplicit();
17941 return false;
17942 }
17943 };
17944}
17945
17946bool Sema::checkThisInStaticMemberFunctionType(CXXMethodDecl *Method) {
17947 TypeSourceInfo *TSInfo = Method->getTypeSourceInfo();
17948 if (!TSInfo)
17949 return false;
17950
17951 TypeLoc TL = TSInfo->getTypeLoc();
17952 FunctionProtoTypeLoc ProtoTL = TL.getAs<FunctionProtoTypeLoc>();
17953 if (!ProtoTL)
17954 return false;
17955
17956 // C++11 [expr.prim.general]p3:
17957 // [The expression this] shall not appear before the optional
17958 // cv-qualifier-seq and it shall not appear within the declaration of a
17959 // static member function (although its type and value category are defined
17960 // within a static member function as they are within a non-static member
17961 // function). [ Note: this is because declaration matching does not occur
17962 // until the complete declarator is known. - end note ]
17963 const FunctionProtoType *Proto = ProtoTL.getTypePtr();
17964 FindCXXThisExpr Finder(*this);
17965
17966 // If the return type came after the cv-qualifier-seq, check it now.
17967 if (Proto->hasTrailingReturn() &&
17968 !Finder.TraverseTypeLoc(ProtoTL.getReturnLoc()))
17969 return true;
17970
17971 // Check the exception specification.
17972 if (checkThisInStaticMemberFunctionExceptionSpec(Method))
17973 return true;
17974
17975 // Check the trailing requires clause
17976 if (Expr *E = Method->getTrailingRequiresClause())
17977 if (!Finder.TraverseStmt(E))
17978 return true;
17979
17980 return checkThisInStaticMemberFunctionAttributes(Method);
17981}
17982
17983bool Sema::checkThisInStaticMemberFunctionExceptionSpec(CXXMethodDecl *Method) {
17984 TypeSourceInfo *TSInfo = Method->getTypeSourceInfo();
17985 if (!TSInfo)
17986 return false;
17987
17988 TypeLoc TL = TSInfo->getTypeLoc();
17989 FunctionProtoTypeLoc ProtoTL = TL.getAs<FunctionProtoTypeLoc>();
17990 if (!ProtoTL)
17991 return false;
17992
17993 const FunctionProtoType *Proto = ProtoTL.getTypePtr();
17994 FindCXXThisExpr Finder(*this);
17995
17996 switch (Proto->getExceptionSpecType()) {
17997 case EST_Unparsed:
17998 case EST_Uninstantiated:
17999 case EST_Unevaluated:
18000 case EST_BasicNoexcept:
18001 case EST_NoThrow:
18002 case EST_DynamicNone:
18003 case EST_MSAny:
18004 case EST_None:
18005 break;
18006
18007 case EST_DependentNoexcept:
18008 case EST_NoexceptFalse:
18009 case EST_NoexceptTrue:
18010 if (!Finder.TraverseStmt(Proto->getNoexceptExpr()))
18011 return true;
18012 LLVM_FALLTHROUGH;
18013
18014 case EST_Dynamic:
18015 for (const auto &E : Proto->exceptions()) {
18016 if (!Finder.TraverseType(E))
18017 return true;
18018 }
18019 break;
18020 }
18021
18022 return false;
18023}
18024
18025bool Sema::checkThisInStaticMemberFunctionAttributes(CXXMethodDecl *Method) {
18026 FindCXXThisExpr Finder(*this);
18027
18028 // Check attributes.
18029 for (const auto *A : Method->attrs()) {
18030 // FIXME: This should be emitted by tblgen.
18031 Expr *Arg = nullptr;
18032 ArrayRef<Expr *> Args;
18033 if (const auto *G = dyn_cast<GuardedByAttr>(A))
18034 Arg = G->getArg();
18035 else if (const auto *G = dyn_cast<PtGuardedByAttr>(A))
18036 Arg = G->getArg();
18037 else if (const auto *AA = dyn_cast<AcquiredAfterAttr>(A))
18038 Args = llvm::makeArrayRef(AA->args_begin(), AA->args_size());
18039 else if (const auto *AB = dyn_cast<AcquiredBeforeAttr>(A))
18040 Args = llvm::makeArrayRef(AB->args_begin(), AB->args_size());
18041 else if (const auto *ETLF = dyn_cast<ExclusiveTrylockFunctionAttr>(A)) {
18042 Arg = ETLF->getSuccessValue();
18043 Args = llvm::makeArrayRef(ETLF->args_begin(), ETLF->args_size());
18044 } else if (const auto *STLF = dyn_cast<SharedTrylockFunctionAttr>(A)) {
18045 Arg = STLF->getSuccessValue();
18046 Args = llvm::makeArrayRef(STLF->args_begin(), STLF->args_size());
18047 } else if (const auto *LR = dyn_cast<LockReturnedAttr>(A))
18048 Arg = LR->getArg();
18049 else if (const auto *LE = dyn_cast<LocksExcludedAttr>(A))
18050 Args = llvm::makeArrayRef(LE->args_begin(), LE->args_size());
18051 else if (const auto *RC = dyn_cast<RequiresCapabilityAttr>(A))
18052 Args = llvm::makeArrayRef(RC->args_begin(), RC->args_size());
18053 else if (const auto *AC = dyn_cast<AcquireCapabilityAttr>(A))
18054 Args = llvm::makeArrayRef(AC->args_begin(), AC->args_size());
18055 else if (const auto *AC = dyn_cast<TryAcquireCapabilityAttr>(A))
18056 Args = llvm::makeArrayRef(AC->args_begin(), AC->args_size());
18057 else if (const auto *RC = dyn_cast<ReleaseCapabilityAttr>(A))
18058 Args = llvm::makeArrayRef(RC->args_begin(), RC->args_size());
18059
18060 if (Arg && !Finder.TraverseStmt(Arg))
18061 return true;
18062
18063 for (unsigned I = 0, N = Args.size(); I != N; ++I) {
18064 if (!Finder.TraverseStmt(Args[I]))
18065 return true;
18066 }
18067 }
18068
18069 return false;
18070}

18072void Sema::checkExceptionSpecification(
18073 bool IsTopLevel, ExceptionSpecificationType EST,
18074 ArrayRef<ParsedType> DynamicExceptions,
18075 ArrayRef<SourceRange> DynamicExceptionRanges, Expr *NoexceptExpr,
18076 SmallVectorImpl<QualType> &Exceptions,
18077 FunctionProtoType::ExceptionSpecInfo &ESI) {
18078 Exceptions.clear();
18079 ESI.Type = EST;
18080 if (EST == EST_Dynamic) {
18081 Exceptions.reserve(DynamicExceptions.size());
18082 for (unsigned ei = 0, ee = DynamicExceptions.size(); ei != ee; ++ei) {
18083 // FIXME: Preserve type source info.
18084 QualType ET = GetTypeFromParser(DynamicExceptions[ei]);
18085
18086 if (IsTopLevel) {
18087 SmallVector<UnexpandedParameterPack, 2> Unexpanded;
18088 collectUnexpandedParameterPacks(ET, Unexpanded);
18089 if (!Unexpanded.empty()) {
18090 DiagnoseUnexpandedParameterPacks(
18091 DynamicExceptionRanges[ei].getBegin(), UPPC_ExceptionType,
18092 Unexpanded);
18093 continue;
18094 }
18095 }
18096
18097 // Check that the type is valid for an exception spec, and
18098 // drop it if not.
18099 if (!CheckSpecifiedExceptionType(ET, DynamicExceptionRanges[ei]))
18100 Exceptions.push_back(ET);
18101 }
18102 ESI.Exceptions = Exceptions;
18103 return;
18104 }
18105
18106 if (isComputedNoexcept(EST)) {
18107 assert((NoexceptExpr->isTypeDependent() ||
18108 NoexceptExpr->getType()->getCanonicalTypeUnqualified() ==
18109 Context.BoolTy) &&
18110 "Parser should have made sure that the expression is boolean");
18111 if (IsTopLevel && DiagnoseUnexpandedParameterPack(NoexceptExpr)) {
18112 ESI.Type = EST_BasicNoexcept;
18113 return;
18114 }
18115
18116 ESI.NoexceptExpr = NoexceptExpr;
18117 return;
18118 }
18119}
18120
18121void Sema::actOnDelayedExceptionSpecification(Decl *MethodD,
18122 ExceptionSpecificationType EST,
18123 SourceRange SpecificationRange,
18124 ArrayRef<ParsedType> DynamicExceptions,
18125 ArrayRef<SourceRange> DynamicExceptionRanges,
18126 Expr *NoexceptExpr) {
18127 if (!MethodD)
18128 return;
18129
18130 // Dig out the method we're referring to.
18131 if (FunctionTemplateDecl *FunTmpl = dyn_cast<FunctionTemplateDecl>(MethodD))
18132 MethodD = FunTmpl->getTemplatedDecl();
18133
18134 CXXMethodDecl *Method = dyn_cast<CXXMethodDecl>(MethodD);
18135 if (!Method)
18136 return;
18137
18138 // Check the exception specification.
18139 llvm::SmallVector<QualType, 4> Exceptions;
18140 FunctionProtoType::ExceptionSpecInfo ESI;
18141 checkExceptionSpecification(/*IsTopLevel*/true, EST, DynamicExceptions,
18142 DynamicExceptionRanges, NoexceptExpr, Exceptions,
18143 ESI);
18144
18145 // Update the exception specification on the function type.
18146 Context.adjustExceptionSpec(Method, ESI, /*AsWritten*/true);
18147
18148 if (Method->isStatic())
18149 checkThisInStaticMemberFunctionExceptionSpec(Method);
18150
18151 if (Method->isVirtual()) {
18152 // Check overrides, which we previously had to delay.
18153 for (const CXXMethodDecl *O : Method->overridden_methods())
18154 CheckOverridingFunctionExceptionSpec(Method, O);
18155 }
18156}

18158/// HandleMSProperty - Analyze a __delcspec(property) field of a C++ class.
18159///
18160MSPropertyDecl *Sema::HandleMSProperty(Scope *S, RecordDecl *Record,
18161 SourceLocation DeclStart, Declarator &D,
18162 Expr *BitWidth,
18163 InClassInitStyle InitStyle,
18164 AccessSpecifier AS,
18165 const ParsedAttr &MSPropertyAttr) {
18166 IdentifierInfo *II = D.getIdentifier();
18167 if (!II) {
18168 Diag(DeclStart, diag::err_anonymous_property);
18169 return nullptr;
18170 }
18171 SourceLocation Loc = D.getIdentifierLoc();
18172
18173 TypeSourceInfo *TInfo = GetTypeForDeclarator(D, S);
18174 QualType T = TInfo->getType();
18175 if (getLangOpts().CPlusPlus) {
18176 CheckExtraCXXDefaultArguments(D);
18177
18178 if (DiagnoseUnexpandedParameterPack(D.getIdentifierLoc(), TInfo,
18179 UPPC_DataMemberType)) {
18180 D.setInvalidType();
18181 T = Context.IntTy;
18182 TInfo = Context.getTrivialTypeSourceInfo(T, Loc);
18183 }
18184 }
18185
18186 DiagnoseFunctionSpecifiers(D.getDeclSpec());
18187
18188 if (D.getDeclSpec().isInlineSpecified())
18189 Diag(D.getDeclSpec().getInlineSpecLoc(), diag::err_inline_non_function)
18190 << getLangOpts().CPlusPlus17;
18191 if (DeclSpec::TSCS TSCS = D.getDeclSpec().getThreadStorageClassSpec())
18192 Diag(D.getDeclSpec().getThreadStorageClassSpecLoc(),
18193 diag::err_invalid_thread)
18194 << DeclSpec::getSpecifierName(TSCS);
18195
18196 // Check to see if this name was declared as a member previously
18197 NamedDecl *PrevDecl = nullptr;
18198 LookupResult Previous(*this, II, Loc, LookupMemberName,
18199 ForVisibleRedeclaration);
18200 LookupName(Previous, S);
18201 switch (Previous.getResultKind()) {
18202 case LookupResult::Found:
18203 case LookupResult::FoundUnresolvedValue:
18204 PrevDecl = Previous.getAsSingle<NamedDecl>();
18205 break;
18206
18207 case LookupResult::FoundOverloaded:
18208 PrevDecl = Previous.getRepresentativeDecl();
18209 break;
18210
18211 case LookupResult::NotFound:
18212 case LookupResult::NotFoundInCurrentInstantiation:
18213 case LookupResult::Ambiguous:
18214 break;
18215 }
18216
18217 if (PrevDecl && PrevDecl->isTemplateParameter()) {
18218 // Maybe we will complain about the shadowed template parameter.
18219 DiagnoseTemplateParameterShadow(D.getIdentifierLoc(), PrevDecl);
18220 // Just pretend that we didn't see the previous declaration.
18221 PrevDecl = nullptr;
18222 }
18223
18224 if (PrevDecl && !isDeclInScope(PrevDecl, Record, S))
18225 PrevDecl = nullptr;
18226
18227 SourceLocation TSSL = D.getBeginLoc();
18228 MSPropertyDecl *NewPD =
18229 MSPropertyDecl::Create(Context, Record, Loc, II, T, TInfo, TSSL,
18230 MSPropertyAttr.getPropertyDataGetter(),
18231 MSPropertyAttr.getPropertyDataSetter());
18232 ProcessDeclAttributes(TUScope, NewPD, D);
18233 NewPD->setAccess(AS);
18234
18235 if (NewPD->isInvalidDecl())
18236 Record->setInvalidDecl();
18237
18238 if (D.getDeclSpec().isModulePrivateSpecified())
18239 NewPD->setModulePrivate();
18240
18241 if (NewPD->isInvalidDecl() && PrevDecl) {
18242 // Don't introduce NewFD into scope; there's already something
18243 // with the same name in the same scope.
18244 } else if (II) {
18245 PushOnScopeChains(NewPD, S);
18246 } else
18247 Record->addDecl(NewPD);
18248
18249 return NewPD;
18250}

18252void Sema::ActOnStartFunctionDeclarationDeclarator(
18253 Declarator &Declarator, unsigned TemplateParameterDepth) {
18254 auto &Info = InventedParameterInfos.emplace_back();
18255 TemplateParameterList *ExplicitParams = nullptr;
18256 ArrayRef<TemplateParameterList *> ExplicitLists =
18257 Declarator.getTemplateParameterLists();
18258 if (!ExplicitLists.empty()) {
18259 bool IsMemberSpecialization, IsInvalid;
18260 ExplicitParams = MatchTemplateParametersToScopeSpecifier(
18261 Declarator.getBeginLoc(), Declarator.getIdentifierLoc(),
18262 Declarator.getCXXScopeSpec(), /*TemplateId=*/nullptr,
18263 ExplicitLists, /*IsFriend=*/false, IsMemberSpecialization, IsInvalid,
18264 /*SuppressDiagnostic=*/true);
18265 }
18266 if (ExplicitParams) {
18267 Info.AutoTemplateParameterDepth = ExplicitParams->getDepth();
18268 for (NamedDecl *Param : *ExplicitParams)
18269 Info.TemplateParams.push_back(Param);
18270 Info.NumExplicitTemplateParams = ExplicitParams->size();
18271 } else {
18272 Info.AutoTemplateParameterDepth = TemplateParameterDepth;
18273 Info.NumExplicitTemplateParams = 0;
18274 }
18275}
18276
18277void Sema::ActOnFinishFunctionDeclarationDeclarator(Declarator &Declarator) {
18278 auto &FSI = InventedParameterInfos.back();
18279 if (FSI.TemplateParams.size() > FSI.NumExplicitTemplateParams) {
18280 if (FSI.NumExplicitTemplateParams != 0) {
18281 TemplateParameterList *ExplicitParams =
18282 Declarator.getTemplateParameterLists().back();
18283 Declarator.setInventedTemplateParameterList(
18284 TemplateParameterList::Create(
18285 Context, ExplicitParams->getTemplateLoc(),
18286 ExplicitParams->getLAngleLoc(), FSI.TemplateParams,
18287 ExplicitParams->getRAngleLoc(),
18288 ExplicitParams->getRequiresClause()));
18289 } else {
18290 Declarator.setInventedTemplateParameterList(
18291 TemplateParameterList::Create(
18292 Context, SourceLocation(), SourceLocation(), FSI.TemplateParams,
18293 SourceLocation(), /*RequiresClause=*/nullptr));
18294 }
18295 }
18296 InventedParameterInfos.pop_back();
18297}
